label: PetalburgCity_Text_WhereIsWally
text: Where has our WALLY gone? / We have to leave for VERDANTURF TOWN very soon…$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouRookieTrainer
text: Hiya! Are you maybe… A rookie TRAINER? / Do you know what POKéMON TRAINERS do when they reach a new town? / They first check what kind of GYM is in the town.$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ThisIsPetalburgGym
text: See? This is PETALBURG CITY's GYM.$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ThisIsGymSign
text: This is the GYM's sign. Look for it whenever you're looking for a GYM.$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WaterReflection
text: My face is reflected in the water. / It's a shining grin full of hope… / Or it could be a look of somber silence struggling with fear… / What do you see reflected in your face?$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_FullPartyExplanation
text: Let's say you have six POKéMON. If you catch another one… / It is automatically sent to a STORAGE BOX over a PC connection.$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_GymSign
text: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: NORMAN “A man in pursuit of power!”$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_CitySign
text: PETALBURG CITY “Where people mingle with nature.”$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WallyHouseSign
text: WALLY'S HOUSE$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouATrainer
text: Excuse me! / Let me guess, from the way you're dressed, are you a POKéMON TRAINER?$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WellMaybeNot
text: … … … … … … / Well, maybe not. Your clothes aren't all that dirty. / You're either a rookie TRAINER, or maybe you're just an ordinary kid.$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ImLookingForTalentedTrainers
text: I'm roaming the land in search of talented TRAINERS. / I'm sorry to have taken your time.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BattleItemScholar
text: I once sold POWER items here. / The left-side vendor in every CENTER now supplies battle items for free.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_IncenseScholar
text: Incense still matters for breeding, but not as a scarce battle tool. / Check CENTER vendors and local shops.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_WhoahLineSoLong
text: Whoa! This line barely moves! I could have paddled home by now.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_LookingForBrawly
text: Oh! You came looking for DEWFORD's GYM LEADER? / That's me! BRAWLY. Guess I've kept you waiting. / I'll head back to DEWFORD right now. Bring two POKéMON. I battle doubles!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_CatchingGuruSellWhatYouNeed
text: I'm the CATCHING GURU! I stock specialized BALLS for every hunt. / The right BALL can turn a rare sighting into your next teammate!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_EvsAlreadyReady
text: A CENTER tutor can prepare your {STR_VAR_1}'s EV spread. / There is no EV training here; only team building and battle practice!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_WonderIfLighthouseStartlesPokemon
text: The light of the lighthouse reaches dozens of miles away. / I wonder if it doesn't startle POKéMON in the sea.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SeaweedFullOfLife
text: Ooh, look at this! / The seaweed you can get around these parts is fresh and full of life. / Why, it looks like it can even rear up and attack!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_HowTownIsBornAndGrows
text: Where the water is clean, the fruits of bountiful harvest gather. / And where people gather, a market soon starts. / That is how a town is born and grows.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SlateportWonderfulPlace
text: Shopping where you can breathe the scent of the ocean… / SLATEPORT is such a wonderful place!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BuyBricksSoDecorWontGetDirty
text: If you put DOLLS or CUSHIONS on the floor, they'll get dirty. / I'm going to buy some BRICKS so my DOLLS and CUSHIONS won't get dirty when I leave them out.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_GoingToCompeteInBattleTent
text: Wroooar! I'm going to compete in the BATTLE TENT, too! / But before that, I need to catch some POKéMON!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BushedHikingFromMauville
text: Whew… I'm just bushed… / I hiked over from MAUVILLE CITY. But, boy, this city's huge. / If I'd known this, I would've ridden my BIKE here.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_EveryoneCallsHimCaptStern
text: STERN, the fellow who built the MUSEUM, also happens to be the leader of an undersea exploration team. / So, everyone calls him CAPT. STERN.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_WhatsLongLineOverThere
text: What is that over there? That long line…$

label: SlateportCity_Text_VisitedMuseumOften
text: When I was a child, I visited the MUSEUM often. / I used to dream about the mysteries of the sea after seeing the exhibits.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_QuitPushing
text: Hey, there! Quit pushing! This is the line, can't you see?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_AquaHasPolicy
text: TEAM AQUA has a policy of assembling and dispersing at the operation site.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BossIsBrilliant
text: Our BOSS is brilliant. / What would he want to do with a MUSEUM now?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_WhatsNewSchemeIWonder
text: What's the new scheme, I wonder? / Our BOSS is scary when he's mad, so I'd better not screw things up…$

label: SlateportCity_Text_ShouldTakeItAll
text: If there's something we need in the MUSEUM, we should take it all!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_DontButtIn
text: Hey, you there! Don't butt in!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_RemindsMeOfLongLineForGames
text: A long line, huh? / It reminds me of the times I lined up to buy smash-hit games…$

label: SlateportCity_Text_WhyAreWeLiningUp
text: Why are we even lining up and paying? We should just march in!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_WhatDoYouWant
text: What? What do you want?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_IllReadSignForYou
text: You want to read this sign? I'll read it for you!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SaysSomethingLikeSeaIsEndless
text: Let's see… / Um… I think it says something like “the life in the sea is endless.” / Yup, I'm pretty sure that's what it says.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_ShouldveBroughtMyGameBoy
text: Grumble… / I should've brought my Game Boy Advance so I wouldn't get bored in line… / Grumble…$

label: SlateportCity_Text_HotSpringsAfterOperation
text: When this operation's over, I'll take you to a hot spring spa! / That's what our leader said. I can't wait!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SeaIsSoWet
text: The sea is just so vast… / Could the sea have been made by the tears shed by POKéMON?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SinkOldBoats
text: Do you know what they do with old ships that become too creaky to sail? / They sink them in the sea so they become habitats for POKéMON.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BuyTooMuch
text: Whenever I visit here, I get carried away and buy too much.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_GetNameRaterToHelpYou
text: If you want to change your POKéMON's nickname, you'll have to get the NAME RATER to help you.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_CantChangeTradeMonName
text: Any POKéMON you get in a trade, you can't change its nickname. / The original TRAINER's love for that POKéMON is in the nickname.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BattleTentBuiltRecently
text: Recently, a BATTLE TENT was built in SLATEPORT. / GYMS are fun, but the BATTLE TENT's awesome in its own way. / You should go find tough POKéMON for the BATTLE TENT!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_CaptSternBeingInterviewed
text: I was hoping that it was a famous star so I could get an autograph. / But who's that being interviewed? Isn't that CAPT. STERN?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_InterviewerSoCool
text: That lady interviewer is so cool and pretty. / When I grow up, I'm going to be an international journalist!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternSaysDiscoveredSomething
text: CAPT. STERN says they discovered something at the bottom of the sea. / I wonder what it is? What could it be?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_CaptainComeBackWithBigFish
text: What's going on here? / Did the good CAPTAIN come back with a big fish from the ocean floor?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_AmIOnTV
text: Hey! Are you watching? Am I on TV?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_CaptainsACelebrity
text: A TV interview! Here! The CAPTAIN's a celebrity!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BigSmileForCamera
text: TY: Okay, CAPT. STERN, a big smile for the camera!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_MostInvaluableExperience
text: GABBY: I see, I see. You've had a most invaluable experience…$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternMoveAheadWithExploration
text: CAPT. STERN: Yes, indeed. We intend to move ahead with our exploration.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_GabbyWonderfulThanksForInterview
text: GABBY: That's wonderful, CAPT. STERN! Thank you for taking the time from your busy schedule to talk to us. / We hope we can interview you again with news of more discoveries!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternWhewFirstInterview
text: CAPT. STERN: Whew… / That was my first time to be filmed for TV. That was nerve-wracking.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_OhPlayerWeMadeDiscovery
text: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}! You're looking great! / We made a huge discovery on our last seafloor exploration. / We found an underwater cavern on ROUTE 128. / We think it's the habitat of a POKéMON that's said to have been long extinct.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_AquaWillAssumeControlOfSubmarine
text: Fufufu… CAPT. STERN, I presume. / We of TEAM AQUA will assume control of your submarine! / Your objections are meaningless! We expect your total cooperation! / Fufufu… Just watch and learn what TEAM AQUA has planned!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternWhatWasAllThat
text: CAPT. STERN: What was that all about? / It sounded like someone using a megaphone… / Where did it come from?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_FromHarborTryingToTakeSub
text: It's from the HARBOR! / The submarine! They're trying to take it!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_PleaseComeWithMe
text: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Please, come with me!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BattleTentSign
text: BATTLE TENT SLATEPORT SITE “Find it! The ultimate POKéMON!”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardWantedSign
text: STERN'S SHIPYARD / “Wanted: A sailor capable of sailing in all currents.”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardNearsCompletion
text: STERN'S SHIPYARD / “The ferry S.S. TIDAL nears completion for serving the ports of SLATEPORT and LILYCOVE.”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardFerryComplete
text: STERN'S SHIPYARD / “Boarding of the SLATEPORT-LILYCOVE ferry S.S. TIDAL is handled at the HARBOR.”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_PokemonFanClubSign
text: POKéMON FAN CLUB “Calling all fans of POKéMON!”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_OceanicMuseumSign
text: “The endless sea sustains all life.” / OCEANIC MUSEUM$

label: SlateportCity_Text_CitySign
text: SLATEPORT CITY / “The port where people and POKéMON cross paths.”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_MarketSign
text: SLATEPORT MARKET “Specialty goods and local services!”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_HarborFerryUnderConstruction
text: SLATEPORT HARBOR / “The ferry S.S. TIDAL is under construction in the SHIPYARD. / “Service is scheduled to begin shortly.”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_HarborSign
text: SLATEPORT HARBOR / “Enjoy a delightful cruise on the ferry S.S. TIDAL.”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_NameRatersHouseSign
text: NAME RATER'S HOUSE “POKéMON nicknames rated.”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerries
text: If a wild POKéMON gets hurt, it heals itself by chewing on BERRIES. / Did you know that? / Somebody saw that and got the idea of making medicine from BERRIES. / Did you know that? / To turn BERRIES into medicine, they must be crushed into powder. / Did you know that? / You seem to have an interest in BERRIES! / I've got something good for someone like you.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_PowderJarSentToPC
text: Your KEY ITEMS pocket is full, so the POWDER JAR was sent to your PC.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_PowderJarNoRoom
text: Your KEY ITEMS pocket and PC are full. Make room, then return for the jar.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerryPowder
text: I recently had machines installed at POKéMON CENTERS for crushing BERRIES. / The BERRY CRUSH machines are at the DIRECT CORNER upstairs. / Did you know? / Could you make BERRY POWDER for me using those machines? / I can make you all sorts of medicine if you bring me lots of BERRY POWDER.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BroughtMeSomeBerryPowder
text: Have you brought me some BERRY POWDER?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExchangeWhatWithIt
text: What would you like to exchange it with?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExchangeBerryPowderForItem
text: Okay, you want to exchange your BERRY POWDER for one {STR_VAR_1}?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_DontHaveEnoughBerryPowder
text: Oh, dear. You don't have enough BERRY POWDER.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_FineBerryPowderTradeSomethingElse
text: This is fine BERRY POWDER. It will make excellent medicine. / Would you like to trade more of your BERRY POWDER for something else?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_WhenYouGetMoreBringItToMe
text: Okay! When you get some more BERRY POWDER, bring it to me, please!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_ComeBackToTradeBerryPowder
text: Come back if you'd like to trade your BERRY POWDER for some medicine. / I'm always running a bazaar here. / Did you know?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_YouDroveTeamAquaAway
text: SCOTT: Huh? I'm sure I met you somewhere before. / Have I introduced myself to you? If not, my name's SCOTT. / I just saw TEAM AQUA run away from here like they were stung. / Let me guess--you drove them away?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_MaybeThisTrainer
text: SCOTT: Hmm… Maybe, just maybe, this TRAINER…$

label: SlateportCity_Text_LetsRegisterEachOther
text: SCOTT: All right! I think you're going to become a good friend. / So, let's register each other in our POKéNAVS. / … … … … … …$

label: SlateportCity_Text_RegisteredScott
text: Registered this SCOTT person in the POKéNAV.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_KeepEyeOnTrainersBeSeeingYou
text: SCOTT: What I'd like to do is tag along with you, but I do want to keep an eye on the talents of other people, too. / So, I'll be off to roam other towns a bit more. / Be seeing you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_TakingBattleTentChallenge
text: SCOTT: Oh, hey! If it isn't {PLAYER}{KUN}! / {PLAYER}{KUN}, let me guess--you're going to take the BATTLE TENT challenge? / Yeah! That's a good idea! That's a really great idea! / After all, a tough TRAINER is the perfect fit for the BATTLE TENT! / Give it your best effort!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_GretaChallenge
text: I'm GRETA of the BATTLE ARENA. / A real match reveals mind, skill, and body all at once. Show me yours!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_GretaDefeat
text: All three were sharp. Nicely done!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_GretaDecline
text: Return when mind, skill, and body are ready to be judged together.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_GretaAfter
text: That GENGARITE marks a contender. Bring it to the BATTLE FRONTIER.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_KnuckleGuardClosed
text: ROUTE 110 is closed while the CYCLING ROAD crew resurfaces the trail. / The LEAGUE lets certified TRAINERS through. BRAWLY's KNUCKLE BADGE counts.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BrawlyAtMuseum
text: BRAWLY is in the queue outside the OCEANIC MUSEUM. Ask him to go home. / Then sail back with MR. BRINEY and challenge DEWFORD GYM.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BrawlyBackInDewford
text: BRAWLY has returned to DEWFORD GYM. Challenge him for the KNUCKLE BADGE. / MR. BRINEY's boat is on ROUTE 109, south of SLATEPORT.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_KnuckleGuardTrigger
text: Whoa, not past the cones! ROUTE 110 is closed until you hold the KNUCKLE BADGE.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleHesTooPeppy
text: UNCLE: It's because of POKéMON that this boy's got more pep, I suppose… But he's become a bit too peppy…$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWantToChallengeGym
text: WALLY: Aww, UNCLE, please? / I don't grind. Nobody has to. I built a team, and a GYM is where you test one.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleYourePushingIt
text: UNCLE: Now hold on, WALLY. / Since you started living with POKéMON, you have grown quite a lot stronger. / But don't you think you're pushing it to suddenly challenge a GYM?$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWeCanBeatAnyone
text: WALLY: I'm not pushing it. / RALTS and I found five partners who cover each other. We can beat anyone!$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWillYouBattleMe
text: WALLY: Oh! Hi, {PLAYER}! / I've built a real doubles team since we met. I want you and my UNCLE to see it. / Please, will you battle me?$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyMyUncleWontKnowImStrong
text: WALLY: Oh… If you won't, my UNCLE will never believe my team is real.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleCanYouBattleWally
text: UNCLE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, was it? On WALLY's behalf, can I ask you to battle with him just this once? / I don't think he's going to listen to any reason the way he is now.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyPleaseBattleMe
text: WALLY: {PLAYER}, please! One battle.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyHereICome
text: WALLY: {PLAYER}, thank you. / WEAVILE leads, ZAPDOS sets the wind… Okay. Here I come!$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyDefeat
text: WALLY: ... / I had a plan for every partner. You still found your way through. / I lost...$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyIllGoBackToVerdanturf
text: WALLY: UNCLE… I'll go back to VERDANTURF. / I know what my team was missing now.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ThankYouNotEnoughToBattle
text: {PLAYER}, thank you. Being a TRAINER is tough, isn't it? / It's not enough just to have POKéMON and make them battle. That isn't what being a real TRAINER is about.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleNoNeedToBeDown
text: UNCLE: WALLY, there's no need to be so down on yourself. / Why, what's keeping you from becoming stronger and stronger? / Come on, let's go home. Everyone's waiting for you.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleVisitUsSometime
text: UNCLE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, it just dawned on me that you must be the TRAINER who kept an eye out for WALLY when he caught his POKéMON. / Why don't you visit us in VERDANTURF sometime? I'm sure WALLY would enjoy it.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyPokenavCall
text: … … … … … … … … … … … Beep! / WALLY: Oh, hello, {PLAYER}! / I just wanted to tell you that my uncle bought me a POKéNAV! / Now I can get in touch with you anytime, {PLAYER}! / … … … … … … … … … … … Click!$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_RegisteredWally
text: Registered WALLY in the POKéNAV.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ScottYouDidntHoldBack
text: SCOTT: Hehe… I was watching that match! / You're friends with that boy WALLY, aren't you? / But you didn't hold anything back and beat him impressively. / Yeah! That's what a real POKéMON battle is all about! / I idolize TRAINERS like that! / … … … … … … I'll be cheering for you!$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonNeedFavorTakeKey
text: WATTSON: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! You look like you have a lot of zip! That's a good thing, wahahahaha! / Fine! I've decided! I need a favor, {PLAYER}{KUN}! / MAUVILLE CITY has an underground sector called NEW MAUVILLE. / {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'd like you to go there and switch off the GENERATOR. / The GENERATOR has been running a bit haywire. It's getting unsafe. / Here, this is the KEY to get into NEW MAUVILLE.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonWontBeChallenge
text: WATTSON: Don't you worry about it. It won't be a challenge to you. / The entrance to NEW MAUVILLE is just a short SURF away from ROUTE 110. / That's it, then, you have my trust! Wahahahaha! / WATTSON: If you find MELTAN, level it up in NEW MAUVILLE to get MELMETAL. The generator can be on or off!$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonThanksTakeElectirizer
text: WATTSON: Wahahahaha! I knew I'd made the right choice asking you! / This ELECTIRIZER came from the old GENERATOR. You've earned it!$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonYoungTakeCharge
text: WATTSON: Wahahahaha! / It pleases me to no end to see the young step up and take charge! / WATTSON: If you find MELTAN, level it up in NEW MAUVILLE to get MELMETAL. The generator can be on or off!$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_NurseHurtMonBackToHealth
text: You know, it's cool to have POKéMON battles and stuff… / But if your POKéMON gets hurt, you have to nurse it back to health.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_AllSortsOfPeopleComeThrough
text: The roads of this town stretch north and south, and east and west. / Because of that, we get all sorts of people coming through.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_RydelVeryGenerous
text: Have you been to RYDEL'S CYCLES yet? / RYDEL, the owner, is a very generous man.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_PokemonCanJumpYouOnBike
text: Even if you're riding a BIKE, wild POKéMON could jump you.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_CitySign
text: MAUVILLE CITY “The bright and shiny city of fun!”$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_GymSign
text: MAUVILLE CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: WATTSON “The cheerfully electrifying man!”$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_BikeShopSign
text: “Ride in gravel and shake up your soul!” RYDEL'S CYCLES$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_GameCornerSign
text: “The play spot for all!” MAUVILLE GAME CORNER$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ExplainTV
text: Hi, do you check out TV at all? / They've added a bunch of cool new shows recently. / TV is so cool. I've seen my friends on TV just out of the blue. / And, sometimes, they even put you on TV without telling you. / I wish I would be on TV sometime. / That's why I think you should check out TVs whenever you can.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_BeenCheckingOutTV
text: Hi, have you been checking out TVs?$

label: RustboroCity_Text_RoxanneRestoredBefore
text: Stone alone is not a strategy. / Study the partners in my GYM, then show me how your own team connects.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_RoxanneRestoredAfter
text: Your STONE BADGE proves you can solve more than a type chart. / DEVON may have a task for you next.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_WeShortenItToDevon
text: The DEVON CORPORATION… We all just shorten it to DEVON. / That company makes all sorts of convenient products.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_SneakyLookingManWentAroundCorner
text: Hm? A sneaky-looking man? / Come to think of it, yes, a shady- looking guy went around the corner.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_HaveYouChallengedGym
text: Have you taken the POKéMON GYM challenge? / When you get that shiny GYM BADGE in hand, I guess TRAINERS begin to realize what is required of them.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_HeyThatsRustborosGymBadge
text: Hey, that's RUSTBORO's GYM BADGE! / Out of all the POKéMON GYM BADGES, RUSTBORO's is the coolest, I'd say.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_YoureNewAroundHere
text: Oh? Who might you be? You're a new face around these parts. / Have you just transferred into the POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL?$

label: RustboroCity_Text_GymLeaderIsntEasyWithFire
text: I challenged the GYM LEADER, but… / It's not going to be easy winning with my FIRE-type POKéMON… / FIRE-type POKéMON don't match up well against ROCK-type POKéMON…$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MrBrineyWalksInTheTunnel
text: The old sailor MR. BRINEY lives in a cottage by the sea. / He goes for walks in the tunnel every so often.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MrBrineyLovesPeeko
text: The old sailor MR. BRINEY lives in a cottage by the sea. / He said he was going shopping in SLATEPORT for his pet, PEEKO. / That old sea dog, he must really love that PEEKO.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_WowYouHavePokemon
text: Wow, you have POKéMON with you, too. / When I get bigger, I'm going to go places with POKéMON, too.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_CatchRarePokemonIfIGoToSchool
text: POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL! / If I go to this school, will I be able to catch rare POKéMON easily?$

label: RustboroCity_Text_PokemonCanChangeLookFromExp
text: If a POKéMON gains experience in battles, it can sometimes change in the way it looks.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_PokemonChangeShape
text: A POKéMON changes shape? If one did that, I would be shocked!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_TradePokemonGrowFast
text: A POKéMON you get in a trade from someone grows fast. / But if you don't have certain GYM BADGES, it may not obey you…$

label: RustboroCity_Text_OutOfTheWay
text: Get out! Out of the way!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_WaitDontTakeMyGoods
text: Wait! Pleeeaaase! / Don't take my GOODS!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_HelpMeIWasRobbed
text: Oh, it's you! / You're that fantastic TRAINER who helped me in PETALBURG WOODS! / Help me! I was robbed by TEAM AQUA! I have to get the DEVON GOODS back! / If I don't… I'm going to be in serious trouble. / He ran east along ROUTE 116! Please check RUSTURF TUNNEL. / Bring the GOODS back to me here. I'll wait by the road.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_ShadyCharacterTookOffTowardsTunnel
text: Follow ROUTE 116 east to RUSTURF TUNNEL. He went that way! / Please bring the DEVON GOODS back to me here.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_YouGotItThankYou
text: Oh! How did it go? The DEVON GOODS? / You did! You got them back! / You really are a great TRAINER! / I know! As my thanks, I'll give you another GREAT BALL!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_YoureLoadedWithItems
text: You're loaded with items. I can't give you this GREAT BALL.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_PleaseComeWithMe
text: Excuse me, please! Please come with me!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayHiLetsRegister
text: MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}! / You had a MATCH CALL feature put on your POKéNAV! / Let's register each other so we can contact one another anytime! / … … … … … …$

label: RustboroCity_Text_RegisteredMay
text: Registered MAY in the POKéNAV.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayPassedBrineyWantToBattle
text: MAY: Oh, by the way, I passed MR. BRINEY in PETALBURG WOODS. / I guess he's on his way home to his cottage by the sea. / How's your POKéDEX coming along, {PLAYER}{KUN}? Mine's looking pretty decent! / So… How about a little battle?$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayOhHaventRaisedPokemonEnough
text: MAY: Oh, what's the matter? / Haven't you caught or raised your POKéMON very much? / That's not very good for a TRAINER!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayWantToBattle
text: MAY: So, what do you think? How about a little battle here?$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayImNotGoingToLose
text: MAY: You just became a TRAINER, {PLAYER}{KUN}. I'm not going to lose!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayDefeat
text: Yikes! You're better than I expected!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayMrBrineyHint
text: MAY: Oh, by the way, MR. BRINEY, who I just passed… / {PLAYER}{KUN}, you just moved here so you might not know this, but MR. BRINEY was once a revered seafarer.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanHiLetsRegister
text: BRENDAN: Oh, hey, {PLAYER}! / You had a MATCH CALL feature put on your POKéNAV! Cool! / Let's register each other so we can get in touch anytime! / … … … … … …$

label: RustboroCity_Text_RegisteredBrendan
text: Registered BRENDAN in the POKéNAV.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanPassedBrineyWantToBattle
text: BRENDAN: By the way, {PLAYER}, I walked by MR. BRINEY in PETALBURG WOODS. / I bet he was on his way home to his cottage by the sea. / {PLAYER}, how's your POKéDEX? Have you filled in any pages yet? / Mine rules. / Want to have a battle to test how far you've progressed?$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanNoConfidenceInPokemon
text: BRENDAN: What's the matter? Don't have any confidence in your POKéMON?$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanWantToBattle
text: BRENDAN: What's up? Want to have a battle with me?$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanIWontGoEasy
text: BRENDAN: I know you just became a TRAINER, but I won't go easy!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanDefeat
text: Hmm… You're pretty good.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanMrBrineyHint
text: BRENDAN: By the way, you know MR. BRINEY? The guy I just passed? / I bet you didn't know this, since you just moved here, {PLAYER}, but MR. BRINEY was once a great sailor.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_TunnelNearingCompletion
text: “Timesaving tunnel nearing completion!” / …Is what it says on the sign, but there's also a big “X” splashed across it in red paint…$

label: RustboroCity_Text_DevonCorpSign
text: DEVON CORPORATION / “For all your living needs, we make it all.”$

label: RustboroCity_Text_GymSign
text: RUSTBORO CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: ROXANNE / “The ROCK-loving honors student!”$

label: RustboroCity_Text_DevonCorpBranchOfficeSign
text: DEVON CORP. BRANCH OFFICE / “Access limited to DEVON employees and authorized personnel.”$

label: RustboroCity_Text_CitySign
text: RUSTBORO CITY / “The city probing the integration of nature and science.”$

label: RustboroCity_Text_TrainersSchoolSign
text: POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL / “We'll teach you anything about POKéMON!”$

label: RustboroCity_Text_CuttersHouse
text: CUTTER'S HOUSE$

label: RustboroCity_Text_DevelopedNewPokenavFeature
text: I've been developing an added feature for the POKéNAV… / And it turned out great! / {PLAYER}, may I see that POKéNAV? The one our PRESIDENT gave you?$

label: RustboroCity_Text_AddedMatchCallPleaseCallMrStone
text: There you go, {PLAYER}! / I added a new feature named MATCH CALL to your POKéNAV. / Using the MATCH CALL feature, you can chat with people who have been registered in your POKéNAV. / {PLAYER}, our PRESIDENT STONE should be registered in your POKéNAV. / Test it out. Please give our PRESIDENT a call.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_PleaseSelectPokenav
text: Please select the POKéNAV.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_IdBetterGetBackToWork
text: Okay, I'd better get back to work. Please take care, {PLAYER}!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_YouCanHave2On2Battle
text: Did you know this? / You can have a 2-on-2 battle even if you're not with another TRAINER. / If you catch the eyes of two TRAINERS when you have two or more POKéMON, they'll both challenge you. / Don't you think it'd be cool if you could beat two TRAINERS by yourself?$

label: FortreeCity_Text_SawGiganticPokemonInSky
text: No one believes me, but I saw this gigantic POKéMON in the sky. / It seemed to squirm as it flew toward ROUTE 131. / By the way… Sniff… Um… You, uh…smell singed. / Were you at a volcano or something?$

label: FortreeCity_Text_SomethingBlockingGym
text: I want to go to the POKéMON GYM, but something's blocking the way. / After all the bother I went through training on ROUTE 120… / STEVEN is on the bridge east of town. He was studying something invisible. / Maybe he can help us clear the GYM path!$

label: FortreeCity_Text_ThisTimeIllBeatWinona
text: I've got my pride-and-joy POKéMON with me. This time, I'll beat WINONA.$

label: FortreeCity_Text_TreesGrowByDrinkingRainwater
text: The ground absorbs rainwater, and trees grow by drinking that water… / Our FORTREE CITY exists because there's both water and soil.$

label: FortreeCity_Text_EveryoneHealthyAndLively
text: The CITY consists of homes built on trees. / Perhaps because of that lifestyle, everyone is healthy and lively. / Why, even myself--I feel as if I've grown thirty years younger.$

label: FortreeCity_Text_BugPokemonComeThroughWindow
text: Living on top of trees is okay. / But sometimes BUG POKéMON come in through windows. It can be really startling.$

label: FortreeCity_Text_PokemonThatEvolveWhenTraded
text: There are POKéMON that evolve when you trade them! That's what I heard.$

label: FortreeCity_Text_SomethingUnseeable
text: Something unseeable is in the way.$

label: FortreeCity_Text_UnseeableUseDevonScope
text: Something unseeable is in the way. / Want to use the DEVON SCOPE?$

label: FortreeCity_Text_UsedDevonScopePokemonFled
text: {PLAYER} used the DEVON SCOPE. / An invisible POKéMON became completely visible! / The startled POKéMON fled!$

label: FortreeCity_Text_CitySign
text: FORTREE CITY “The treetop city that frolics with nature.”$

label: FortreeCity_Text_GymSign
text: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: WINONA / “The bird user taking flight into the world.”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_AltarianiteKeeperOffer
text: Your ALTARIA carries itself like a cloud dragon. Take this ALTARIANITE?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_AltarianiteKeeperExplain
text: ALTARIANITE lets ALTARIA Mega Evolve. / WINONA also entrusts one to every TRAINER who earns her BADGE.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_AltarianiteKeeperNeedsAltaria
text: Return with ALTARIA. I want to see whether it moves like a cloud.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_AltarianiteKeeperDecline
text: Very well. The stone will wait until you and ALTARIA are ready.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayShoppingLetsBattle
text: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Shopping? The CENTER gives out held items free, but choosing is the fun part. / I've rebuilt my team around the POKéMON I found on the way. Let's see how yours has grown!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayNotRaisingPokemon
text: MAY: Not now? Come on. Nobody needs to grind here. Bring the plan you have.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayBattleMe
text: MAY: Come on, battle me so I can see how you build now!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayWontBeBeaten
text: MAY: My six have an answer for everything. Let's see yours answer them!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayDefeat
text: MAY: I remember our first battle on ROUTE 103. / You keep finding ways through my teams. I'll have to try again!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayGoingBackToLittleroot
text: MAY: I'm heading back to LITTLEROOT. Dad could use help sorting all our POKéMON sightings.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToCollectBadges
text: Keep going, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Earn the BADGES, explore HOENN and take on the LEAGUE! / I'll still finish the POKéDEX before you do. See you!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToPokemonLeague
text: {PLAYER}{KUN}, is it the LEAGUE next? Or the POKéDEX? / I lost the battle. I'm still winning the POKéDEX. See you!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToBattleFrontier
text: {PLAYER}{KUN}, what are you going to do? / Are you taking the BATTLE FRONTIER challenge? / Or, are you going to complete your POKéDEX? / I might've lost to you in battling, but I'll finish my POKéDEX before you! / See you!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanShoppingLetsBattle
text: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}. Running an errand for Dad. No, not DOLLS. / It's been a while. Let's see whose six got smarter since ROUTE 119.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanNoConfidence
text: BRENDAN: What, no plan ready? That's new for you.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanBattleMe
text: BRENDAN: Battle me. I want to see how you build now.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanWontBeBeaten
text: BRENDAN: I've caught and trained POKéMON all the way here. I'm ready for you, {PLAYER}!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanDefeat
text: BRENDAN: You found a way through my team. That stings. / I had a head start as a TRAINER... I'll have to make the next one count.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanGoingBackToLittleroot
text: BRENDAN: I'm heading home. Dad needs someone to sort our POKéMON sightings, and I know where I found mine.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToCollectBadges
text: {PLAYER}, what's next? The rest of the BADGES and the LEAGUE? / Maybe I'll do that too… / Anyway. Keep reading them faster.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToPokemonLeague
text: {PLAYER}, going for the LEAGUE? / One more rebuild and I'd beat you. Probably. Anyway, hang in there!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToBattleFrontier
text: {PLAYER}, what now? The FRONTIER, or the POKéDEX? / With your teams, the FRONTIER. The CIRCUIT there is doubles all the way. / One more rebuild and I'm stronger than you. Probably. Hang in there!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MovedLootIntoHideoutToday
text: Fufufu… / We moved more loot into our secret HIDEOUT today… / Wh-who are you?! I was just talking to myself!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ChanceToDoBigThings
text: I'm just a GRUNT, so I don't know what the BOSS is thinking… / But being on TEAM AQUA, I know I'll get the chance to do big things! / Wh-who are you?! I was just talking to myself!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_DontGoNearCaveInCove
text: Hey, you! / Don't go near the cave in the cove! / Why? You don't need a reason why! I'm an adult, so you just listen to me!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_IfWorldBecomesOurs
text: If this whole wide world becomes ours, TEAM AQUA's, it will be a happier place for POKéMON, too.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_WailmerLeapOutOfWater
text: There! WAILMER! Leap out of the water now!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_GetLostMessingUpTraining
text: Hunh? What do you want? / You're messing up our training, so can you, like, get lost?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ContestHallInTown
text: There's a POKéMON CONTEST HALL right in this here town.  / That means well-raised POKéMON will come from all over the country. / My heart swells with excitement!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_StrangeCaveInCove
text: Have you seen that strange cave in the cove at the edge of town?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_GoingToMoveDeleterForHMs
text: I'm going to teach my POKéMON some new moves for entering a CONTEST. / So, I'm going to see the MOVE DELETER and make it forget HM moves.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ImFromKanto
text: I came from KANTO. / The HOENN region is beautiful with all its water and verdant nature. / Hunh? Wait a second… / Could there be rare POKéMON that live only in this area?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaBeenTrainingWailmer
text: TEAM AQUA's been training their WAILMER in the cove. / We SAILORS can't get our boats out to sea with them in the way!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SomeonePuntedTeamAquaOut
text: Ahoy, did you know? / Someone punted TEAM AQUA out of the way for us! / That got the WAILMER out of the cove, so we can get our boats out again.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SomeoneStoleMyPokemon
text: I was taking a relaxing snooze at the seaside inn to the sound of waves… / When someone stole my POKéMON! / Who's the abductor? TEAM AQUA? Is it TEAM AQUA?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MissingPokemonCameBack
text: My missing POKéMON… It came back without me noticing!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ImArtDealer
text: I'm an ART DEALER. / I am a buyer and seller of fine art, especially paintings. / I've heard that the MUSEUM here has magnificent works on exhibit…$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SeaRemainsForeverYoung
text: Even as we grow old and wrinkled, the sea remains forever young with the vivid brilliance of life… / Fwohoho fwohohohoho…$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SixtyYearsAgoHusbandProposed
text: It was sixty years ago that my husband proposed to me here. The sea remains as beautiful as ever. / Mufufufu mufufufufufu…$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaRenovatedCavern
text: Hm, you know of the peculiar cavern in this cove? / That had been a natural formation, but then that TEAM AQUA lot came along and made their renovations. / They call themselves the “nature-loving TEAM AQUA”! / But what they do and what they say don't match at all!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaLotGoneForGood
text: That cave in the cove… / I didn't notice it right away, but it's completely empty now. / That TEAM AQUA lot, they must have gone away for good.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_CitySign
text: LILYCOVE CITY / “Where the land ends and the sea begins.”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ContestHallSign
text: POKéMON CONTEST HALL “The gathering place for TRAINERS!”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MotelSign
text: COVE LILY MOTEL / “Remember us as COVE LILY of LILYCOVE.”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MuseumSign
text: LILYCOVE MUSEUM / “POKéMON Masterpiece Collection on exhibit!”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MuseumSignPlayersExhibit
text: LILYCOVE MUSEUM / “{PLAYER}'s POKéMON Collection on exhibit!”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_HarborSignUnderConstruction
text: LILYCOVE CITY HARBOR / “The ferry S.S. TIDAL is under construction in SLATEPORT CITY. / “Service is scheduled to begin shortly.”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_HarborSign
text: LILYCOVE CITY HARBOR / “Enjoy a delightful cruise on the ferry S.S. TIDAL.”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_TrainerFanClubSign
text: POKéMON TRAINER FAN CLUB / The names of TRAINERS are scribbled all over the sign…$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_DepartmentStoreSign
text: LILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE / “Overflowing with great merchandise and excitement! / “A great place to find that something you need!”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MoveDeletersHouseSign
text: MOVE DELETER'S HOUSE / “Unwanted POKéMON moves deleted.”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_DoYouKnowAboutBerryBlender
text: Do you know about the machine BERRY BLENDER?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_FasterSpinBetterPokeblocks
text: People have to work together to get it to spin faster. / The faster you can make it spin, the better {POKEBLOCK}S you can get, I've heard.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ExplainBerryBlender
text: It's used for making a kind of candy called a {POKEBLOCK}. / If you give a good {POKEBLOCK} to a POKéMON, its condition will improve by a lot.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_HeardTowerCalledSkyPillar
text: I heard there's a tower somewhere out on the sea routes. / It's called the SKY PILLAR, I hear.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SawTallTowerOnRoute131
text: I saw this tall tower somewhere around ROUTE 131. / Could that possibly be…?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_JustArrivedAndSawRarePokemon
text: We just arrived here on our honeymoon vacation. / We happened to see a DRAGON-type POKéMON flying way up in the sky. / Do cool POKéMON like that live in the HOENN region?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_HoneymoonVowToSeeRarePokemon
text: On our honeymoon, we vowed to see as many rare POKéMON as we can. / So we were delighted to see a rare POKéMON as soon as we arrived. / I mean, we are totally happy!$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WantKingsRockStevenGaveMe
text: I got this from STEVEN, but I don't know what it's good for. / I think it's called KING'S ROCK. Do you want it?$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_YouCanKeepIt
text: Why would you want it? You're weird. / You can keep it, but keep it a secret from STEVEN.$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_StevensHouseOverThere
text: STEVEN's house is right over there!$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WhatToDoWithWeirdRock
text: Yeah, you think so, too! What are you supposed to do with some weird rock?$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WailmerWatching
text: Around MOSSDEEP, you can see wild WAILMER. / It's called, uh… What was it now… / WAI, WAI, WAI… / WAILMER watching!$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterReceivedLetter
text: The island's SPACE CENTER has been launching huge rockets. / There's been some kind of an uproar over a letter they received recently.$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterLaunchingRockets
text: The island's SPACE CENTER has been launching huge rockets.$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_MossdeepTargetedByMagma
text: I heard from a SAILOR buddy that TEAM AQUA set up shop in LILYCOVE. / I also heard that someone came along and wiped the floor with them! / But MOSSDEEP here's been targeted by that TEAM MAGMA. / If you want to know what they're up to, go visit the SPACE CENTER.$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_FeelReliefOnLand
text: I'm a SAILOR, so the sea's obviously more important to me. / But you know? When I get back on land after a long voyage, I do feel relief!$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_NiceIfWorldCoveredByFlowers
text: Wouldn't it be nice? / If the whole world was covered in plants and flowers like this island?$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_LifeNeedsSeaToLive
text: With the MIND BADGE, MANAPHY and PALKIA can appear among wild POKéMON on the SEAFLOOR CAVERN seabed. / DIVE at ROUTE 128 and search near the submarine. / Each has a 1% chance. SWEET SCENT gives a 25% chance of an available legendary, shared between them.$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SurfExhilarating
text: A voyage on a ship is fine. / But crossing the sea with POKéMON using SURF… / Now that's an exhilarating trip! Wouldn't you agree, youngster?$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpecialSpaceCenterRock
text: This rock has a special meaning to the people at the SPACE CENTER. / They put it here as their wish for their rockets to fly safely. / When you make a wish, what do you use? Do you wish upon a star? / I use a wish tag to make it happen. That's what I do.$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_ItsAWhiteRock
text: It's a white rock.$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_GymSign
text: MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM LEADERS: LIZA & TATE / “The mystic combination!”$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_CitySign
text: MOSSDEEP CITY “Our slogan: Cherish POKéMON!”$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterSign
text: MOSSDEEP SPACE CENTER “The closest place to space.”$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_ScottSomethingWrongWithTown
text: SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, feeling good? I'm doing great! / I'd heard MOSSDEEP's GYM LEADER is pretty strong, so I decided to come take a look-see for myself. / But there's something wrong about this town. / People are going on about a warning letter and the SPACE CENTER… / I don't think it concerns me in any way, though.$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SootopolisNewGymLeader
text: Ahh… It feels great letting the waves wash over my feet… / Speaking of the waves, you know that island city SOOTOPOLIS? / I think the GYM there had a new LEADER come in. / People tell me the new LEADER once mentored WALLACE.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GymSign
text: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: JUAN / “The GYM LEADER with the beauty of pure water!”$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CitySign
text: SOOTOPOLIS CITY / “The mystical city where history slumbers.”$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoorIsClosed
text: The door is closed.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_PhysicallyFitLivingHere
text: Diving in the sea. Climbing up and down stairs all the time… / If you live in this town, you end up getting physically fit.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiantPokemonSuddenlyAppeared
text: These giant POKéMON suddenly appeared in the middle of the city! / And, I've never seen them before! / Why are they smashing into each other like that? / Why can't they be friends, those POKéMON?$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WhatIsThatGreenPokemon
text: What? What? What? What is that green POKéMON?!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WhereDidLegendariesGo
text: GROUDON and KYOGRE… Where did they go? / Will they cause droughts or downpours somewhere else?$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_TwoPokemonArentAngry
text: I just get this sense somehow that the two POKéMON aren't angry. / I think… They probably can't control their own power…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_FlyingMonStoppedRampage
text: That flying POKéMON came down from the sky and stopped the rampaging POKéMON…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WonderWhatWorldIsLike
text: I… I've never been out of this city. / I wonder what the world is like on the other side of this round sky?$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThisIsWicked
text: Wow! This is wicked!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThatWasWicked
text: Wow! That was wicked!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GoRedAndBlueMon
text: Go for it, red POKéMON! Don't back off, blue POKéMON!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoYouKnowMonNames
text: … … … … … … / Hi, do you know the names of those POKéMON fighting over there?$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GreenOneSettlesThings
text: I was wondering which one would win, the red one or the blue one, but, oh no, it's the green one that settles things! / Talk about a huge turn of events!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SeeingLegendWithOwnEyes
text: There's an ancient legend that claims the land and sea were shaped by a colossal battle between POKéMON. / Well, I'm seeing that happen with my very own eyes! / Whoa! I never expected to be witness to something this huge!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SawLegendWithOwnEyes
text: There's an ancient legend that claims the land and sea were shaped by a colossal battle between POKéMON. / Well, I saw that happen with my very own eyes! / Whoa! I never expected to be witness to something this huge!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_BigPokemonFighting
text: A big POKéMON is fighting with another big POKéMON! / Please, someone make them stop!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_PrettyMonCameFromSky
text: A pretty POKéMON came down from the sky…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisWillBeWrecked
text: Oh, no! SOOTOPOLIS CITY will get wrecked!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisDidntGetWrecked
text: SOOTOPOLIS CITY didn't get wrecked!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NoOrdinaryTourist
text: Hm! You've come all the way to SOOTOPOLIS? You're no ordinary tourist. / But I suppose that doesn't make you an extraordinary tourist, either.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CityRegainedCalm
text: The city has regained its calm…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginPleaseLeave
text: Who might you be? / This is the CAVE OF ORIGIN. / The spirits of POKéMON, becalmed at MT. PYRE, are said to be revived here. / Please leave.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_LeadSuperiorTrainerToCave
text: A person with a strong will and superior talent… / A TRAINER who has knowledge and experience of many kinds of POKéMON… / If such a person were to appear, I was instructed by WALLACE to lead that TRAINER to this CAVE.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AwakenedPokemonClash
text: Oh, my… / The clash between the two awakened POKéMON was quelled by the awakening of a third POKéMON…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginSleepsToo
text: The crisis has passed. You may explore the CAVE OF ORIGIN again. / TERAPAGOS lives on B1F, the floor where you met WALLACE. Let me check its discovery record.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisSkyBeautiful
text: SOOTOPOLIS sprang up as a town in the crater of a volcano. / If you look up at the sky, the lip of the crater is also visible. So, all you see is the sky in a circle. / But that's what makes the sky above SOOTOPOLIS the most beautiful.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiganticPokemonFight
text: When two POKéMON that gigantic are fighting that savagely, there's not much that we can do.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_FearedWorstWhenPokemonFlewDown
text: When that third POKéMON flew down, I feared the worst.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NightSkyFavoriteScenery
text: A circle of a night sky framed by the crater of a volcano… / And in that ring, stars flicker and blink as if they were alive… It's my favorite scenery.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WeatherWentWild
text: The weather was clear this morning, but… / All of a sudden, dark clouds brewed up, rain started falling in sheets, and there was thunder and lightning, too. / The weather just went completely wild! / Is all of this because of those POKéMON?$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_YouBroughtFlyingMon
text: Oh? / It was you who brought that flying POKéMON here? / Well, aren't you amazing!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GroudonPleaseStop
text: MAXIE: GROUDON, stop! I wanted land that could sustain a future, not consume it. / My certainty left no room for yours.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AfterAllOurScheming
text: MAXIE: RAYQUAZA did not overpower both rivals. It restored their relationship. / All our models optimized one side of a system that could only live in balance.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_KyogreCalmDown
text: ARCHIE: KYOGRE! I called this freedom, but even the sea needs a shore. / The RED ORB cannot make you hear me.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_TryingMeaninglessToPokemon
text: ARCHIE: Land, sea, and sky returned to motion without belonging to any of us. / AQUA tried to free the world by choosing its answer for it. That was control too.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_InvolvedWithCrisisComeWithMe
text: STEVEN: GROUDON and KYOGRE's clash is tearing through this crater. / Their weather reaches across HOENN. We must restore the balance before anyone else is hurt. / WALLACE knows the old legends. Come with me.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoesThisMakeYourFearPokemon
text: STEVEN: Power without relationship looks terrifying. You already know the answer: a partner is not a tool to command.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_HereWereAreHelpWallace
text: WALLACE knows the story of the last time these two clashed. Tell him what you have seen.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_KnowWhatsNeededToHelpHim
text: STEVEN: I think you have what's needed to help him…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NeverBeenToSkyPillar
text: STEVEN: SKY PILLAR stands on the north side of ROUTE 131, east of PACIFIDLOG. / RAYQUAZA is said to rest at its summit. Find it and bring it here!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SoThatsRayquaza
text: STEVEN: RAYQUAZA did not make them flee. It reminded land and sea of the whole.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_MaxieArchieLeft
text: STEVEN: MAXIE and ARCHIE have gone to MT. PYRE to return the ORBS. / The weather is settling. There is still so much of HOENN to explore, and so many POKéMON to meet. / Our researcher at DEVON can tell you which legendary discoveries are available now.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_HaventYouScaledSkyPillar
text: WALLACE: Oh? {PLAYER}{KUN}? / Haven't you scaled the SKY PILLAR yet? / I'm sure that you can make it to the top of the SKY PILLAR…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AquaMagmaDidntMeanHarm
text: WALLACE: MAXIE and ARCHIE caused this, but both finally understand the cost. / Hear them. Accountability matters more when the motive once sounded noble.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThankYouForHelpAcceptThis
text: WALLACE: You did not win by possessing the strongest POKéMON in the crater. / You found the one relationship that made every other action possible. / HOENN is safe. Please accept this.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ExplainWaterfallGoToGym
text: That HIDDEN MACHINE contains WATERFALL. / With the RAIN BADGE, a party member that can learn WATERFALL can climb waterfalls without being taught it. / And where does one get the RAIN BADGE? You know, don't you? / That's right! You have to beat the SOOTOPOLIS GYM LEADER. / When you're all set to go, step through that door.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DazzledByMentor
text: WALLACE: JUAN's Gym is the final test before the LEAGUE. Expect no mercy.$

label: EverGrandeCity_Text_EnteringVictoryRoad
text: ENTERING VICTORY ROAD$

label: EverGrandeCity_Text_EnteringPokemonLeague
text: ENTERING POKéMON LEAGUE CENTER GATE$

label: EverGrandeCity_Text_CitySign
text: EVER GRANDE CITY / “The paradise of flowers, the sea, and POKéMON.”$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
text: MOM: {PLAYER}, we're here, honey! / It must be tiring riding with our things in the moving truck. / Well, this is LITTLEROOT TOWN. / How do you like it? This is our new home! / It has a quaint feel, but it seems to be an easy place to live, don't you think? / And, you get your own room, {PLAYER}! Let's go inside.$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WaitPlayer
text: MOM: Wait, {PLAYER}!$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoes
text: MOM: {PLAYER}! {PLAYER}! Did you introduce yourself to PROF. BIRCH? / Oh! What an adorable POKéMON! You got it from PROF. BIRCH. How nice! / You're your father's child, all right. You look good together with POKéMON! / Here, honey! If you're going out on an adventure, wear these RUNNING SHOES. / They'll put a zip in your step!$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_SwitchShoesWithRunningShoes
text: {PLAYER} switched shoes with the RUNNING SHOES.$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ExplainRunningShoes
text: MOM: {PLAYER}, those shoes came with instructions. / “Press the B Button while wearing these RUNNING SHOES to run extra-fast! / “Slip on these RUNNING SHOES and race in the great outdoors!”$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ComeHomeIfAnythingHappens
text: … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … / To think that you have your very own POKéMON now… Your father will be overjoyed. / He's at the GYM in PETALBURG CITY. Go west from OLDALE along ROUTE 102. / …But please be careful. If anything happens, you can come home. / Go on, go get them, honey!$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanUsePCToStoreItems
text: If you use a PC, you can store items and POKéMON. / The power of science is staggering!$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSpendsDaysInLab
text: PROF. BIRCH spends days in his LAB studying, then he'll suddenly go out in the wild to do more research… / When does PROF. BIRCH spend time at home?$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_IfYouGoInGrassPokemonWillJumpOut
text: Um, um, um! / If you go outside and go in the grass, wild POKéMON will jump out!$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_DangerousIfYouDontHavePokemon
text: It's dangerous if you don't have your own POKéMON.$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanYouGoSeeWhatsHappening
text: Um, hi! / There are scary POKéMON outside! I can hear their cries! / I want to go see what's going on, but I don't have any POKéMON… / Can you go see what's happening for me?$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_YouSavedBirch
text: You saved PROF. BIRCH! I'm so glad!$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_GoodLuckCatchingPokemon
text: Are you going to catch POKéMON? Good luck!$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_TownSign
text: LITTLEROOT TOWN “A town that can't be shaded any hue.”$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ProfBirchsLab
text: PROF. BIRCH'S POKéMON LAB$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_PlayersHouse
text: {PLAYER}'s HOUSE$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ProfBirchsHouse
text: PROF. BIRCH'S HOUSE$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSomethingToShowYouAtLab
text: PROF. BIRCH: Well, well, {PLAYER}{KUN}! That was good work out there! / I knew there was something special about you when I first saw you, but I never expected this. / Oh, yes. Do you still have the POKéDEX I gave you? / I have something to show you. Let's go to my LAB.$

label: OldaleTown_Text_OpeningBallSupplies
text: Your field supplies are topped up! Check your Bag or item PC. / Try more partners before your first battle with the PROF.'s kid.$

label: OldaleTown_Text_SavingMyProgress
text: I want to take a rest, so I'm saving my progress.$

label: OldaleTown_Text_IWorkAtPokemonMart
text: Hi! I work at a POKéMON MART. / Can I get you to come with me?$

label: OldaleTown_Text_ThisIsAPokemonMart
text: This is a POKéMON MART. Just look for our blue roof. / We sell a variety of goods including POKé BALLS for catching POKéMON. / Here, I'd like you to have this as a promotional item.$

label: OldaleTown_Text_PotionExplanation
text: A POTION can be used anytime, so it's even more useful than a POKéMON CENTER in certain situations.$

label: OldaleTown_Text_WaitDontComeInHere
text: Aaaaah! Wait! Please don't come in here. / I just discovered the footprints of a rare POKéMON! / Wait until I finish sketching them, okay?$

label: OldaleTown_Text_DiscoveredFootprints
text: I just discovered the footprints of a rare POKéMON! / Wait until I finish sketching them, okay?$

label: OldaleTown_Text_FinishedSketchingFootprints
text: I finished sketching the footprints of a rare POKéMON. / But it turns out they were only my own footprints…$

label: OldaleTown_Text_MayLetsGoBack
text: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Over here! Let's hurry home!$

label: OldaleTown_Text_BrendanLetsGoBack
text: BRENDAN: I'm heading back to my dad's LAB now. {PLAYER}, you should hustle back, too.$

label: OldaleTown_Text_TownSign
text: OLDALE TOWN “Where things start off scarce.”$

label: DewfordTown_Text_BrawlyInSlateport
text: Hey, Champ-to-be! / BRAWLY, the GYM LEADER here, went to SLATEPORT's OCEANIC MUSEUM. / Look for him in the queue outside. He needs a nudge to come home! / MR. BRINEY can sail you there once you deliver STEVEN's LETTER. / Find STEVEN in GRANITE CAVE, northwest of DEWFORD.$

label: DewfordTown_Text_TinyIslandCommunity
text: The meadow west of town reopened after the cave began shining. / An abandoned manor there holds DEVON's oldest records of MEGA EVOLUTION.$

label: DewfordTown_Text_TownSign
text: DEWFORD TOWN “A tiny island in the blue sea.”$

label: DewfordTown_Text_GymSign
text: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM LEADER: BRAWLY “A big wave in fighting!”$

label: DewfordTown_Text_HallSign
text: DEWFORD HALL “Everyone's information exchange!”$

label: Route104_Text_LandedInDewfordDeliverLetter
text: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! We've hit land in DEWFORD. / I suppose you're off to deliver that LETTER to, who was it now, STEVEN!$

label: DewfordTown_Text_SetSailBackToPetalburg
text: MR. BRINEY: Have you delivered your LETTER? / Or were you meaning to sail back to PETALBURG?$

label: DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSail2
text: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG it is, then! / Anchors aweigh! PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$

label: DewfordTown_Text_GoDeliverIllBeWaiting
text: MR. BRINEY: Look for GRANITE CAVE along ROUTE 106. That's where STEVEN went. / Take your time with the LETTER. PEEKO and I will keep an eye on the boat!$

label: DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInDewford
text: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! We've hit land in DEWFORD! / You just go on and tell me whenever you want to set sail again!$

label: DewfordTown_Text_WhereAreWeBound
text: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! The LETTER's delivered, and the sea's still calling us! / Now, my friend, where are we bound?$

label: DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSail
text: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG, is it? / Anchors aweigh! PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$

label: DewfordTown_Text_SlateportWereSettingSail
text: MR. BRINEY: SLATEPORT, is it? A fine harbor, and a busy one! / Anchors aweigh! PEEKO, we're off!$

label: DewfordTown_Text_JustTellMeWhenYouNeedToSetSail
text: MR. BRINEY: You just tell me whenever you need to set sail again!$

label: DewfordTown_Text_GettingItchToFish
text: This is a renowned fishing spot. Are you getting the itch to fish?$

label: DewfordTown_Text_GiveYouOneOfMyRods
text: I hear you, and I like what you're saying! / I'll give you one of my fishing RODS.$

label: DewfordTown_Text_ThrowInFishingAdvice
text: And, as an added bonus, I'll even throw in a little fishing advice! / First, you want to face the water, then use the ROD. / Focus your mind… If you get a bite, pull on the ROD. / Sometimes you can snag something immediately, but with bigger catches, you need to time the pulls on your ROD to haul them in.$

label: DewfordTown_Text_ThatsTooBadThen
text: Oh, is that so? That's too bad, then.$

label: DewfordTown_Text_HowsYourFishing
text: Yo! How's your fishing?$

label: DewfordTown_Text_GreatHaulInSomeBigOnes
text: Is that right! That's great! Haul in some big ones!$

label: DewfordTown_Text_FishingAdvice
text: Oh, hey, don't get down on yourself! I'll give you a little fishing advice. / First, you want to face the water, then use the ROD. / Focus your mind… If you get a bite, pull the ROD. / Sometimes you can snag something immediately, but with bigger catches, you need to time the pulls on your ROD to haul them in.$

label: DewfordTown_Text_XIsTheBiggestHappeningThingRight
text: I like what's hip, happening, and trendy. I'm always checking it out. / Listen, have you heard about this new “{STR_VAR_1}”? / That's right! Of course you know! / I mean, sheesh, “{STR_VAR_1}”… It's the hottest thing in cool! / Wherever you're from, “{STR_VAR_1}” is the biggest happening thing, right?$

label: DewfordTown_Text_TellMeWhatsNewAndIn
text: Hunh? It's not the hip and happening thing? / Well, hey, you have to tell me, what's new and what's “in”?$

label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
text: Hunh? “{STR_VAR_2}”? / … … / …Uh… Yeah! That's right! Yeah, I knew that! Knew it all along! / Of course I know about that! “{STR_VAR_2},” right? / Yeah, that's it, it's there! Isn't “{STR_VAR_2}” the coolest, or what? / It's the hippest thing in hip. You think I'd not know about it? / “{STR_VAR_1}”… It's, like, so five minutes ago. / Now, “{STR_VAR_2}” is what's vital and in tune with the times!$

label: DewfordTown_Text_XHuhIThinkYIsCool
text: Hmm… “{STR_VAR_2},” huh? / But personally, I think “{STR_VAR_1}” is what's real in cool.$

label: DewfordTown_Text_HearOfAnyTrendsComeShareWithMe
text: Well, if you hear of any happening new trends, come share them with me, okay?$

label: DewfordTown_Text_YeahDefinitionOfInRightNow
text: Yeah, absolutely right! / “{STR_VAR_1}” is the definition of “in” right now.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_MayNiceBadgesTakeThis
text: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Long time no see! / Oh? While I visited the hot springs, you got the LAVARIDGE GYM BADGE. / You must have collected good POKéMON… No, I believe you raised some. / I guess it would be okay for you to have this.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_GoGogglesSentToPC
text: Your KEY ITEMS pocket is full, so the GO-GOGGLES were sent to your PC.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_GoGogglesNoRoom
text: Your KEY ITEMS pocket and PC are full. Make room before taking the GO-GOGGLES.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_MayExplainGoGogglesChallengeDad
text: MAY: With those GO-GOGGLES, you'll have no trouble getting through the desert near ROUTE 111. / But, wow, {PLAYER}{KUN}… Challenging GYMS… / You're trying hard because you don't want to lose to me, I bet! / {PLAYER}{KUN}, I think I should challenge your dad in PETALBURG GYM. / See you again!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanNiceBadgesTakeThis
text: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, hey, it's been a while. How's it going? / Hmm… That's a decent collection of BADGES. / All right, then. You may as well have this.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanExplainGoGogglesChallengeDad
text: BRENDAN: Keep those with you if you're planning on going into that desert near ROUTE 111. / There should be some POKéMON that are exclusively desert-dwellers. You might look around for those. / As for me… I'm considering challenging NORMAN, the GYM LEADER of PETALBURG. / Unlike you, {PLAYER}, your dad looks like he really is tough. / See you around!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HaveEggWillYouTakeIt
text: I have here an EGG. / I'd hoped to hatch it by covering it in hot sand by the hot springs. But that doesn't seem to be enough… / I've heard it would be best if it were kept together with POKéMON and carried about. / You are a TRAINER, yes? And your POKéMON radiate vitality. / So, what say you? Will you take this EGG to hatch?$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HopeYoullWalkPlentyWithEgg
text: Good! I hope you'll walk plenty with this here EGG!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_ReceivedTheEgg
text: {PLAYER} received the EGG.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_NoRoomForThisEgg
text: Oh? You've too many POKéMON. There's no room for this EGG…$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_AsYouWishThen
text: As you wish, then… / If you have a change of heart about hatching this EGG, I will be here.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_EverySoOftenEggFoundAtDayCare
text: Every so often, an EGG will be found at the POKéMON DAY CARE. / Or at least that's how the rumor goes.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HotSpringsNeverRunDry
text: We draw as much hot water as we need, and yet the hot springs never run dry. / Isn't it magical? / These hot springs appear near active volcanoes. Veins of water under the ground are heated by magma to well up as hot springs.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_PokemonNippedBackside
text: Being buried in this hot sand is… Sigh… / So warm and heavenly… / Eh? Gyaah! Ouch! / A POKéMON nipped my backside!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_OhYouLikeHotSprings
text: Oh, you like hot springs, do you? / That's surprising for one as young as you.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BatheInHotSpringsEveryDay
text: I bathe in the hot springs every day. / I want to become a beautiful and strong GYM LEADER like FLANNERY.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_IfPokemonInHotSprings
text: If people put POKéMON in hot springs, it might be seriously strange. / Why, it might be an electric bath, or a bubble bath, or even a lava bath…$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HotSpringsClaims
text: They're claiming that these hot springs are good for calming nervous tension, relieving aching muscles, solving romantic problems, and attracting money…$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_TownSign
text: LAVARIDGE TOWN / “POKéMON CENTER HOT SPRINGS An excellent place for relaxing!”$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_GymSign
text: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM LEADER: FLANNERY “One with a fiery passion that burns!”$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HerbShopSign
text: POKéMON HERB SHOP “Bitter taste--better cure!”$

label: FallarborTown_Text_MayDisaster
text: MAY: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}! Help!$

label: FallarborTown_Text_BrendanComeHere
text: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}! Come here!$

label: FallarborTown_Text_MayWeirdos
text: MAY: PROF. COZMO was abducted by TEAM MAGMA! / I'm heading for METEOR FALLS now. Please catch up and help us!$

label: FallarborTown_Text_BrendanNuts
text: BRENDAN: PROF. COZMO was abducted by TEAM MAGMA! / I'm heading for METEOR FALLS now. Catch up as soon as you can!$

label: FallarborTown_Text_ShadyCharactersCozmosHome
text: Something's happening, and I don't like it! / I've seen shady characters wandering in and out of PROF. COZMO's home…$

label: FallarborTown_Text_RegionKnownForMeteors
text: This region's been known for meteors since the olden days. / They say METEOR FALLS was gouged out by a falling meteorite long ago.$

label: FallarborTown_Text_MyPreciousAzurill
text: See! Take a look! This is my precious AZURILL! / It's slick and smooth and plushy, too!$

label: FallarborTown_Text_Azurill
text: AZURILL: Rooreelooo.$

label: FallarborTown_Text_HaveYouChallengedFlannery
text: Have you already challenged FLANNERY, the LEADER of LAVARIDGE GYM? / The girl's grandfather was famous. He was one of the ELITE FOUR in the POKéMON LEAGUE at one point. / It wouldn't surprise me to see FLANNERY become a great TRAINER in her own right.$

label: FallarborTown_Text_BattleTentSign
text: BATTLE TENT FALLARBOR SITE “May the Greatest Teams Gather!”$

label: FallarborTown_Text_TownSign
text: FALLARBOR TOWN “A farm community with small gardens.”$

label: FallarborTown_Text_MoveTutorSign
text: HEART SCALE WORKSHOP “Scales polished into PP UPS.”$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManTryingToDigTunnel
text: My papa told me. / He says this tunnel is full of timid POKéMON. / They get all scared of loud noise and make a big uproar. / So they had to stop the big tunnel project. / But there's one man. He's trying to dig the tunnel by himself!$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManDugTunnelForLove
text: There was a man who dug a tunnel for a lady he loved. / I don't really get it, but hey!$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_AirCleanHere
text: The way the winds blow, volcanic ash is never blown in this direction. / The air is clean and delicious here. Living here should do wonders for even frail and sickly people.$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_MakeBattleTentDebut
text: My POKéMON and I, we've been riding a hot winning streak. / So I decided to make my BATTLE TENT debut in this town.$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_GuyTryingToBustThroughCave
text: Did you see the cave next to the POKéMON MART? / There's a guy in there who's trying to bust up boulders so he can bust out through to the other side. / It'd be great if we could go through… It'll make it easy to visit RUSTBORO.$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_EasyToGetToRustboroNow
text: That cave next to the POKéMON MART is now a tunnel to the other side. / It's great--it's easy to go shop for new DEVON products in RUSTBORO now.$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_TownSign
text: VERDANTURF TOWN / The windswept highlands where grass and people recover after every storm. / A restored meadow lies to the south.$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_WandasHouse
text: WANDA'S HOUSE$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_BattleTentSign
text: BATTLE TENT VERDANTURF SITE “Feast Your Eyes on Battles!”$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_RusturfTunnelSign
text: RUSTURF TUNNEL “Linking RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF / “The tunnel project has been canceled.”$

label: Route101_Text_RescueTryAgain
text: Your partners are safe. / Try again and help BIRCH?$

label: Route101_Text_PairUnavailable
text: There is no room for both partners. No new pair was given.$

label: Route101_Text_HelpMe
text: H-help me!$

label: Route101_Text_PleaseHelp
text: You there! Please help! / Two wild POKéMON are after me! Choose two POKéMON from my BAG!$

label: Route101_Text_DontLeaveMe
text: Wh-Where are you going?! Don't leave me like this!$

label: Route101_Text_YouSavedMe
text: PROF. BIRCH: Whew… / I was in the tall grass studying wild POKéMON when I was jumped. / You saved me. Thanks a lot! / Oh? / Hi, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}! / This is not the place to chat, so come by my POKéMON LAB later, okay?$

label: Route101_Text_TakeTiredPokemonToPokeCenter
text: If POKéMON get tired, take them to a POKéMON CENTER. / There's a POKéMON CENTER in OLDALE TOWN right close by.$

label: Route101_Text_WildPokemonInTallGrass
text: Wild POKéMON will jump out at you in tall grass. / If you want to catch POKéMON, you have to go into the tall grass and search.$

label: Route101_Text_RouteSign
text: ROUTE 101 {UP_ARROW} OLDALE TOWN$

label: Route103_Text_MayRoute103Pokemon
text: MAY: Let's see… The POKéMON found on ROUTE 103 include…$

label: Route103_Text_MayLetsBattle
text: MAY: I took the partner you left with Dad. PIKACHU and the rest of my team are ready too! / Bring the team you want. Ready for our DOUBLE BATTLE?$

label: Route103_Text_MayDefeated
text: Your team earned that win!$

label: Route103_Text_MayTimeToHeadBack
text: MAY: That was a serious battle! / Let's tell Dad how our teams did.$

label: Route103_Text_BrendanRoute103Pokemon
text: BRENDAN: Okay, so it's this one and that one that live on ROUTE 103…$

label: Route103_Text_BrendanLetsBattle
text: BRENDAN: I took the partner you left with Dad. PIKACHU and the rest of my team are ready too! / Bring the team you want. Ready for our DOUBLE BATTLE?$

text: BRENDAN: You earned that win! / Let's tell Dad how our teams did.$

text: Speak to Dad or his lab aide first. Your partners and field supplies are waiting for you there.$

label: Route103_Text_KeepPreparing
text: I'll be here when your team is ready.$

label: Route103_Text_ShouldHaveBroughtPotion
text: My POKéMON is staggeringly tired… I should have brought a POTION…$

label: Route103_Text_ShortcutToOldale
text: If you cross the sea from here, it'll be a shortcut to OLDALE TOWN. / Fufufu, that's useful, isn't it?$

label: Route103_Text_RouteSign
text: ROUTE 103 {DOWN_ARROW} OLDALE TOWN$

label: Route103_Text_ANDREW_LocalConversation
text: The fish are ignoring my bait. I may have offended the chef.$

label: Route103_Text_MARCOS_LocalConversation
text: I wrote a song about this river. It has a very strong current.$

label: Route103_Text_PETE_LocalConversation
text: Swimming is all about timing. So is remembering to breathe.$

label: Route103_Text_ISABELLE_LocalConversation
text: I found a shell for my collection. It objected and walked away.$

label: Route110_Text_WeCantTalkAboutAquaActivities
text: TEAM AQUA's activities… We can't talk about them yet.$

label: Route110_Text_KickUpARuckus
text: I want to get going to SLATEPORT and kick up a ruckus!$

label: Route110_Text_MyFirstJobInAqua
text: This is my first job after joining TEAM AQUA. It's a little scary.$

label: Route110_Text_AquaActionsBringSmiles
text: TEAM AQUA's actions should bring smiles to people's faces!$

label: Route110_Text_MayLetsBattle
text: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! I've been catching partners on every route since OLDALE. / Two of them cover each other in a way I want to test. Doubles, right now!$

label: Route110_Text_MayDefeated

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_SeriousLookingMachine
text: It's a serious-looking machine. The PROF must use this for research.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_PCUsedForResearch
text: It's a PC used for research. Better not mess around with it.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CrammedWithBooksOnPokemon
text: It's crammed with books on POKéMON.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BookTooHardToRead
text: It's a book that's too hard to read.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OtherRegionsUpgradeToNational
text: PROF. BIRCH: Now… / {PLAYER}{KUN} and {RIVAL}, I've had the two of you help me study POKéMON. / Your POKéDEX recorded every region from the day your journey began. / Now I can synchronize our final field notes and mark FRONTIER research. / Here, let me see your POKéDEX units.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayUpgradeSoCool
text: MAY: Eheheh! / It's so cool that our field notes are finally synchronized! / It's because you went out and caught so many POKéMON, {PLAYER}{KUN}!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanYouCanThankMe
text: BRENDAN: I went out all over HOENN and checked out POKéMON. / You can thank me for the final research notes. / Yep, you're lucky, {PLAYER}!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OkayAllDone
text: PROF. BIRCH: Okay, all done!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_PokedexUpgradedToNational
text: {PLAYER}'s POKéDEX synchronized the CHAMPION research notes!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_GrassyPatchWaiting2
text: PROF. BIRCH: But listen. You've become the CHAMPION, but your POKéMON journey isn't over. / There is no end to the road that is POKéMON. / Somewhere, there is a grassy patch that's waiting for you!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayTakeBreakFromFieldwork
text: MAY: I think I'll take a short break from fieldwork. / I think I'll help the PROF here for a while.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanTakeBreakFromFieldwork
text: BRENDAN: For the time being, I'm taking a break from fieldwork. / I'll be helping out the PROF here for a while.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CompletedDexResearchReward
text: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Let's have a look at your POKéDEX. / … … … … … … … … … … … … / Every known HOENN species. Wonderful! You proved how each habitat connects. / DEVON helped me restore five tools from our LEGENDARY FORM research. / They let certain rare POKéMON change or combine outside battle. Take them!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ResearchRewardWaiting
text: PROF. BIRCH: Your LEGENDARY FORM tools are still here. Let's finish the set.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ResearchRewardComplete
text: Those tools affect KYUREM, ZYGARDE, NECROZMA, and CALYREX. / The POKéMON must still choose you. The tools only reveal forms they can take.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ResearchRewardBagFull
text: Your KEY ITEMS pocket is full. Make room and return; every remaining tool is safe.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayWhatNextImStayingHere
text: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}, after this… What are you going to do? / Are you going to keep battling and sharpening your skills? / Or are you going to try filling the NATIONAL POKéDEX? / I'm staying here to help the PROF.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanPreferCollectingSlowly
text: BRENDAN: Rather than collecting POKéMON, I prefer slowly and  steadily raising the one I chose.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayHaveYouGoneToBattleFrontier
text: MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Have you gone to that place, the BATTLE FRONTIER?$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanHaveYouGoneToBattleFrontier
text: BRENDAN: Hey, {PLAYER}! Have you gone out to that place, the BATTLE FRONTIER?$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ScottAboardSSTidalCall
text: … … … … … … … … … … … Beep! / SCOTT: Hi, hi, {PLAYER}! It's me, SCOTT. / I'm aboard the S.S. TIDAL now. It feels great to be on the sea! / By the way… / There's this place that I'd like to invite you to for a visit. / If you're interested, board a ferry at either SLATEPORT or LILYCOVE. / I'll fill you in on the details when we meet. I'll be waiting! / … … … … … … … … … … … Click!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_YourTwoPartners
text: You and both POKéMON saved me. / I would like {STR_VAR_1} and {STR_VAR_2} to stay with you.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_NameOpeningPartner
text: Would you like to nickname {STR_VAR_1}?$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OpeningDex
text: Take this POKéDEX. There are many more partners waiting out there!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OpeningBalls
text: You received 20 POKé BALLS!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OpeningBallsInPC
text: Your 20 POKé BALLS were sent to the item PC.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OpeningReady
text: Oldale's Center can prepare any team you want, all for free. / Catch more partners, try your ideas, then meet {RIVAL} on ROUTE 103.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OpeningSuppliesFull
text: Your field supplies are waiting. / Make room in your Bag or item PC, then speak to me or the aide.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OpeningDebrief
text: Welcome back! I am glad you both gave that battle everything. / Keep finding partners and making the team your own!$

label: OldaleTown_House1_Text_LeftPokemonGoesOutFirst
