text: In a DOUBLE BATTLE, your first two Pokémon able to battle form your opening pair. / Change their party order before you challenge a Trainer. Those two partners set the opening.$

label: OldaleTown_House2_Text_PokemonLevelUp
text: POKéMON grow from battles, but you never need to grind. / A POKéMON CENTER LEVELER trains your whole party to the current limit.$

label: OldaleTown_House2_Text_YoullGoFurtherWithStrongPokemon
text: Raw levels alone won't take you far. / Build different partners for different battles, then change plans when needed.$

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TrainersCanUsePC
text: That PC in the corner there is for any POKéMON TRAINER to use. / Naturally, that means you're welcome to use it, too.$

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokemonCentersAreGreat
text: POKéMON CENTERS are great! / You can use their services as much as you like, and it's all for free. You never have to worry!$

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WirelessClubNotAvailable
text: The POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB on the second floor was built recently. / But they say they're still making adjustments.$

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedInWirelessClub
text: The POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB on the second floor was built recently. / I traded POKéMON right away.$

label: OldaleTown_Mart_Text_PokeBallsAreSoldOut
text: The clerk says they're all sold out. I can't buy any POKé BALLS.$

label: OldaleTown_Mart_Text_ImGoingToBuyPokeBalls
text: I'm going to buy a bunch of POKé BALLS and catch a bunch of POKéMON!$

label: OldaleTown_Mart_Text_RestoreHPWithPotion
text: If a POKéMON gets hurt and loses its HP and faints, it won't be able to battle. / To prevent your POKéMON from fainting, restore its HP with a POTION.$

label: DewfordTown_House1_Text_LotToBeSaidForLivingOnIsland
text: There's a lot to be said for living on a small island like this in harmony with POKéMON and the family.$

label: DewfordTown_House1_Text_LifeGoesSlowlyOnIsland
text: I left the major port of SLATEPORT CITY when I married my husband here. / Life goes by slowly on this little island. But being surrounded by the beautiful sea--that's happiness, too.$

label: DewfordTown_House1_Text_Zigzagoon
text: ZIGZAGOON: Guguuh!$

label: DewfordTown_House1_EventScript_MegaGift_BARBARACITE_Text
text: I found this in a tide pool, held tight between two little claws. / A Binacle has a stubborn grip. Its grown form can use this stone.$

label: DewfordTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_StoneCavern
text: There's a stone cavern at the edge of town. / I've heard you can find rare stones there.$

label: DewfordTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FaintedMonCanUseHM
text: Even if a POKéMON faints and can't battle, it can still use a move learned from a HIDDEN MACHINE (HM).$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
text: BRAWLY brings a powerful Fighting team, but his partners do more than attack. / PACHIRISU draws single-target moves aside. His fighters use speed, priority and support to create openings. / Normal Pokémon risk Fighting damage, but a useful support role can still earn a place on your team. / The GYM grows brighter as you defeat its trainers. Make every action count!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
text: Whoah! It's turned too bright in here! / Your future is bright, too!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoIntro
text: GRAPPLOCT can hold a target in place. WOBBUFFET makes switching difficult too. / Let us see how you handle the pressure!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoDefeat
text: You won a tough battle!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoPostBattle
text: HITMONLEE's WHITE HERB can clear its stat drops and activate UNBURDEN. / Speed can change in the middle of a turn. Watch the whole board.$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynIntro
text: TAILWIND can change the race in an instant. / Four turns of pressure. Can your team handle them?$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynDefeat
text: You took this battle!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynPostBattle
text: TAILWIND lasts four turns. BRELOOM's POISON HEAL can keep it going while the field changes. / Plan for the partners still in reserve.$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraIntro
text: FAKE OUT steals the first turn, and GUTS makes my own burn a weapon. / Can you afford to blink?$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraDefeat
text: That was a hard-fought win!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraPostBattle
text: Blank FAKE OUT, pressure the Flame Orb, and never switch on instinct alone.$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithIntro
text: INTIMIDATE softens you, then SCRAGGY dances into the space it made. / We build on every opening!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithDefeat
text: You brought a winning team!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithPostBattle
text: A paired battle is two complete teams, not one trick repeated twice.$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenIntro
text: MACHOP's NO GUARD beats accuracy tricks. SAWK has MOLD BREAKER. / There is no safe angle here!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenDefeat
text: We gave it everything!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenPostBattle
text: Do not let one physical wall become your answer to an entire FIGHTING school.$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianIntro
text: FALINKS strikes its own partner, and JUSTIFIED turns the blow into power. / Hurt us and we sharpen!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianDefeat
text: Our formation could not hold!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianPostBattle
text: FALINKS can power up JUSTIFIED before its partner attacks. / GALLADE and LUCARIO can both use that opening. Always check who is active.$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyIntro
text: Back from SLATEPORT? Right on! / I'm BRAWLY, DEWFORD's GYM LEADER! / My team draws attacks aside, then uses the space to set up. / Don't give us time to build momentum. Once we're rolling, we're hard to stop!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyDefeat
text: Whoa! You knocked me off balance! / Take the KNUCKLE BADGE. You earned it!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ReceivedKnuckleBadge
text: {PLAYER} received the KNUCKLE BADGE from BRAWLY.$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_KnuckleBadgeInfoTakeThis
text: The KNUCKLE BADGE lets your LEVELER train a party up to Lv. 30. / It also enables the hidden move FLASH outside of battle. / Take this rare MEGA STONE, too.$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ExplainLucarionite
text: Lucarionite lets Lucario Mega Evolve. You'll soon receive the Ring it needs.$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_RegisteredBrawly
text: Registered GYM LEADER BRAWLY in the POKéNAV.$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPostBattle
text: Return to STEVEN in GRANITE CAVE, northwest of town, for your MEGA RING. / Your new BADGE lets you use FLASH to light the way inside.$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
text: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM / BRAWLY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPreRematch
text: BRAWLY: A wave may draw back, but it always returns to the shore. / A giant wave of a talent like you… I knew you would return! / Show me how much higher you've gone!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchDefeat
text: Wow! Swamped again!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPostRematch
text: BRAWLY: Battling is vast and it's deep. You can't see the bottom. It's just like the sea of HOENN!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchNeedTwoMons
text: BRAWLY: A wave may draw back, but it always returns to the shore. / A giant wave of a talent like you… I knew you would return! / Oh? You only have one POKéMON that can battle. / I'm sorry, but I'd like you to come back with at least two POKéMON.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TradeTropius
text: My {STR_VAR_2} longs for a new route. / Trade your {STR_VAR_1} for my {STR_VAR_2}?$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TradeComplete
text: A fair trade! Give {STR_VAR_2} room to spread those broad leaves.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TradeDeclined
text: No pressure. Good trades should feel right to both TRAINERS.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_NeedRequestedMon
text: That isn't a {STR_VAR_1}. I promised my partner an even exchange.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TropiusDoingWell
text: How is TROPIUS? DEWFORD's sea breeze never quite suited those leaves.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_CantImagineLifeWithoutTrend
text: What's in vogue? Why, it has to be “{STR_VAR_1}”! / I can't imagine what life would be like without “{STR_VAR_1}”!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_GettingBoredOfTrend
text: What's in vogue? Why, it has to be “{STR_VAR_1}”! / But I'm getting kind of bored with it. / I should look for the next big thing.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TeachingMonAboutTrend
text: I'm teaching my POKéMON about “{STR_VAR_1},” but it's not going well. / It's a bit too much, I think.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_DeepLinkBetweenXAndY
text: I'm studying up on the hip and trendy “{STR_VAR_1}” now. / Is it true that there's a deep link between “{STR_VAR_1}” and “{STR_VAR_2}”?$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_MyHunchWasRight
text: Oh! So, my hunch was right! / I'm one step closer to being hip and happening, yowza!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_NotEasyToKeepUp
text: What?! Is that so?! / It's not easy for an older fellow like me to keep up with trends!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TVShowAboutTrend
text: This whole business about “{STR_VAR_1}”… Isn't there a TV show on it?$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_IsTrendMorePopularAcrossSea
text: Across the sea… / Is “{STR_VAR_1}” even more popular?$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_CollectTrendMerchandise
text: I collect official “{STR_VAR_1}” licensed merchandise. / I have official “{STR_VAR_1}” DOLLS… / Official “{STR_VAR_1}” brand clothing… / And officially licensed “{STR_VAR_1}” picture books. / Heheh, I own! I'm not sharing anything with you!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_BooksAboutTrend
text: IDENTIFYING GOOD “{STR_VAR_1}” & BAD “{STR_VAR_1}”… / THE LINK BETWEEN “{STR_VAR_1}” AND POKéMON… / USEFUL “{STR_VAR_1}”… / It's neatly jammed with books about “{STR_VAR_1}.”$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendsScream
text: “{STR_VAR_1}'S SCREAM” is the title.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendsSmile
text: “{STR_VAR_1}'S SMILE” is the title.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_LastTrend
text: It's titled “THE LAST {STR_VAR_1}”.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_BirthOfTrend
text: It's titled “THE BIRTH OF {STR_VAR_1}”.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_SawTrendCoolestThing
text: I saw “{STR_VAR_1}”! Cool, huh? / It's, like, the coolest thing going! / It was awesome! It was the real thing, oh yeah!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_AllegedTrendNotAuthentic
text: Oh, no, no, no. / That alleged “{STR_VAR_1}” you claim to have seen--it's not. / The authentic article is much… How should I say it? Sharper, yet more mellow! / Ah, no matter. It's astonishing!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_ComposedTrendThemeSong
text: Hey, listen, I composed a theme song for “{STR_VAR_1}.” / “{STR_VAR_1}” is really popular right now. / Okay, listen! … … / Oh! {STR_VAR_1}! / Wonderful {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_WorkOnYourSinging
text: … … / I dare say, chap, it would pay for you to work on your singing before you trifle yourself with “{STR_VAR_1}.”$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_OrganizeTrendParty
text: Anyway, as I was saying earlier, we should get together and organize a “{STR_VAR_1}” party on the island.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_BrilliantIndeed
text: Oh, a smashing good idea! / It will settle once and for all who is the best at “{STR_VAR_1}.” Brilliant, indeed! / Starting today, our lives will revolve around “{STR_VAR_1}”!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendHasBecomePartOfLife
text: I was thinking, though… / Wouldn't you agree that “{STR_VAR_1}” has grown from being something trendy to being a part of our daily lives?$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendWeighsHeavilyOnMind
text: Beg pardon? That much, what? / However, it's true that “{STR_VAR_1}” weighs heavily on your mind, whether you're awake or asleep. / Absolutely, you're the “{STR_VAR_1}” PROFESSOR, old sport!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_IfWeTeamUpWellBeInvincible
text: If you and me team up as a combo, we'll be invincible when it comes to all things “{STR_VAR_1}”!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_WellBeTrendDuo
text: Spot on, my friend! / We shall be the “{STR_VAR_1}” DUO! / Isn't that a ripe image? Hahahah!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_GiveYouDeepSeaScale
text: The Deep Sea Scale is trending! / It evolves Clamperl into Gorebyss.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_ScaleAndTrend
text: That DEEP SEA SCALE evolves CLAMPERL into GOREBYSS. / The trendy move “{STR_VAR_1}” is making waves, too.$

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_WantYouToHaveReaperCloth
text: Gorge your eyes on this rare REAPER CLOTH! Spooky, yet stylish! / You appreciate my dazzling taste. Here, I want you to have it!$

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_NoRoom
text: Oh, you don't have room? / This REAPER CLOTH is rare! Make room and come back for it.$

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_ExplainReaperCloth
text: A Reaper Cloth evolves Dusclops. Use it from the Bag when ready.$

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_BrawlySoCool
text: Wow, you bothered to cross the sea to visit DEWFORD? / Did you maybe come here because you heard about BRAWLY? / He's so cool… Everyone idolizes him.$

label: DewfordTown_House2_EventScript_MegaGift_KINGLERITE_Text
text: I followed a Krabby along the shore and found this where it was digging. / When its claw is big and strong, this stone could make it stronger!$

label: DewfordTown_House2_EventScript_MegaGift_GYARADOSITE_Text
text: The fish you overlook today might carry you through a storm tomorrow. / Raise a Magikarp with care. This stone is for its grown form.$

label: LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_WelcomeToHerbShop
text: Welcome to the HERB SHOP, home of effective and inexpensive medicine!$

label: LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_YouveComeToLookAtHerbalMedicine
text: You've come to look at herbal medicine in LAVARIDGE? / That's rather commendable. / I like you! Take this!$

label: LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_ExplainFireStone
text: A Fire Stone evolves certain Pokémon. Use it from the Bag when ready.$

label: LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_HerbalMedicineWorksButMonWillDislike
text: Herbal medicine works impressively well. But your POKéMON will dislike you for it. It must be horribly bitter!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice
text: FLANNERY's sun strengthens Fire attacks and weakens Water attacks. / LILLIGANT can use AFTER YOU to let slow TORKOAL attack sooner. / Weather control, disruption and careful damage all offer different ways to challenge that partnership.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
text: Yow! That was a scorching-hot battle!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ColeIntro
text: Owowowowow! Yikes, it's hot! / Contact can burn more than pride!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ColeDefeat
text: I'm blinded by sweat in my eyes…$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ColePostBattle
text: Being buried in hot sand promotes circulation. / It's effective for healing pain in your joints.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxleIntro
text: I'm trying to relieve my stress. Don't come along and stress me out! / ARMAROUGE's WEAKNESS POLICY can turn a weakness into power!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxleDefeat
text: I hope FLANNERY flames you good!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxlePostBattle
text: Haaah… Whew… / If you spend too much time buried in hot sand, it tuckers you out…$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_KeeganIntro
text: You must be getting tired by now. You'd like to rest in the hot sand, wouldn't you? / But you should know that maintaining your willpower is an important ability for all TRAINERS. / My own poison is my fuel!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_KeeganDefeat
text: Play with fire, and be burned…$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_KeeganPostBattle
text: Your skill is real… But our LEADER FLANNERY is strong. / If you don't watch yourself, you'll be burned seriously.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GeraldIntro
text: Can your POKéMON handle the heat of this team? / SUNNY DAY first. Then we run!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GeraldDefeat
text: It didn't burn hotly enough…$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GeraldPostBattle
text: Sun helps my Grass Pokémon move faster. / Even here, a Fire team needs its partners!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_DanielleIntro
text: Um… Okay, I'll battle with you. / Dance, and ORICORIO dances too!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_DanielleDefeat
text: Oh, but you're too strong.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_DaniellePostBattle
text: I'm going to be a pretty and strong TRAINER just like FLANNERY.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JaceIntro
text: Come on, get with it! Let's go before my feelings cool! / SALAZZLE's TOXIC can poison STEEL!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JaceDefeat
text: It's so hot, and yet my heart is clutched by ice…$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JacePostBattle
text: The way the battling spirit burns within you, you may stand a chance against our LEADER.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JeffIntro
text: See how the flames blaze wildly? They flare in anticipation of my win! / At full health, TALONFLAME's Flying moves gain priority!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JeffDefeat
text: Something didn't go right.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JeffPostBattle
text: Well, so what? I say so what? I can walk on hot coals barefoot! / …Don't even think about trying it!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_EliIntro
text: As much as I love mountains, I especially love volcanoes. / CLAYDOL avoids Ground attacks. BRONZONG can take the heat!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_EliDefeat
text: Well, it seems my team has met its match!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_EliPostBattle
text: I stay here because I became a fan of FLANNERY's power. / Hehehehe.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryIntro
text: I am FLANNERY, LAVARIDGE's GYM LEADER! / MT. CHIMNEY taught me that power needs timing. / LILLIGANT and TORKOAL are ready to turn up the heat. Show us your best!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryDefeat
text: That was a blazing battle! / You beat the team I put my heart into. Take the HEAT BADGE!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ReceivedHeatBadge
text: {PLAYER} received the HEAT BADGE from FLANNERY.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainHeatBadgeTakeThis
text: The HEAT BADGE lets your LEVELER train a party up to Lv. 45. / It also enables STRENGTH outside of battle. / This is a token of my appreciation. Don't be shy about taking it!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainCameruptite
text: Cameruptite lets Camerupt Mega Evolve. Let it hold the stone in battle.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_RegisteredFlannery
text: Registered GYM LEADER FLANNERY in the POKéNAV.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPostBattle
text: Four BADGES! NORMAN is ready for your challenge in PETALBURG CITY. / Head back through MAUVILLE, then west through RUSTURF TUNNEL. / From RUSTBORO, follow the woods south to PETALBURG and its GYM. / EMBER PATH is also open now. Explore it when you can move boulders.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatue
text: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatueCertified
text: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM / FLANNERY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPreRematch
text: FLANNERY: Losing a battle isn't going to deflate me. / I love POKéMON. I love to battle. And… I love this GYM! / Let's exchange superhot moves in another battle!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryRematchDefeat
text: Whew! On the verge of eruption!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPostRematch
text: FLANNERY: I lost the match, but I'm completely satisfied. / It's not often I get to enjoy a battle this heated. / Let's have another one like this again sometime!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryRematchNeedTwoMons
text: FLANNERY: Losing a battle isn't going to deflate me. / I love POKéMON. I love to battle. And… I love this GYM! / Let's exchange superhot moves in another battle! / Oh, wait. Do you only have one POKéMON that can battle? / I hate to say this, but when you come see me, bring at least two POKéMON.$

label: LavaridgeTown_House_Text_WifeWarmingEggInHotSprings
text: My wife's warming an EGG in the hot springs. This is what she told me. / She left two POKéMON with the DAY CARE. And they discovered that EGG!$

label: LavaridgeTown_House_Text_Zigzagoon
text: ZIGZAGOON: Pshoo!$

label: LavaridgeTown_House_EventScript_MegaGift_BLAZIKENITE_Text
text: I learned footwork by watching Blaziken train on the hot rocks. / A flame needs room to grow. Take this stone on your journey.$

label: LavaridgeTown_House_EventScript_MegaGift_MACHAMPITE_Text
text: Machamp carried the stones that built some of these old baths. / This one is small enough to carry yourself. Let a Machamp hold it.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Mart_Text_PrepareBeforeTrainerBattles
text: TRAINER battles don't allow items from the BAG. / Prepare your moves and held items before the battle begins!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Mart_Text_LocalSpecialtyOnMtChimney
text: On MT. CHIMNEY's peak, there's a local specialty sold beside the crater. / Give it to a POKéMON--it will be elated.$

label: LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LucyChallenge
text: Scott said a serious Trainer would come through these springs. / I am Lucy. I stack the odds until they obey. Show me your answer.$

label: LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LucyDefeat
text: So… You made your own luck.$

label: LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LucyReward
text: That ABSOLITE belongs with someone who can force the right outcome. / The BATTLE FRONTIER awaits.$

label: LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TrainersPokemonSpendTimeTogether
text: I think POKéMON get closer to their TRAINERS if they spend time together. / The longer the better. That's what I think.$

label: LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HotSpringCanInvigorate
text: It's sort of magical how just sitting in a hot-spring pool can invigorate. / I wish I could let my POKéMON soak, too.$

label: LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TrainersShouldRestToo
text: Hohoho! Hey, kid, you can reach the hot springs from here. / If POKéMON are getting rest, so too should their TRAINERS.$

label: LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MoomooMilkWelcome
text: Moomoo Milk is perfect before or after the hot spring. How many would you like?$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
text: You're… Ah, you must be {PLAYER}{KUN}, right? / Thank you for playing with WALLY a little while ago. / He's been frail and sickly ever since he was a baby. / We've sent him to stay with my relatives in VERDANTURF TOWN for a while. / The air is a lot cleaner there than it is here. / What's that? Where's WALLY? He's already left, our WALLY. / I wonder where he could have gotten by now?$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WonderHowWallyIsDoing
text: I wonder how our WALLY is doing?$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
text: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Please excuse us for dragging you here this way. / But our WALLY's become very healthy since he went to VERDANTURF TOWN. / We owe it all to you! / When WALLY left town, you helped him catch a POKéMON, right? / I think that made WALLY really happy. / Actually, not just WALLY. It made me, his father, happy too. / Happy that he's gained such a great friend as you. / This isn't a bribe or anything, but I'd really like you to have this.$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_SurfGoAllSortsOfPlaces
text: A partner that can SURF will carry you across water. Head to MAUVILLE. / Go east onto ROUTE 118 and cross its river, then take ROUTE 119 north. / Beyond the WEATHER INSTITUTE lies FORTREE CITY and WINONA's GYM.$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyIsComingHomeSoon
text: WALLY's coming home soon. I'm looking forward to that.$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_YouMetWallyInEverGrandeCity
text: Oh? You met WALLY in EVER GRANDE CITY? / Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}, don't be silly. / He may have gotten healthy, but he can't go somewhere far away like that all by himself.$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyWasReallyHappy
text: WALLY was really happy when he told us that he caught a POKéMON. / It's been ages since I've seen him smile like that.$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyLeftWithoutTelling
text: I want you to keep this a secret from my husband… / But our WALLY left VERDANTURF TOWN without telling anyone. / You know, WALLY is frail, but he's surprisingly strong-willed. / I'm sure that he'll come back safe and sound one day!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadYoureHereWithYourPokemon
text: DAD: Hm? / Well, if it isn't {PLAYER}! So you're all finished moving in? / I'm surprised that you managed to get here by yourself. / Oh, I see. You're with your POKéMON. / Hm… Then I guess you're going to become a TRAINER like me, {PLAYER}. / That's great news! I'll be looking forward to it!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyIdLikeAPokemon
text: Um… I… I'd like to get a POKéMON, please…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadOhYoureWallyRight
text: DAD: Hm? You're… Uh… Oh, right. You're WALLY, right?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyIveNeverCaughtAPokemon
text: WALLY: I'm going to go stay with my relatives in VERDANTURF TOWN. / I thought I would be lonely by myself, so I wanted to take a POKéMON along. / But I've never caught a POKéMON before. I don't know how…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadHmISee
text: DAD: Hm. I see.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadPlayerGoWithWally
text: DAD: {PLAYER}, you heard that, right? / Go with WALLY and make sure that he safely catches a POKéMON.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_IllLoanYouMyZigzagoon
text: WALLY, here, I'll loan you my POKéMON. / WALLY received a ZIGZAGOON!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouAndDadGivesPokeBall
text: WALLY: Oh, wow! A POKéMON! / DAD: Hm. I'll give you a POKé BALL, too. Go for it! / WALLY received a POKé BALL!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyOhWowThankYou
text: WALLY: Oh, wow! Thank you!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WouldYouReallyComeWithMe
text: {PLAYER}… Would you really come with me?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadSoDidItWorkOut
text: DAD: So, did it work out?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouBye
text: WALLY: Thank you, yes, it did. Here's your POKéMON back. / {PLAYER}, thank you for coming along with me. / You two are why I was able to catch my POKéMON. / I promise I'll take really good care of it. / Oh! My mom's waiting for me, so I have to go! / Bye, {PLAYER}!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoCollectBadges
text: DAD: Now… / {PLAYER}, if you want to become a strong TRAINER, here's my advice. / Head west to ROUTE 104, then north through PETALBURG WOODS to RUSTBORO. / There, you should challenge the GYM LEADER, ROXANNE. / After her, go on to other POKéMON GYMS and defeat their LEADERS. / Collect BADGES from them, understood? / Of course, I'm a GYM LEADER, too. We'll battle one day, {PLAYER}. / But that's only after you become stronger.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanGoToRustboro
text: DAD: Hm? Aren't you going to the POKéMON GYM in RUSTBORO CITY? / Follow ROUTE 104 west of town, then head north through PETALBURG WOODS. / There's no challenge for me to battle a greenhorn TRAINER. / {PLAYER}, I want you to challenge me when you become a lot stronger. / I'll battle you, {PLAYER}, when you can show me four GYM BADGES, okay?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanGoToDewford
text: DAD: I see… So, you've beaten the GYM LEADER in RUSTBORO CITY. / But there are many more TRAINERS who are stronger than you, {PLAYER}. / Across the sea in DEWFORD TOWN is a GYM LEADER named BRAWLY. / You should go challenge him.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_YouHaveGottenStronger
text: DAD: Hm… {PLAYER}, you have gotten stronger. / I can tell by the number of BADGES that you've earned.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NextGymMauville
text: WATTSON runs MAUVILLE GYM. From SLATEPORT, follow ROUTE 110 north. / Keep going. Bring back four BADGES, and we'll see how far you've come.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NextGymLavaridge
text: FLANNERY runs LAVARIDGE GYM, below MT. CHIMNEY. Travel north of MAUVILLE. / The cable car is on ROUTE 112. From the summit, JAGGED PASS leads down. / Earn that fourth BADGE, then come home. I'll be waiting here at the GYM.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanIntro
text: DAD: Four BADGES brought you back, but this battle is not about raw growth. / Every member of my team reveals a rule: a lock, an Ability, an item, or a clock. / Read each one before you commit. I will battle as GYM LEADER, not as your father.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanDefeat
text: You beat the team I've raised with so much care. / I'm proud of you. Take the BALANCE BADGE.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedBalanceBadge
text: {PLAYER} received the BALANCE BADGE from DAD!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainBalanceBadgeTakeThis
text: DAD: The BALANCE BADGE lets your LEVELER train a party up to Lv. 55. / It also lets POKéMON use SURF to travel over water. / This is my gift to you. {PLAYER}, I'm sure you can use it correctly.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainLopunnite
text: Dad: Lopunnite lets Lopunny Mega Evolve. Let it hold the stone in battle.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadHappyAndSad
text: DAD: As a LEADER, I learned from you. As your father, I'm simply proud.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_PleaseComeWithMe
text: Ah, there you are, {PLAYER}{KUN}! / Please come with me. I have something I want you to have.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_LetMeBorrowPlayer
text: NORMAN, you don't mind, do you? / Let me borrow your {PLAYER}{KUN} for a minute or two.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoingToKeepTraining
text: DAD: {PLAYER}, you should go visit your mother every so often. / I'm going to stay here and redouble my training. / It would bother me as a TRAINER to not avenge my loss to you, {PLAYER}!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadNoAmountOfTrainingIsEnough
text: DAD: {PLAYER}, how are things going? / The world of POKéMON is deep. / I honestly think that no amount of training would ever be enough.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
text: Welcome, CHAMPION-bound {PLAYER}! / Defeat the Trainers in a room to open its onward doors. / The left door leads to the MULTIHIT ROOM. The right leads to the RETALIATION ROOM. / Each room's sign names its plan. Choose your route and prepare your partners together.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
text: {PLAYER}! Whoa! You've overcome even your own father! / Like, whoa! What a stunning turn of events!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallIntro
text: This is the MULTIHIT ROOM. / One attack can strike again and again. A FOCUS SASH may not be enough!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallDefeat
text: That was a magnificent battle!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBattle
text: Another challenge waits ahead. / The left door leads to the TRICK ROOM; the right leads to the STATUS ROOM.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBadge
text: Whomever you beat, and whomever you may lose to, you never shirk from training yourself and your POKéMON. / That's what I think being a GYM LEADER is all about.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerIntro
text: Welcome to the TRICK ROOM. / LICKILICKY shakes the ground. ORANGURU tells it to do it again. / TELEPATHY keeps my partner safe. What will keep yours safe?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerDefeat
text: Our timing was not enough. Good battle!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerPostBattle
text: WIDE GUARD can stop both EARTHQUAKES. But we have single-target moves, too. / The POWER ROOM is next. Be ready!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerPostBadge
text: After you beat our LEADER, the training has become a lot tougher.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgeIntro
text: This is the ENDURANCE ROOM. / Healing buys time. DUBWOOL can turn that time into BODY PRESS power. / Can your team finish the job?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgeDefeat
text: We could not outlast your team!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBattle
text: That was well played. / The next door leads to the BURST ROOM. Be ready for its concentrated pressure.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBadge
text: I'm going to keep training at GYMS. One day, I'll become a LEADER.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkeIntro
text: This is the BURST ROOM. / EXPLOUD's voice can hit Ghosts. MEGA GLALIE turns Normal attacks into Ice. / Prepare for both sides of the board!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkeDefeat
text: Your team took the battle!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkePostBattle
text: A strong pair can attack through different defenses. / The last reserves still matter: STOUTLAND and KANGASKHAN keep the pressure on.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkePostBadge
text: Since your dad became the LEADER, the TRAINERS of PETALBURG CITY have become a lot tougher.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryIntro
text: This is the RETALIATION ROOM. / DRAMPA can gain power after a hard hit. RUFFLET's HUSTLE trades accuracy for strength. / Every risk needs a purpose!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryDefeat
text: You were a cut above me…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBattle
text: More formidable teams await. / The left door leads to the STATUS ROOM; the right leads to the ENDURANCE ROOM.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBadge
text: Do you know what we're trying to achieve as TRAINERS? / We're striving to become soul mates with our POKéMON.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaIntro
text: This is the STATUS ROOM. / ZANGOOSE and URSARING make their own status a weapon. / Bring a plan for the whole team!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaDefeat
text: Our defenses weren't enough…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBattle
text: You've given me something to think about. / The left door leads to the POWER ROOM; the right leads to the BURST ROOM.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBadge
text: Hi! Have you tried using SURF?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyIntro
text: This is the POWER ROOM. / Our LEADER told us to give you everything we have, even if you are his kid. / That is exactly what we will do!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyDefeat
text: But… I went all out!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBattle
text: The way you use your POKéMON… It's like your father's style. / Go on through! The GYM LEADER, your father, is waiting!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBadge
text: Sure, it's fine to make your POKéMON stronger. / But what decides the winner? / Why, it's the feelings TRAINERS have for their POKéMON.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DoorAppearsLocked
text: This door appears to be locked right now…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterSpeedRoom
text: “MULTIHIT ROOM”, the sign says. / Do you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DoorAppearsLocked2
text: This door appears to be locked right now…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterAccuracyRoom
text: “RETALIATION ROOM”, the sign says. / Do you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterConfusionRoom
text: “TRICK ROOM”, the sign says. / Do you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterDefenseRoom
text: “STATUS ROOM”, the sign says. / Do you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterRecoveryRoom
text: “ENDURANCE ROOM”, the sign says. / Do you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterStrengthRoom
text: “POWER ROOM”, the sign says. / Do you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterOHKORoom
text: “BURST ROOM”, the sign says. / Do you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterGymLeadersRoom
text: “GYM LEADER'S ROOM / “See for yourself what POKéMON await you!” the sign says. / Do you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
text: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM / NORMAN'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}$

label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_TravelingIsWonderful
text: Traveling is wonderful! / When I was young, I roamed the seas and the mountains!$

label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_GoOnAdventure
text: Sigh… / I wish I could go on an adventure with some POKéMON… / Crawl through some damp grass… Climb rocky, rugged mountains… / Cross the raging seas… Wander about in dark caves… / And, sometimes, even get a little homesick… / It must be fabulous to travel!$

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_NormanBecameGymLeader
text: NORMAN became our town's new GYM LEADER. / I think he called his family over from somewhere far away.$

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_BattledNormanOnce
text: I battled NORMAN once, but, whew, he was way too strong. / How would I put it? / I just got the feeling that he lives for POKéMON.$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PCStorageSystem
text: That PC-based POKéMON Storage System… / Whoever made it must be some kind of a scientific wizard!$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OranBerryRegainedHP
text: When my POKéMON ate an ORAN BERRY, it regained HP!$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManyTypesOfPokemon
text: There are many types of POKéMON. / All types have their strengths and weaknesses against other types. / Depending on the types of POKéMON, a battle could be easy or hard.$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TreeckoIsGrassType
text: For {STR_VAR_1}, remember: / GRASS attacks are strong against WATER, GROUND, and ROCK types. / A second type can change how much damage an attack does.$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TorchicIsFireType
text: For {STR_VAR_1}, remember: / FIRE attacks are strong against GRASS, BUG, ICE, and STEEL types. / A second type can change how much damage an attack does.$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MudkipIsWaterType
text: For {STR_VAR_1}, remember: / WATER attacks are strong against FIRE, GROUND, and ROCK types. / A second type can change how much damage an attack does.$

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_WeakWillGrowStronger
text: Even if a POKéMON is weak now, it will grow stronger. / The most important thing is love! Love for your POKéMON!$

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_RepelIsUseful
text: Do you use REPEL? It keeps POKéMON away, so it's useful when you're in a hurry.$

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_TakeSomeAntidotesWithYou
text: Do you carry ANTIDOTES? / Poison no longer drains HP while walking, but it still matters in battle. / An ANTIDOTE clears it before your next fight.$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CantMakeHeadsOrTails
text: The hull fits. The engine fits. So why won't these measurements agree? / If I move this here… No, then that won't fit!$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_MeetDockDeliverToStern
text: Hm? Oh, sorry. I'm DOCK. CAPT. STERN asked me to design a ferry. / Are those the DEVON GOODS? He's been waiting for them. / He's at the OCEANIC MUSEUM. Take the parcel straight to him.$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CouldYouFindStern
text: DOCK: Try the OCEANIC MUSEUM. CAPT. STERN needs that parcel. / I'll be here, arguing with these measurements…$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CouldUseAdviceFromVeteran
text: DOCK: Shipbuilding is an art. / A lot of things can't be figured out just by calculating. / I really could use advice from a veteran who knows the seas…$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_BrineyJoinedUs
text: DOCK: Hi! MR. BRINEY's joined us to lend us his help. / Thanks to the veteran sailor, the ferry is steadily coming together.$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_FerryIsReady
text: DOCK: The ferry is finally ready! / The new S.S. TIDAL is truly a marvel of technology! / But, I get the feeling that we can make something even better. / You know, there's never an end to technology's march.$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_DecidedToHelpDock
text: MR. BRINEY: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}! It's been too long! / Aye, since I met you, this old sea dog's been feeling frisky! / So I've decided to help DOCK make a ferry. / Aye, after all, a ferry would be able to carry a lot of people. / But, you know, that DOCK is really something special. / With his knack for technology and my experience, I'm sure that we can build one great ship, aye!$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_SeaIsLikeLivingThing
text: The seasons, the weather, where the moon sits in the sky… / These and other conditions make the sea change its expression. / That's right! The sea is like a living thing!$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_GetSeasickEasily
text: I get seasick real easily. So I get to help out here instead.$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2F_Text_ShipDesignMoreLikeBuilding
text: Designing a large ship is more like making a big building than putting together a transportation vehicle.$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2F_Text_FloatsBecauseBuoyancy
text: Don't you think it's strange that a ship made of heavy iron floats? / It floats because of a principle called buoyancy.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WouldYouLikeToEnter
text: Welcome to the OCEANIC MUSEUM. / The entrance fee is ¥50. Would you like to enter?$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_PleaseEnjoyYourself
text: Please enjoy yourself.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_NotEnoughMoney
text: Oh? I'm sorry, but you don't seem to have enough money.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_CatchUpWithYourGroup
text: Oh? You're with that group that went in earlier? / You're the only one who's late. You'd better go catch up to them!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_AquaExistForGoodOfAll
text: We, TEAM AQUA, exist for the good of all!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OurBossIsntHere
text: We were told to assemble here, so we did, but… / Our BOSS, the linchpin, isn't here.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WouldStuffHereMakeMeRich
text: If I ripped off the stuff here, would it make me rich?$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_CanLearnForNefariousDeeds
text: What I learn here, I can put to use on nefarious deeds…$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_RustboroBungled
text: If our goons didn't bungle things in RUSTBORO, we wouldn't be here!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_DidntHaveMoney
text: I didn't have ¥50, so it took a long time getting by the receptionist.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_LearnAboutSeaForBattling
text: I want to learn about the sea and use that knowledge for battling.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_SternIsRoleModel
text: I get all giddy and gooey when I see the sea! / For me, CAPT. STERN is the number one role model!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_MustBePokemonWeDontKnow
text: The sea is vast without end, and infinitely deep… / There must be many POKéMON that we don't know about.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WantSeaPokemon
text: I want a sea POKéMON. / I think it would feel cool and nice to hug.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_RememberMeTakeThis
text: Aiyeeeh! What are you doing here? / Me? I'm the TEAM AQUA member you thumped before, remember? Back in RUSTURF TUNNEL? / Here, take this! You have to forgive me!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_HopeINeverSeeYouAgain
text: That DEEP SEA TOOTH suits you more than it does me. It evolves CLAMPERL. / Hope I never see you again! Wahahaha!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_YouHaveToTakeThis
text: Awww, come on! You have to take this and let me go!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WhirlpoolExperiment
text: A blue fluid is spiraling inside a glass vessel. / “This is an experiment to create a WHIRLPOOL artificially using wind.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WaterfallExperiment
text: A red ball is bobbing up and down inside a glass vessel. / “This is an experiment simulating a WATERFALL using the ball's buoyancy.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanSoilDisplay
text: It's a sample of soil from the ocean floor. / “Over many years, the remains of life-forms settle at the bottom of the sea, making sedimentary layers. / “By analyzing these layers, the ancient past is revealed.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_BeachSandDisplay
text: It's a sample of beach sand. / “Stones from mountains are washed down by rivers where they are chipped and ground down. / “They are reduced to grains and end up as sand on beaches.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact1
text: “OCEANIC MINIFACT 1 Why is seawater blue? / “Light is composed of many colors. / “When light passes through water, most kinds of light lose color. / “However, blue light retains its color, making the sea appear blue.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact2
text: “OCEANIC MINIFACT 2 Why is the sea salty? / “Seawater contains dissolved salt in the form of sodium and chlorine ions. / “These ions leech out of rocks and are carried out to sea by rain. / “The concentration of dissolved salt makes the sea salty.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact3
text: “OCEANIC MINIFACT 3 Which is bigger? The sea or land? / “The sea covers about 70% of the planet, and the rest is land. / “The sea is therefore more than twice the size of land.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_FossilDisplay
text: It's a fossil with wavy ridges on it. / “Soil on the ocean floor gets scoured by the tide. / “The flowing seawater marks the soil with small ridges and valleys. / “If this soil becomes fossilized, it is called a ripple mark.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_DepthMeasuringMachine
text: A strange machine is rotating under a glass dome. / Maybe it's for measuring the depth of something…$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_ThankYouForTheParts
text: I'm STERN. You brought DEVON's parts! They'll help us measure pressure deep beneath the sea. / The tides have been changing. Even the wild POKéMON are appearing in unusual places.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WellTakeThoseParts
text: Hold it. Those parts map pressure below the seafloor. AQUA is taking them.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SternWhoAreYou
text: CAPT. STERN: Wh-what? Who are you people?$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WereTeamAqua
text: We're TEAM AQUA! Those parts belong to the people who understand the sea!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: That wasn't supposed to happen!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_BossGoingToBeFurious
text: The boss is going to hear about this…$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_LetMeTakeCareOfThis
text: Move aside. I'll get those parts myself!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: I can't stop this kid!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_MeddlingKid
text: We still don't have the parts. What are we going to tell ARCHIE?$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_CameToSeeWhatsTakingSoLong
text: That's enough. You two, stand back. I'll deal with this.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_ArchieWarning
text: I'm ARCHIE, leader of TEAM AQUA. / The sea doesn't care for borders. Life moves where the water carries it. / Those instruments can track the deep currents and lead us to the POKéMON that shaped the sea. / MAXIE would bury that power under more land. I intend to let it flow. / Hand them over, or stand and fight!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_ArchieDefeat
text: Tch! I underestimated you.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_ArchieDefeated
text: Keep them, then. AQUA won't turn back for one Trainer. / We'll find that current with or without your precious instruments.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SternThankYouForSavingUs
text: {PLAYER}, thank you. You kept us and the parts safe. / Our instruments may reveal what is disturbing the ocean and its POKéMON.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SternIveGotToGo
text: I'll get these instruments to the ship. We can't let AQUA reach the depths first. / After DEWFORD GYM, follow ROUTE 110 north to MAUVILLE CITY. / WATTSON keeps the city running. His GYM should give you a challenge!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_BrawlyHandoff
text: But earn BRAWLY's BADGE first. Then you can head north.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_RemindsMeOfAbandonedShip
text: I saw a model of a ship here. / It reminded me of the ABANDONED SHIP near DEWFORD TOWN…$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_DontRunInMuseum
text: Don't you dare run around inside the MUSEUM!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WantToRideSubmarine
text: Wow, the submarine's awesome! I want to go for a ride!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WaterQualitySample1
text: “WATER QUALITY SAMPLE 1,” the label says. / The sea is all connected, but the water seems to differ by region.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WaterQualitySample2
text: “WATER QUALITY SAMPLE 2,” the label says. / Does the saltiness of seawater differ by region, too?$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_PressureExperiment
text: A rubber ball is expanding and shrinking. / “In the sea, the weight of water itself exerts pressure. / “In shallow water, the pressure is not very heavy. / “However, in extremely deep water, the pressure can reach even tens of thousands of tons on a small area.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_HoennModel
text: “MODEL OF HOENN REGION” / It's a miniature diorama of the HOENN region. / Where is LITTLEROOT TOWN on this?$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_DeepSeawaterDisplay
text: It's a display on the flow of seawater. / “Near the bottom of the sea, water flows due to differences in such factors as temperature and salinity.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SurfaceSeawaterDisplay
text: It's a display on the flow of seawater. / “Toward the surface, seawater flows as currents driven by the winds.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SSTidalReplica
text: “THE FERRY S.S. TIDAL / “A scale replica of the ship under construction at STERN'S SHIPYARD.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SubmarineReplica
text: “SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1 / “A replica of the high-performance ocean floor exploration submarine.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SumbersibleReplica
text: “SUBMERSIBLE POD / “A replica of a compact, unmanned pod for seafloor exploration.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SSAnneReplica
text: “S.S. ANNE / “A replica of the luxury liner that circles the globe.”$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FerryServiceUnavailable
text: I beg your pardon? You're looking for a ship? / I'm sorry, the ferry service isn't available at present…$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_MayISeeYourTicket
text: Hello, are you here for the ferry? May I confirm your ferry pass?$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_YouMustHaveTicket
text: Your ferry pass is not registered. / I'm terribly sorry. / You need a registered pass to board the ferry.$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ConfirmedPassWhereTo
text: The attendant confirmed your ferry pass. / Perfect! That's all you need! / And where would you like to go?$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SailAnotherTime
text: Please sail with us another time!$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_LilycoveItIs
text: LILYCOVE CITY it is, then!$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_BattleFrontierItIs
text: BATTLE FRONTIER it is, then!$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_PleaseBoardFerry
text: Please board the ferry and wait for departure.$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
text: Then, where would you like to go?$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_LoveToGoDeepUnderwaterSomeday
text: A journey to the bottom of the sea… I wonder what it'd be like? / I'd love to go deep underwater like that someday.$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_AbnormalWeather
text: For a ship to sail safely, we need to know about the weather! / Speaking of weather, I heard something from a guy at the WEATHER INSTITUTE. / He was saying abnormal weather has been reported all over the place! / You should visit the WEATHER INSTITUTE and ask around!$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SubTooSmallForMe
text: I wanted to go with CAPT. STERN on the ocean floor exploration. / But the sub's too small for me. / If I squeezed in, there wouldn't be any room for the CAPTAIN…$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SameThugsTriedToRobAtMuseum
text: CAPT. STERN: Those thugs… / They're the same lot who tried to rob the DEVON GOODS at the MUSEUM.$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ArchieYouAgainHideoutInLilycove
text: ARCHIE: Oh? Not you again… / You are tenacious to track us here, that much I will give you. / But now… No one can stop us! No one! / Or, will you follow us back to our HIDEOUT in LILYCOVE CITY? / Fwahahahaha…$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_CaptSternWhyStealMySubmarine
text: CAPT. STERN: They have my submarine. The cavern charts are aboard, too. / ARCHIE named LILYCOVE. Reach the city by heading east from ROUTE 121. / Find LILYCOVE's eastern beach. SURF north to TEAM AQUA's cave hideout. / Stop their launch before they reach the sleeping POKéMON on the seafloor.$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNeedDive
text: CAPT. STERN: AQUA left before you could stop them... Don't blame yourself. / To follow that submarine, you'll need DIVE registered, the MIND BADGE, and a partner able to use the technique. / Travel to MOSSDEEP. Its divers and the SPACE CENTER may be able to help.$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_NeedDiveToCatchSub
text: CAPT. STERN: To follow the submarine, you'll need DIVE registered, the MIND BADGE, and a compatible partner. / Visit MOSSDEEP's SPACE CENTER and find STEVEN. He may be able to help.$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WontBeLongBeforeWeFinishFerry
text: CAPT. STERN: Oh, yes. MR. BRINEY came to our SHIPYARD. / It won't be long now before we finish making the ferry!$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FinishedMakingFerry
text: CAPT. STERN: {PLAYER}{KUN}! / We finally finished making the ferry S.S. TIDAL! / We couldn't have done it without your friend MR. BRINEY. / Please go for a short cruise on it!$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WouldYouTradeScanner
text: CAPT. STERN: Oh? {PLAYER}{KUN}, that item you have… / That's a SCANNER! That would sure help us on our explorations. / {PLAYER}{KUN}, would you trade your SCANNER for something? / Like, say, a DEEPSEATOOTH or a DEEPSEASCALE that I have?$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_IfYouWantToTradeLetMeKnow
text: CAPT. STERN: Are you certain? It's useless to you, {PLAYER}{KUN}… / Well, okay, then. If you want to trade your SCANNER, let me know.$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TradeForDeepSeaTooth
text: CAPT. STERN: So you'll trade it for my DEEPSEATOOTH?$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TradeForDeepSeaScale
text: CAPT. STERN: So you'll trade it for my DEEPSEASCALE?$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WhichOneDoYouWant
text: CAPT. STERN: Which one do you want?$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_HandedScannerToStern
text: {PLAYER} handed the SCANNER to CAPT. STERN.$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ThisWillHelpResearch
text: CAPT. STERN: Thanks, {PLAYER}{KUN}! This will help our research a lot!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
text: Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION- bound {PLAYER}? / WATTSON, the LEADER of MAUVILLE GYM, uses ELECTRIC-type POKéMON. / If you challenge him with WATER-type POKéMON, he'll zap them! Bzzt! / And, he's put in switch-controlled doors all over his GYM! Eccentric! / Hey, go for it!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
text: Whoa, you're electrifying! You've powered the door open!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkIntro
text: PINCURCHIN floors the whole stage, and TOGEDEMARU takes your bolts. / Find the current's blind spot!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkDefeat
text: You shut down my amplifier!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkPostBattle
text: ELECTRIC TERRAIN protects grounded Pokémon from sleep. / A Flying Pokémon or an AIR BALLOON changes which benefits apply.$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnIntro
text: Some of my Pokémon float above Ground attacks. Others use the terrain beneath them. / Can you tell which answer fits each pair?$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnDefeat
text: You broke our live connection…$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle
text: BELLIBOLT can set ELECTRIC TERRAIN for RAICHU's SURGE SURFER. / MEGA AMPHAROS brings a different pace and a Dragon typing.$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenIntro
text: Send current -- LANTURN drinks it. Send water -- HELIOLISK drinks that. / What is left in your bag?$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenDefeat
text: Our circuit couldn't hold!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenPostBattle
text: CHARJABUG powers special attacks with BATTERY. DISCHARGE can even heal LANTURN. / That same move is not safe beside every partner.$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianIntro
text: PLUSLE and MINUN amplify each other just by standing side by side. / Split us, or lose to both!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianDefeat
text: Our partnership wasn't enough!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianPostBattle
text: Do not press ELECTRIC attacks into the Ability that wants to absorb them.$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloIntro
text: JOLTIK makes THUNDER more reliable, and TOXTRICITY turns sound into power. / We are ready to take our chances!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloDefeat
text: Our relay lost its charge…$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloPostBattle
text: WATTREL can set TAILWIND, and JOLTIK can slow opponents with ELECTROWEB. / Those moves change speed in different ways.$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro
text: Wahahahah! I am WATTSON! / ELECTRODE sends the current. ELECTIVIRE turns it into speed. / I know how my partners work together. Show me what yours can do!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonDefeat
text: Wahahah! What a battle! / You have earned the DYNAMO BADGE!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedDynamoBadge
text: {PLAYER} received the DYNAMO BADGE from WATTSON.$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainDynamoBadgeTakeThis
text: The DYNAMO BADGE lets your LEVELER train a party up to Lv. 40. / It also enables ROCK SMASH outside of battle. / Hmm… You should take this, too!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainManectite
text: Manectite lets Manectric Mega Evolve. Let it hold the stone in battle.$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredWattson
text: Registered GYM LEADER WATTSON in the POKéNAV.$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPostBattle
text: Head north on ROUTE 111. My crew will let you through with that BADGE. / Turn west onto ROUTE 112 and go through FIERY PATH to ROUTE 113. / Follow it west to FALLARBOR TOWN. Ask there about the trouble at / METEOR FALLS, down ROUTE 114.$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonMtChimney
text: Head north on ROUTE 111, then west onto ROUTE 112. / Take the cable car up MT. CHIMNEY. Stop TEAM MAGMA at the crater.$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonLavaridge
text: Take ROUTE 112's cable car up MT. CHIMNEY, then descend JAGGED PASS. / That leads to LAVARIDGE TOWN. Challenge FLANNERY at the GYM.$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonGoForthAndEndeavor
text: Wahahahah! Go forth and endeavor, youngster!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: MAUVILLE CITY POKéMON GYM$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
text: MAUVILLE CITY POKéMON GYM / WATTSON'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPreRematch
text: WATTSON: Ah-ha! Here at last! I know what you want. You want to battle my POKéMON! / Wahahahaha! / I'll make sparks fly from you! Don't say I didn't warn you!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonRematchDefeat
text: Oof… Our batteries ran dry…$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPostRematch
text: WATTSON: We'll have to recharge our batteries again. / When we're fully charged up, we'll gladly accept your challenge. / So, come back again sometime, won't you?$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonRematchNeedTwoMons
text: WATTSON: Ah-ha! Here at last! I know what you want. You want to battle my POKéMON! / Wahahahaha! / Oops! Wait! You've only one POKéMON with you! / Come see me with two or more POKéMON, all right?$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_WelcomeToDevonCorp
text: Hello and welcome to the DEVON CORPORATION. / We're proud producers of items and medicine that enhance your life.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_StaffGotRobbed
text: One of our research staff stupidly got robbed of an important parcel.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ThoseShoesAreOurProduct
text: Hey, those RUNNING SHOES! They're one of our products! / It makes me happy when I see someone using something we made.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RobberWasntVeryBright
text: That stolen parcel… / Well, sure it's important, but it's not anything that anyone can use. / In my estimation, that robber must not have been very bright.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_SoundsLikeStolenGoodsRecovered
text: It sounds like they've recovered the ripped-off DEVON GOODS.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_OnlyAuthorizedPeopleEnter
text: I'm sorry, only authorized people are allowed to enter here.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_HowCouldWeGetRobbed
text: It's beyond stupid. How could we get robbed?$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_YoureAlwaysWelcomeHere
text: Hi, there! You're always welcome here!$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RocksMetalDisplay
text: Samples of rocks and metal are displayed in the glass case. / There's a panel with some writing on it… / “DEVON CORPORATION got its start as a producer of stones from quarries. / “The company also produced iron from filings in the sand. / “From that humble start as a producer of raw materials, DEVON developed. / “DEVON is now a manufacturer of a wide range of industrial products.”$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ProductDisplay
text: Prototypes and test products fill the glass display case. / There's a panel with a description… / “In addition to industrial products, DEVON now markets sundries and pharmaceuticals for better lifestyles. / “Recently, DEVON has begun marketing tools for POKéMON TRAINERS, including POKé BALLS and POKéNAV systems.”$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_EeveeResearcherOffer
text: DEVON can safely return an evolved EEVEE to its original form. Try it?$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_EeveeResearcherChoose
text: Choose the EEVEE evolution to return to EEVEE.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_EeveeResearcherConfirm
text: Return {STR_VAR_1} to EEVEE? Its current moves will be preserved.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_EeveeResearcherComplete
text: The genetic pattern stabilized. {STR_VAR_1} is EEVEE again.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_EeveeResearcherInvalid
text: That POKéMON is not an evolved member of EEVEE's family.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_EeveeResearcherExit
text: The machine will be ready whenever you need it.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_LegendarySignResearcherIntro
text: HOENN is full of rare discoveries. You can find them at your own pace. / Some legendaries have a 1% chance to appear among wild POKéMON. / SWEET SCENT gives a 25% chance of an available local legendary. / If several are available there, they share that chance evenly. / Check each entry for its BADGE, story and partner requirements. / If one escapes or faints, keep looking. It can appear again. / Others await you at special places or come from rewards. / I keep leads for every discovery, including ones you have completed.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_MagearnaParty
text: Your discovery completes DEVON's sealed mechanical prototype! / MAGEARNA awakens and joins your party.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_MagearnaPC
text: Your discovery completes DEVON's sealed mechanical prototype! / MAGEARNA awakens and is sent to your PC.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_MagearnaNoRoom
text: The sealed prototype answers DIANCIE, but your party and PC have no room.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_ArceusRewardParty
text: You restored HOENN's weather and earned all eight badges. Something extraordinary has answered! / ARCEUS appears before you and joins your party.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_ArceusRewardPC
text: You restored HOENN's weather and earned all eight badges. Something extraordinary has answered! / ARCEUS appears before you and is sent to your PC.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_ArceusRewardNoRoom
text: ARCEUS has answered your journey, but needs room. Please make space in your PC.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_ArceusRewardComplete
text: Even ARCEUS has joined your journey. Take your discoveries to the LEAGUE!$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceForTalkingToPokemon
text: We're developing a device for talking with POKéMON. / But we haven't had much success…$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopingNewBalls
text: I'm developing new kinds of POKé BALLS… / But I haven't made much headway…$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WeFinallyMadeNewBalls
text: We finally made new kinds of POKé BALLS! / The REPEAT BALL makes it easier to catch POKéMON you've caught before. / The TIMER BALL gets better at catching POKéMON the longer a battle runs. / Both are proudly developed by the DEVON CORPORATION. / Please give them a try!$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_IMadePokenav
text: I made the POKéNAV! / As an engineer, I feel blessed to have made something so great!$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WowThatsAPokenav
text: Oh, wow! That's a POKéNAV! / It came about as a result of our PRESIDENT's desire to learn about the feelings of POKéMON. / Would you like me to describe its features in detail? / No, no. I think you'll find out just by trying the POKéNAV out.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceToVisualizePokemonDreams
text: I'm trying to develop a device that visually reproduces the dreams of POKéMON… / But it's not going well.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopDeviceToResurrectFossils
text: My FOSSIL REGENERATOR can restore ancient POKéMON from every era. / Bring me any complete fossil you find.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WantToBringFossilBackToLife
text: Wait! You have a POKéMON fossil! / Shall I restore its ancient POKéMON with the FOSSIL REGENERATOR?$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_OhIsThatSo
text: Oh, is that so? / DEVON's technological expertise is outstanding, I tell you.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_ChooseFossil
text: The machine restores one fossil at a time. Which one shall I revive?$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_HandedFossilToResearcher
text: Excellent! Let's do this right away. / {PLAYER} handed the {STR_VAR_1} to the DEVON RESEARCHER.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilNoLongerAvailable
text: Oh! That fossil is no longer in your Bag. Bring it back and we'll try again.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilDataLost
text: The regenerator's record is unreadable. I've reset it so we can try again.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilRegeneratorTakesTime
text: The FOSSIL REGENERATOR, which I made, is incredible. / But it has one drawback--it takes a long time to work. / So, uh… How about you go for a stroll and look around for a while?$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilizedMonBroughtBackToLife
text: Thanks for waiting! / Your fossilized POKéMON has been brought back to life! / It was {STR_VAR_2}! An ancient POKéMON!$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_ReceivedMonFromResearcher
text: {PLAYER} received {STR_VAR_2} from the DEVON RESEARCHER.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TooManyPokemon
text: Uh-oh, you've got too many POKéMON. You have no room for this one.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopNewPokenavFeature
text: I'm trying to develop a new feature for the POKéNAV… / But it's not going well.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WhatToWorkOnNext
text: Well, now what shall I work on developing next? / Our company allows us to make our inspirations into reality. / One couldn't ask for a better environment as an engineer.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_EventScript_MegaGift_MAGEARNITE_Text
text: Eight badges! You have seen things our laboratory can only dream of. / This stone responds to Magearna. Perhaps you can learn why.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIHaveFavor
text: I'm MR. STONE, president of DEVON. You recovered our GOODS and protected my staff. Thank you! / Reports of rare POKéMON are arriving from caves and forests across HOENN. / MAGMA and AQUA are searching those same places. I fear the thefts are connected. / My son STEVEN is in GRANITE CAVE near DEWFORD. Please take this LETTER to him. / Then deliver the GOODS to CAPT. STERN in SLATEPORT. He's counting on us.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_LetterSentToPC
text: Your KEY ITEMS pocket is full, so the LETTER was sent to your PC.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_LetterNoRoom
text: Your KEY ITEMS pocket and PC are full. Make room, then return to my desk.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneWantYouToHaveThis
text: Please take this POKéNAV. You'll need a good map for the journey ahead.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ReceivedPokenav
text: {PLAYER} received a POKéNAV.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
text: The POKéNAV maps HOENN and keeps you in touch with key Trainers. / Our second-floor researcher keeps a legendary discovery guide. / He lists each Pokémon's location and requirements, and whether you can catch it now. / Please rest before you leave. DEWFORD is your next stop.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneGoWithCautionAndCare
text: Go carefully, {PLAYER}. You've already done more for us than I could ask.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_CountingOnYou
text: You'll find STEVEN in GRANITE CAVE near DEWFORD. He loses track of time studying rocks! / Our second-floor researcher keeps a guide to legendary POKéMON. Ask whenever you want a lead.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_StevenAwaitsKnuckleBadge
text: STEVEN received my LETTER. Good. / He will entrust the MEGA RING only after you earn DEWFORD's KNUCKLE BADGE.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThankYouForDeliveringLetter
text: You reached STEVEN and earned the right to use MEGA EVOLUTION. Excellent. / This stone was found above RUSTBORO. Let PIDGEOT show you what it can become.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ExplainPidgeotite
text: PIDGEOTITE lets a PIDGEOT Mega Evolve when it holds the stone and you possess a MEGA RING. / Find Mega Stones in HOENN's caves, gyms and side paths, or through the people you meet. / CENTER vendors supply held items and ordinary evolution items free of charge.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_NotFamiliarWithTrends
text: Some rare POKéMON become available as you earn BADGES or help HOENN. / A few also require you to have caught another POKéMON. Our guide tells you exactly which one. / You can explore and catch them without visiting our researcher.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
text: This is the DEVON CORPORATION's third floor. / Our PRESIDENT's OFFICE is on this floor. / Anyway, I can't tell you how much I'm grateful for what you've done. / Um… By the way, that parcel you got back for us… / Could I get you to deliver that to the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT? / It would be awful if those robbers tried to take it again. / Uh… Hehehe, so, uh, could I count on you to do that for me? / Oh, that's right. Could you wait here a second?$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_WordWithPresidentComeWithMe
text: Our PRESIDENT would like to have a word with you. / Please come with me.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_PleaseGoAhead
text: Please, go ahead.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_VisitCaptSternShipyard
text: If you visit the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT, you should go see CAPT. STERN.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_RepeatAndTimerHugelyPopular
text: DEVON's new products, the REPEAT BALL and TIMER BALL, have become hugely popular among TRAINERS.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_RareRocksDisplay
text: It's a collection of rare rocks and stones assembled by the PRESIDENT.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GuideIntroduction
text: Yo! Welcome to RUSTBORO GYM. / Every trainer here brings a complete doubles plan. ROXANNE brings the full force of her Rock team. / Prepare your partners, study the board, and make your own opening. / Take these FRESH WATERS. Come see me after you earn the BADGE!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
text: ROXANNE uses Rock Pokémon with different jobs. / CARBINK can reverse move order with TRICK ROOM. NOSEPASS can guard its partner from spread attacks. / Water and Grass are useful, but target choice and timing still matter. Build the answer that suits your team!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
text: Whoa! What a breathtaking victory! My cheering must've worked! / Great! Check your TRAINER CARD. / The STONE BADGE you got should be properly recorded on it. / In other words… / You've climbed the first step on the stairs to the CHAMPIONSHIP! / That's got to feel awesome!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshIntro
text: BONSLY and SHIELDON can survive a knockout blow at full health. / We make that extra action count!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshDefeat
text: Our wall came down!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshPostBattle
text: STURDY can preserve BONSLY at full health. Chip damage or an Ability that bypasses it changes the plan.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyIntro
text: LILEEP drinks the water you aim at my rocks. SHUCKLE slows your feet. / Go on -- find the dry path!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyDefeat
text: You saw right through them!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyPostBattle
text: Two small ROCKS still add up. Never underestimate a first-badge team.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcIntro
text: AMAURA calls snow and raises AURORA VEIL. / Stop the screen or find a way through!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcDefeat
text: You kept control of your choices!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcPostBattle
text: ROXANNE combines every lesson: field control, reverse speed, and endurance.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneIntro
text: I am ROXANNE, RUSTBORO's GYM LEADER. / Each challenger gives me something new to study. / My Pokémon can endure a blow, guard a partner, or reverse the order of battle. / Show me how your team answers mine.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneDefeat
text: There is always more to learn. Even a carefully prepared team can be beaten. / You have earned the STONE BADGE. May it be the first of many!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedStoneBadge
text: {PLAYER} received the STONE BADGE from ROXANNE.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_StoneBadgeInfoTakeThis
text: The STONE BADGE lets your LEVELER train a party up to Lv. 20. / It also enables POKéMON to use CUT outside of battle. / It also marks your first true step toward the POKéMON LEAGUE. / Please take this with you, too.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_ExplainRoxanneRewards
text: Aerodactylite lets Aerodactyl Mega Evolve once you possess a Mega Ring. / DEVON can restore that OLD AMBER. Consider Aerodactyl your first Mega project.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePostBattle
text: Your next GYM is BRAWLY's in DEWFORD. / MR. BRINEY sails from his cottage on ROUTE 104, south of PETALBURG WOODS.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: RUSTBORO CITY POKéMON GYM$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
text: RUSTBORO CITY POKéMON GYM / ROXANNE'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRegisterCall
text: … … … … … … … … … … … Beep! / ROXANNE: Oh, hello, {PLAYER}? This is ROXANNE of RUSTBORO CITY. / I heard from BRAWLY that you're moving up through the ranks of TRAINERS at an incredible clip. / Your progress gives my students an excellent model to study. / I hope you'll share what you learn as your journey continues! / … … … … … … … … … … … Click!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredRoxanne
text: Registered GYM LEADER ROXANNE in the POKéNAV.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePreRematch
text: ROXANNE: I'm so glad to see you again. I'm ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER here. / I'm sure we've both experienced many battles since we last met. / I would like to see how much better we've become. Let us battle!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRematchDefeat
text: Grr… Again, I have lost…$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePostRematch
text: ROXANNE: I still have much to learn when it comes to battling POKéMON. / That awareness makes me love battling all that much more!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRematchNeedTwoMons
text: ROXANNE: I'm so glad to see you again. I'm ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER here. / I'm sure we've both experienced many battles since we last met. / I would like to see how much better we've become… / Oh, no… You only have one POKéMON with you? / Please return with at least one more POKéMON.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_BlackboardListsStatusChanges
text: The blackboard lists status changes that may affect POKéMON in battle.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ReadWhichTopic
text: Which topic do you want to read?$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainPoison
text: If a POKéMON is poisoned, it steadily loses HP during battle. / Poison remains after battle, but it no longer causes damage while traveling. / Heal it using an ANTIDOTE.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainParalysis
text: If a POKéMON becomes paralyzed, its SPEED drops. / It may also not be able to move while it is in battle. / Paralysis remains after battle. Cure it using a PARLYZ HEAL.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainSleep
text: Sleep prevents most moves until the Pokémon wakes. / SLEEP TALK and SNORE are exceptions. A sleeping Pokémon stays asleep after battle; AWAKENING cures it.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainBurn
text: A burn normally lowers damage from physical attacks and causes HP loss. / Some Abilities change that result. GUTS attackers can benefit from burn! / BURN HEAL removes a burn outside a trainer battle.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainFreeze
text: A frozen Pokémon usually cannot move. It may thaw, and certain moves can help it thaw as well. / Freezing remains after battle. An ICE HEAL removes it.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentsWhoStudyEveryTool
text: A good TRAINER studies every tool. / This SUN STONE evolves certain POKéMON. Show me that you know when to use it.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainSunStone
text: A Sun Stone evolves certain Pokémon. Use it from the Bag when ready.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_TradingRightNow
text: I'm trading POKéMON with my friend right now.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_AlwaysWantedSeedot
text: I always wanted a SEEDOT, and I'm finally getting one!$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_PokemontCantUseManMadeItems
text: POKéMON can hold items, but they don't know what to do with man-made items like POTION and ANTIDOTE.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ConfusedPokemonAttacksItself
text: You know how some POKéMON moves can confuse a POKéMON? / A confused POKéMON will sometimes attack itself without meaning to. / But once it leaves battle, it will return to normal.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_PokemonHealItselfWithBerry
