text: A POKéMON holding a BERRY will heal itself… / There are many kinds of items that POKéMON can hold… / Boy, it sure is hard taking notes down…$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentsNotes
text: It's this student's notebook… / POKéMON are to be caught using POKé BALLS. / Up to six POKéMON can accompany a TRAINER. / A TRAINER is someone who catches POKéMON, raises them, and battles with them. / A TRAINER's mission is to defeat the strong TRAINERS who await challengers in POKéMON GYMS.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyCut
text: SCOTT: We met in PETALBURG, didn't we? I'm looking for exceptional Trainers. / The CUTTER nearby has the CUT HM. Collect it and the STONE BADGE. / Then a compatible party member can clear thin trees without keeping CUT in its battle moves.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentTalentLevelUnknown
text: SCOTT: Hmm… / The talent levels of the students here are unknown. The potential's there.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottStoneBadge
text: SCOTT: Oh, what's that? / It's a STONE BADGE, isn't it? That's pretty impressive, I'd say. / But, you know, I would've loved to see you in battle. / It's hard to tell what you're like as a TRAINER from a LEAGUE BADGE.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyStoneBadge
text: Hello? Didn't we meet before? I think back in PETALBURG CITY. / Let me introduce myself. My name's SCOTT. / I've been traveling everywhere in search of outstanding TRAINERS. / More specifically, I'm looking for POKéMON battle experts. / Oh, what's that? It's a STONE BADGE, isn't it? / That's pretty impressive, I'd say, for a starting TRAINER like yourself. / But, you know, I would've loved to see you in battle. / It's hard to tell what you're like as a TRAINER from a LEAGUE BADGE.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokemonHavePersonalities
text: My POKéMON has a NAIVE nature, and my friend's has a JOLLY nature. / It's fascinating how POKéMON have personalities!$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MaleAndFemalePokemon
text: Just like people, there are male and female POKéMON. / But no one seems to have any idea how they're different.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HMCutNextDoor
text: The man next door gave me an HM! / I used it to teach my POKéMON how to CUT down skinny trees.$

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_MoveSpecialist
text: FALSE SWIPE used to be my special TM. / The POKéMON CENTER specialist now teaches it whenever it is legal.$

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_BuyingHealsInCaseOfShroomish
text: I'm buying some PARLYZ HEALS and ANTIDOTES. / Just in case I run into SHROOMISH in PETALBURG WOODS.$

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_ShouldBuySuperPotionsInstead
text: My POKéMON evolved. It has a lot of HP now. / I should buy SUPER POTIONS for it instead of ordinary POTIONS.$

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_GettingEscapeRopeJustInCase
text: I'm getting an ESCAPE ROPE just in case I get lost in a cave. / I just need to use it to get back to the entrance.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_1F_Text_EveryPokemonHasAbility
text: Every POKéMON has a special ability that it can use.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_1F_Text_PokemonStrange
text: POKéMON are such strange creatures.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ComingUpWithMealsIsHard
text: Oh, it's so hard every day… / What's hard? You need to ask? / It's trying to figure out what to make for meals every day. / It really isn't easy coming up with meals every day.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_HelloDoYouKnowFunnyPhrase
text: Oh, hello! Welcome to the PEPPER household. / I have a question for you. Have you ever baby-sat? / You see, I'm a new father, so raising a child is all new to me. / And I have a problem. My daughter WALDA doesn't laugh enough. / I think she'd laugh for me if I told her something funny. / Do you know of a funny word or phrase you can tell me?$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_BeenSayingXDoYouKnowBetterPhrase
text: I've been saying “{STR_VAR_1}” to amuse her lately. / Do you know of a better word or a phrase that might work?$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_WonderfulLetsHearSuggestion
text: Oh, that's wonderful. So, let's hear it, your suggestion.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhIsThatRight
text: Oh, is that right? / Well, if you come up with a good suggestion, I'm all ears.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_LetsGiveItATry2
text: Ah, I see. Well, let's give it a try, shall we?$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhShesLaughing
text: {STR_VAR_1}. {STR_VAR_1}. / Oh, yes! She's laughing! Oh, I am as delighted as she!$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_LetsGiveItATry
text: Ah, I see. Well, let's give it a try, shall we?$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ShesNotSmilingAtAll
text: {STR_VAR_1}. {STR_VAR_1}. / Hmmm… She's not smiling at all. Maybe WALDA is one serious child…$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThinkOfMyOwnPhrase
text: Oh, so you don't know any good words. I'd better think for myself, then. / Hmm… How about “{STR_VAR_1}”? Let's see if that will work.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ShesNotSmilingAtAll2
text: {STR_VAR_1}. {STR_VAR_1}. / Hmmm… She's not smiling at all. Maybe WALDA is one serious child…$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhYouDontKnowAny
text: Oh, so you don't know any good words. I guess I'll try to amuse her with the saying I used before. / Anyways, if you have a good suggestion, don't hesitate in telling me, okay?$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThankYouIllGiveYouWallpaper
text: Thank you! / Thanks to you, my darling WALDA laughed for me! / Actually, I may not look all that special, but I'm one of DEVON CORPORATION's top researchers. / So, how about I do something in return for you? / I know, I'll add some new wallpaper patterns for the BOXES in the PC POKéMON Storage System. / In the wallpaper pattern menu, select “FRIENDS.” / That will give you access to the new wallpaper patterns.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ItsAPokemonPlushDoll
text: It's a POKéMON plush DOLL!$

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_IllTradeIfYouWant
text: Huh? My POKéMON is cute? Sure, I knew that. / But if you really want, I'm willing to trade it to you. / I'll trade you my {STR_VAR_2} for a {STR_VAR_1} if you want.$

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_PleaseBeGoodToMyPokemon
text: Eheheh… Please be good to my POKéMON. / It already has a proper battle set, so it can fight from day one.$

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_DoesntLookLikeMonToMe
text: Huh? That doesn't look anything like a {STR_VAR_1} to me.$

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_YouDontWantToThatsOkay
text: Oh, if you don't want to, that's okay. But my POKéMON is cute, you know…$

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_AnyPokemonCanBeCute
text: Any POKéMON can be cute if you raise it with care and kindness.$

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_AllSortsOfPlaces
text: In all sorts of places, there are all sorts of POKéMON and people. / I find that fascinating, so I go to all sorts of places.$

label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_YouCanPutThisHMToGoodUse
text: That determined expression… That limber way you move… And your well-trained POKéMON… / You're obviously a skilled TRAINER! / No, wait, don't say a word. I can tell just by looking at you. / I'm sure that you can put this HIDDEN MACHINE to good use. / No need to be modest or shy. Go on, take it!$

label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_ExplainCut
text: That HM registers CUT as a field technique for your team. / With the STONE BADGE, a party member able to learn CUT can chop thin trees. / It needn't keep CUT among its four battle moves.$

label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_DadHelpedClearLandOfTrees
text: When they were expanding the city of RUSTBORO, my dad helped out. / He made his POKéMON use CUT to clear the land of trees.$

label: RustboroCity_House2_Text_TrainerSchoolExcellent
text: The TRAINER'S SCHOOL is excellent. / If you study there, you could even become a GYM LEADER.$

label: RustboroCity_House2_Text_RoxanneKnowsALot
text: ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER, really knows a lot about POKéMON. / She's really strong, too!$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_1F_Text_DevonWorkersLiveHere
text: DEVON CORPORATION's workers live in this building.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_1F_Text_Skitty
text: SKITTY: Gyaaaah!$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_DevonWasTinyInOldDays
text: Way back in the old days, DEVON was just a teeny, tiny company.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_MyDaddyMadeThisYouCanHaveIt
text: My daddy's working at the CORPORATION. / My daddy made this! But I can't use it, so you can have it.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_GoingToWorkAtDevonToo
text: My daddy's working at the CORPORATION. / When I grow up, I'm going to work for DEVON, too.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_MyDadsAceAtDevon
text: My dad is a real ace at DEVON. / Here. Take something an ACE TRAINER like me knows how to use.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_PokemonHoldFloatStone
text: DEVON refines METAL COATS. / Use one from the BAG to evolve ONIX or SCYTHER. No trade with another player is required.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_PutOnWeight
text: For some reason, I've put on a lot of weight recently…$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_3F_Text_PresidentCollectsRareStones
text: DEVON's PRESIDENT likes to collect rare stones.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_3F_Text_PresidentsSonAlsoCollectsRareStones
text: I think the PRESIDENT's son also collects rare stones.$

label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_IGivePerfectlySuitedNicknames
text: For my own POKéMON, I give them perfectly suited nicknames! / It's my expression of, uh… originality, yes, that's it!$

label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_NamingPikachuPekachu
text: But giving the name PEKACHU to a PIKACHU? It seems pointless. / I suppose it is good to use a name that's easy to understand, but…$

label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_Pekachu
text: PEKACHU: Peka!$

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_YouWillTradeWontYou
text: Wrooooaaar! I need it! I have to get me a {STR_VAR_1}! I'll do anything for it! / …Uh… Did you hear that? My shout from the bottom of my heart? / Having heard that, you will trade your {STR_VAR_1} for my {STR_VAR_2}, won't you?$

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_MonYouTakeCare
text: Oh, yeah, right on! / {STR_VAR_1}, welcome! {STR_VAR_2}, you take care!$

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_ThisIsntAMon
text: Uh, no, I don't think so. That isn't a {STR_VAR_1}.$

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_YouWontTradeMe
text: No? You won't trade me? Even after I bared my heart to you?$

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_GoingToMakeVolbeatStrong
text: I'm going to make VOLBEAT super strong from this moment on! / BOMBIRDIER already knows its role. Just give it a partner to cover!$

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_TradingMemoriesWithOthers
text: Trading POKéMON with others… / It's as if you're trading your own memories with other people.$

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_Zigzagoon
text: ZIGZAGOON: Gumomoh?$

label: FortreeCity_House1_EventScript_MegaGift_MILOTICITE_Text
text: People admire a Milotic, but few remember the patient work of raising it. / Take this stone if you find one. Beauty deserves a little adventure.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
text: Yo, how's it going, CHAMPION- bound {PLAYER}? / FORTREE GYM LEADER WINONA is a master of FLYING-type POKéMON. / She's waiting at the back of this GYM, behind the rotating doors. / She's waiting for new challengers who are trying to take wing! / Okay, go for it!$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
text: You did it! You've achieved liftoff!$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredIntro
text: SWOOBAT's SIMPLE doubles every CALM MIND. NOCTOWL keeps the pressure on. / Which one will you stop first?$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredDefeat
text: We couldn't hold the sky…$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredPostBattle
text: TAUNT can stop CALM MIND. But don't forget the attacker beside SWOOBAT.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoIntro
text: JUMPLUFF puts you to sleep, and HONCHKROW grows with every fall. / Give it nothing to feed on!$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoDefeat
text: We lost our lift…$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoPostBattle
text: TAILWIND lasts four turns. Stall the wind, then punish what it carried.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintIntro
text: MULTISCALE DRAGONITE, SPEED BOOST YANMEGA, and dragons in reserve. / WINONA needn't see you if I win here!$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintDefeat
text: WINONA, I… The wind broke!$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintPostBattle
text: Speed stacked on speed still dies to priority. EXTREME SPEED is coming.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyIntro
text: PIDGEOT's HURRICANE never misses under NO GUARD. PELIPPER brings the rain. / Position, then power!$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyDefeat
text: Even our sky wasn't enough!$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyPostBattle
text: Changing the rain slows MANTINE. But NO GUARD works in any weather.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoIntro
text: GLISCOR heals through its own poison, and CORVIKNIGHT returns what you send. / Lower our stats. I dare you!$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoDefeat
text: Even steel wings can buckle…$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoPostBattle
text: Special attacks test our defenses. ICE is especially hard on GLISCOR.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusIntro
text: TORNADUS gives TAILWIND priority. BRAVIARY rides the gust behind it. / Four turns. Outlast them!$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusDefeat
text: Our wind has run its course.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusPostBattle
text: A rival TAILWIND can contest mine. TRICK ROOM can turn speed against us.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaIntro
text: I am WINONA, FORTREE's GYM LEADER. / The sky controls position: wind decides speed, wings evade Ground, snow hides the final horizon. / Preserve the answer you will need after the weather changes.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaDefeat
text: You denied the wind without losing sight of the snow. Accept the FEATHER BADGE.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedFeatherBadge
text: {PLAYER} received the FEATHER BADGE from WINONA.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFeatherBadgeTakeThis
text: The FEATHER BADGE lets your LEVELER train a party up to Lv. 60. / It also enables FLY outside of battle. Your FLIGHT BEACON works from now on. Use it from the BAG to revisit towns. / And this… This is a gift from me.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainAltarianite
text: Altarianite lets Altaria Mega Evolve. Let it hold the stone in battle.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_PyreHandoff
text: AQUA has been seen near MT. PYRE. Follow ROUTES 120 and 121 east, then SURF south on ROUTE 122 to find it. / Discover what they are disturbing there. The skies over HOENN are unsettled.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredWinona
text: Registered GYM LEADER WINONA in the POKéNAV.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostBattle
text: A flying team is not one species label. It is freedom of position. Remember that. / To follow AQUA to MT. PYRE, head east through ROUTES 120 and 121, then SURF south on ROUTE 122. / Find what drew them to that quiet place.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
text: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM / WINONA'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPreRematch
text: WINONA: We humans can never escape gravity's pull on the ground. / But by striving for excellence, we have the power to soar! / You have scaled the pinnacle as the reigning CHAMPION. / Please, allow me to see your power at full flight!$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchDefeat
text: I failed to reach your height again…$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostRematch
text: WINONA: Even though I have lost, the wings of my heart remain unbroken. / I can rise and soar again and yet again. / I am convinced of it!$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchNeedTwoMons
text: WINONA: We humans can never escape gravity's pull on the ground. / But by striving for excellence, we have the power to soar! / You have scaled the pinnacle as the reigning CHAMPION. / Please, allow me to see your power at full flight! / Oh, no… Do you have but one POKéMON with you? / Please return with two POKéMON at the very least.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaAfterPyre
text: A flying team is not one species label. It is freedom of position. Remember that.$

label: FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GoToSafariZone
text: Listen, kid, are you working on a POKéDEX? / Hmm… Go to the SAFARI ZONE. That's my suggestion.$

label: FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RecordCornerIsNeat
text: Have you done anything at the RECORD CORNER? / It's pretty neat. It mixes and matches the records of TRAINERS. / I don't know quite how it works, but it's cool. It's exciting, even!$

label: FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DoYouKnowAboutPokenav
text: Oh, wow, you have a POKéNAV! And it's just like mine! / Do you know about POKéNAV's MATCH CALL system? / Access it, and you can chat with registered TRAINERS anytime. / It also lets TRAINERS share news and training notes with you. / It's really nifty! Those DEVON guys sure know what they're doing!$

label: FortreeCity_Mart_Text_SpenserChallenge
text: I am SPENSER of the BATTLE PALACE. / A Pokémon's instincts reveal its Trainer's trust. Let me see yours!$

label: FortreeCity_Mart_Text_SpenserDefeat
text: Gwahaha! Your trust held firm!$

label: FortreeCity_Mart_Text_SpenserAfter
text: Use that PROTECTOR to raise a new partner. We will meet at the FRONTIER.$

label: FortreeCity_Mart_Text_SuperRepelBetter
text: SUPER REPEL lasts a long time, and it gets the job done. / It's much better than an ordinary REPEL.$

label: FortreeCity_Mart_Text_StockUpOnItems
text: I always stock up on more items than I'm sure I'll need. / You never know what might happen. Better to be safe than sorry!$

label: FortreeCity_Mart_Text_RareCandyMakesMonGrow
text: The LEVELER raises your whole party to the current level limit at once. / It makes training completely optional.$

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_HiddenPowersArousedByNature
text: People… POKéMON… / Their hidden powers are aroused by living in natural environments…$

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CoinInWhichHand
text: Let this old woman see if your hidden power has awoken… / I hold a coin in my hand. / Now, tell me, have I palmed it in the right hand? Or in the left?$

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CorrectTryAgainWhichHand
text: Oh! Yes, correct! / We shall try again. / In which hand have I palmed the coin? The right or left?$

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CorrectTryAgainWhichHand2
text: Oh! Yes, correct! / We shall try again. / In which hand have I palmed the coin? The right or left?$

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_YourHiddenPowerHasAwoken
text: Your insight has awoken! / Take this Dubious Disc for Porygon2.$

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_ExplainDubiousDisc
text: A DUBIOUS DISC evolves PORYGON2. Use it from the Bag when ready.$

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_YouGuessedWrong
text: No, too bad. You guessed wrong.$

label: FortreeCity_House3_Text_MetStevenHadAmazingPokemon
text: While speaking about POKéDEXES, I remembered something. / I met this TRAINER, STEVEN, when I was searching for rare stones. / Hoo, boy, he had some amazing POKéMON with him. / They weren't just rare, they were trained to terrifying extremes! / He might even be stronger than the GYM LEADER in this town…$

label: FortreeCity_House3_Text_OhYouHavePokedex
text: What's that thing you have there? / … … … … … … / Oh, it's called a POKéDEX? It's really awesome!$

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_BringsWorldCloserTogether
text: By being together with POKéMON, people make more and more friends. / And that brings the world closer together. I think it's wonderful!$

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_GoBirdPokemon
text: There! Go, BIRD POKéMON!$

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_AskedWingullToRunErrand
text: Heheh, I asked my WINGULL to run an errand for me.$

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_WelcomeWingullTakeSachet
text: Welcome back, Wingull! And thank you. / Please take this Sachet as my thanks.$

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_FriendsFarAwayThanksToWingull
text: Thanks to my WINGULL, I have friends who live far away.$

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_Wingull
text: WINGULL: Pihyoh!$

label: FortreeCity_House5_Text_TreeHousesAreGreat
text: The tree houses of FORTREE are great! / I think it's the number one town for living together with POKéMON.$

label: FortreeCity_House5_Text_AdaptedToNature
text: POKéMON and people have adapted to nature for survival. / There's no need to make nature conform to the way we want to live.$

label: FortreeCity_House5_Text_Zigzagoon
text: ZIGZAGOON: Bufuu!$

label: FortreeCity_House5_EventScript_MegaGift_CHIMECHITE_Text
text: Listen to the chimes in the trees. No two breezes sound quite alike. / I kept this for a Chimecho. Perhaps yours will give it a voice.$

label: FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_MerchandiseSentToPC
text: Merchandise you buy here is sent to your own PC. / That's fantastic! I wish they could also deliver me home like that.$

label: FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_BuyingDeskForDolls
text: I'm buying a pretty desk and I'm putting my cute DOLLS on it. / If I don't, when I decorate my SECRET BASE, my DOLLS will get dirty or poked with splinters.$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_FerryUnavailable
text: I beg your pardon? You're looking for a ship? / I'm sorry, the ferry service isn't available at present…$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_MayISeeYourTicket
text: Hello, are you here for the ferry? May I confirm your ferry pass?$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_NoTicket
text: Your ferry pass is not registered. / I'm terribly sorry. / You need a registered pass to board the ferry.$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_ConfirmedPassWhereTo
text: The attendant confirmed your ferry pass. / Perfect! That's all you need! / And where would you like to go?$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailAnotherTime
text: Please sail with us another time!$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SlateportItIs
text: SLATEPORT CITY it is, then!$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_BattleFrontierItIs
text: BATTLE FRONTIER it is, then!$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_PleaseBoard
text: Please board the ferry and wait for departure.$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
text: Then, where would you like to go?$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailorFerryUnavailable
text: STERN is preparing exploration trips. Come back with the FEATHER BADGE and I'll have your passes ready.$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailorFerryAvailable
text: Six badges! STERN and DEVON have approved your exploration trips. / Here are passes for the ferry, SOUTHERN ISLAND, NAVEL ROCK, BIRTH ISLAND and FARAWAY ISLAND. / The BATTLE FRONTIER is open too. Its CIRCUIT awards legendary POKéMON as your total wins grow.$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_ChampionPassesReady
text: Your island routes are active. Show the attendant a pass to choose a destination. / Explore for LATIAS or LATIOS, LUGIA, HO-OH, DEOXYS and MEW. You can meet them during your GYM journey.$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_ChampionPassesBagFull
text: Your BAG cannot hold the next pass. Make room and speak to me again.$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_LatiReport
text: Two flying POKéMON were spotted! / One now travels HOENN's routes. The other rests on SOUTHERN ISLAND. / Which color did you hear about on the mainland: red or blue?$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_LatiReportReady
text: Red is LATIAS; blue is LATIOS. / Watch the routes for your choice, and sail to meet the other!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
text: Yo, how's it going, CHAMPION-bound {PLAYER}? / The GYM LEADERS here use PSYCHIC-type POKéMON. / If you go up against them with FIGHTING- or POISON-type POKéMON, they'll inflict horrible damage! / Plus, they'll come at you with outstanding combination attacks. / If you want to win, you'll need to show them how tight you are with your POKéMON. Go for it!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
text: Wow, you're astounding! You're one great TRAINER!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonIntro
text: MAGIC GUARD protects ALAKAZAM from poison damage and hazards. / You'll need a more direct approach!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonDefeat
text: I couldn't read your next move.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonPostBattle
text: MAGIC GUARD doesn't stop paralysis or sleep. Damage isn't everything.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilIntro
text: BRONZONG changes our pace with ROOM. MUSHARNA makes you fear sleep. / Slow doesn't mean harmless!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilDefeat
text: Our timing wasn't enough…$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilPostBattle
text: TRICK ROOM lasts five turns. You can reverse it, or endure until it ends.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeIntro
text: MEOWSTIC's screens shelter METANG. KLEFKI and MR. MIME can slow you down. / Can you keep the pressure on?$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeDefeat
text: Our defenses couldn't hold.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakePostBattle
text: BRICK BREAK removes our screens. Critical hits can bypass them, too.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahIntro
text: BRUXISH bites. MALAMAR gets stronger when SUPERPOWER should weaken it. / Our blades aren't our only weapons!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahDefeat
text: Even our sharpest edge fell short.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahPostBattle
text: Burns hinder my physical attackers. But ESPATHRA attacks another way.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaIntro
text: GOTHITELLE closes the exit. AZELF plots, and then ends the board. / You cannot run from this one!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaDefeat
text: I couldn't keep you in my grasp.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaPostBattle
text: MAGIC BOUNCE returns your hazards and sleep. ESPEON still fears direct hits.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraIntro
text: JYNX starts a countdown. GOTHITELLE makes leaving difficult. / Three turns. Can you find a way out?$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraDefeat
text: The last note belonged to you.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraPostBattle
text: GHOST types can leave SHADOW TAG. SOUNDPROOF blocks PERISH SONG. / A well-timed pivot can escape, too.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaIntro
text: INDEEDEE and SIGILYPH open for us. DONDOZO and TATSUGIRI wait in reserve. / Save an answer for their partnership!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaDefeat
text: Even our reserve plan wasn't enough.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaPostBattle
text: Inside DONDOZO, TATSUGIRI can't be hit. HAZE can clear DONDOZO's boosts.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro
text: METAGROSS resists half of what you own, and MIMIKYU gets a free turn. / Break the disguise early!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateDefeat
text: We ran out of answers.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NatePostBattle
text: Breaking DISGUISE is only a start. MIMIKYU still needs a second answer.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenIntro
text: I am the last door before the twins. / LATIAS endures, DRAGAPULT outruns, and TYRANITAR wears you down. / Prove you belong in there!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenDefeat
text: You've earned your way to the twins.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenPostBattle
text: LATIAS can recover and use CALM MIND. Don't let a long battle favor it.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordIntro
text: PINCURCHIN's terrain doubles RAICHU's speed. ESPATHRA gets faster every turn. / Keep up if you can!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordDefeat
text: We couldn't keep ahead of you.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordPostBattle
text: Replacing ELECTRIC TERRAIN removes RAICHU's SURGE SURFER speed boost.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyIntro
text: FERROTHORN and TOXAPEX do not fall. DELPHOX brings firepower in reserve. / Bring fire, or bring patience!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyDefeat
text: Our patience finally ran out.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyPostBattle
text: TOXAPEX can erase boosts with HAZE. TAUNT can restrict its recovery, too.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasIntro
text: LATIOS moves before you do, and AEGISLASH punishes your reply. / Choose your swing carefully!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasDefeat
text: You found your way past our blades.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasPostBattle
text: INTIMIDATE helps CONTRARY MALAMAR. A burn is a safer way to weaken it.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NeedFeatherBadge
text: TATE: Your path still bends west. LIZA: WINONA awaits in FORTREE. / Return with the FEATHER BADGE, and we'll accept your challenge.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro
text: TATE: We share one board. LIZA: But we can give it two move orders. / TATE: Psychic Terrain denies priority. LIZA: TRICK ROOM punishes speed. / TATE: Break our timing... LIZA: ...before GARDEVOIR takes over.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaDefeat
text: TATE: We shared our strength... LIZA: ...and you still overcame us. / TATE: You earned... LIZA: ...the MIND BADGE.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedMindBadge
text: {PLAYER} received the MIND BADGE from TATE and LIZA.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMindBadgeTakeThis
text: TATE: The MIND BADGE lets your LEVELER train a party up to Lv. 70. / LIZA: It also enables DIVE outside of battle. / TATE: You should also take this, too.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMetagrossite
text: Tate: Metagrossite lets Metagross Mega Evolve. Let it hold the stone.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredTateAndLiza
text: Registered GYM LEADERS TATE & LIZA in the POKéNAV.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPostBattle
text: TATE: The SPACE CENTER detected a wish... LIZA: ...inside METEOR FALLS. Ask STEVEN.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaNeedTwoMons
text: TATE: Hehehe… Were you surprised? / LIZA: That there are two GYM LEADERS? / TATE: Oops, you have only one… LIZA: POKéMON that can battle. / TATE: We can't battle that way! / LIZA: If you want to challenge us, bring some more POKéMON.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
text: MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM / LIZA AND TATE'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPreRematch
text: TATE: POKéMON… LIZA: POKéMON… / TATE: By changing the party's mix… LIZA: The battle style changes. / TATE: But me… LIZA: But me… / TATE: I'll always be with LIZA! LIZA: I'll always be with TATE! / TATE: Our combination… LIZA: We'll show you again and again!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaRematchDefeat
text: TATE: You and your POKéMON… LIZA: It's as if you were siblings!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPostRematch
text: TATE: You can knock us down, but we'll never stay down! / LIZA: Because the two of us, we always support each other!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaRematchNeedTwoMons
text: TATE: You're back again… LIZA: You're back again… / TATE: To give us a rematch. LIZA: To give us a rematch. / TATE: But… LIZA: For our match… / TATE: You brought just one POKéMON! LIZA: You brought just one POKéMON! / TATE: We need you to bring at least… LIZA: Two POKéMON when you come back.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SpaceCenterHandoff
text: TATE: TEAM MAGMA is after the SPACE CENTER's rocket fuel. / LIZA: Please help STEVEN stop them! The SPACE CENTER is east of our GYM.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketLaunchImminent
text: The rocket's launch is imminent!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_SuccessfulLaunchNumber
text: The rocket launched safely! That's launch no. {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HaywireButRocketLaunchImminent
text: I know that things are a little haywire right now, but… / The rocket's launch is imminent!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HaywireButSuccessfulLaunchNumber
text: I know that things are a little haywire right now, but… / The rocket launched safely! That's launch no. {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketLaunchDemandsPerfection
text: A rocket launch demands perfection. Not even a 1% margin of error is allowed. / Even if it's 99% okay, the whole thing is useless if 1% happens to be no good. / Despite that, we never stop trying. Why? It's a dream that never ends.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaHaveSightsOnSpaceCenter
text: Those MAGMA thugs have their sights set on our SPACE CENTER. / But we can't allow anything that minor to interfere with our rocket launch!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_FoundThisYouCanHaveIt
text: I was taking a stroll down the beach when I found this. / It's not anything I need, so you can have it.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HoennFamousForMeteorShowers
text: The HOENN region has been famous for  its meteor showers for a long time.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaCantStealFuelTakeThis
text: TEAM MAGMA can't be allowed to steal the rocket fuel. / Oh, by the way, you can have this stone I found on the beach.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_CantStrollOnBeachWithMagma
text: With TEAM MAGMA around, I guess strolls on the beach aren't safe.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_DidPokemonComeFromSpace
text: Some people claim that POKéMON came from space. Could it be true?$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_AquaShouldBeatMagma
text: TEAM AQUA should take care of TEAM MAGMA! / But if they did that, TEAM AQUA will become bold and brazen, won't they?$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketsBoggleMyMind
text: A giant chunk of metal bursts through the skies and flies into space… / It boggles my mind!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaWantsToSpoilMyDream
text: A giant chunk of metal bursts through the skies and flies into space… / But TEAM MAGMA wants to spoil that dream of mine! / I'm not having any of that!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_StevenMagmaCantBeAllowedToTakeFuel
text: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, have you read that proclamation already? / TEAM MAGMA is coming after the rocket fuel on this island. / I don't know what they'd need it for, but they can't be allowed to take it. / I'll keep an eye on things for a while longer. / In the meantime, why don't you go check out the town?$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3Intro
text: We're here for the rocket fuel, exactly like we announced. MAXIE likes it tidy.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
text: Ran out of fuel…$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
text: Don't think you're on a roll just because you beat me. I'm the warm-up.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: We gave fair warning! Nothing sneaky about TEAM MAGMA! Now, MIGHTYENA!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: Grrr… Next time we try sneaky.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: Okay, I get it. Next time we come unannounced. Write that down.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4Intro
text: The rocket fuel in storage. Every last drop of it. That's the whole plan.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4Defeat
text: Please, can you spare some fuel? Even a chintzy cup?$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
text: What do we DO with rocket fuel? How would I know? Ask the boss upstairs.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
text: MAXIE said nobody gets past me. So nobody gets past me. FLYGON!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: Ack! Ack! Aaack!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: Tell him I never left my post. Tell him I stayed to the end.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaIntentToStealNotice
text: This is… An intent-to-steal notice? / “To the staff of the SPACE CENTER: How are you? We are doing fine. / “We will soon visit you to take your rocket fuel. / “Please don't try to stop us. We will take the fuel no matter what. / “Let there be more land!                                           TEAM MAGMA”$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MossdeepIdealForRockets
text: MOSSDEEP has mainly sunny weather, and its winds are stable. / It's an ideal location for launching rockets.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WhyWouldMagmaStealRocketFuel
text: Why would TEAM MAGMA want to steal our rocket fuel in the first place?$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WouldveLikedToBeAstronaut
text: If only I was a little younger, I would have liked being an astronaut… / No… It's not too late! I can and will try!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MagmaCantGetAwayWithThis
text: If TEAM MAGMA takes the rocket fuel, I won't be able to go to space! / They can't be allowed to get away with such an outrage!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WishOrdinaryPeopleCouldGoIntoSpace
text: I wish ordinary people could go into space one day…$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_DoesMagmaWantToGoToSpace
text: TEAM MAGMA… Do they want to go to space, too?$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_YoureOutnumberedTakeUsOn
text: Three consecutive formations guard this corridor. You still choose to advance?$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_GoodAnswer
text: A sound decision. Recover your team before challenging the full sequence.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt5Intro
text: First formation: establish pressure before you can read the sequence.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt5Defeat
text: First line broken. The sequence holds.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt6Intro
text: Second formation: punish the answer you revealed in the first.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt6Defeat
text: You changed plans between battles…$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7Intro
text: Final formation: exploit the damage the first two left behind. No reset.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7Defeat
text: Your team endured the whole sequence…$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt6PostBattle
text: Three battles should expose every answer. You kept finding new ones.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7PostBattle
text: Attrition favored us. Adaptation favored you.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
text: MAXIE's model did not account for a team that improves while being worn down.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WellTakeCareOfYou
text: You broke the corridor and reached the launch floor. That ends here. / Our final formation protects MAXIE and the fuel at the same time.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieDontInterfere
text: MAXIE: The calculation has reached its final input. Do not interfere.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenWhyStealRocketFuel
text: STEVEN: Rocket fuel cannot control GROUDON. What are you truly targeting?$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieUseFuelToEruptVolcano
text: MAXIE: The rocket fuel will blast open MT. CHIMNEY. New land will rise across HOENN. / GROUDON would not obey. I will finish what it began myself.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenAreYouReadyToBattle
text: STEVEN: {PLAYER}! We fight together. Their formation is built for two targets. / Are you ready to break it as partners?$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenHurryGetReadyQuickly
text: STEVEN: Then, hurry! Get ready quickly!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_JustWantToExpandLand
text: All I want… I just want to expand the land mass…$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_Text_TabithaDefeat
text: The launch angle collapsed…$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_TabithaIntro
text: TABITHA: The rocket needs a stable base. / My sand formation will pin both of your POKéMON before you reach MAXIE.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_TabithaAfter
text: You broke the foundation, but the real launch sequence is still ahead.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_TabithaNotEnoughMons
text: A formation requires two usable POKéMON. Return when both can battle.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_Text_CourtneyDefeat
text: Joint model... broken by partnership.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_CourtneyFormation
text: COURTNEY: MAXIE supplies force. I supply the alternate clock. STEVEN is accounted for. You remain the unstable variable.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieWeFailedIsAquaAlsoMisguided
text: MAXIE: Again, your partnership adapted while my certainty narrowed. / We failed to control GROUDON, and now we would destroy what refused control. / If MAGMA's premise is wrong, then AQUA's opposite certainty must be wrong as well.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieWeWillGiveUp
text: MAXIE: Keep the fuel. I must find GROUDON before ARCHIE repeats the same mistake.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenThankYouComeSeeMeAtHome
text: STEVEN: That was true doubles play: each of us made the other's options better. / Come to my home west of the GYM. I have the HM DIVE for you. / We can use it to follow AQUA's stolen submarine.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice
text: Yo! How's it going, CHAMPION- bound {PLAYER}? / SOOTOPOLIS's GYM LEADER JUAN is a master of WATER-type POKéMON. / And, to get to JUAN, an icy floor will hamper your progress… / Listen, I'm sorry, but that's all the advice that I have for you. / The rest of the way, you have to go for it yourself!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
text: Yow! You've beaten even JUAN, who was supposedly the best in all HOENN! / Okay! Check out your TRAINER CARD. / If you've gotten all the BADGES, you're set for the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro
text: I am JUAN, WALLACE's mentor, keeper of SOOTOPOLIS's final examination. / You calmed one impossible rain. Now face rain used deliberately: speed, endurance and growing power. / Artistry gives each choice purpose. Show me yours.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanDefeat
text: Excellent! A victory to be proud of. / Take the RAIN BADGE. WALLACE will ask even more of your team.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ReceivedRainBadge
text: {PLAYER} received the RAIN BADGE from JUAN.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainRainBadgeTakeThis
text: The RAIN BADGE lets your LEVELER train a party up to Lv. 80. / It also enables WATERFALL to scale walls of cascading water. / With all eight BADGES, HOENN's last doors open: VICTORY ROAD, and the LEAGUE beyond it. / And, so that you never forget the battle we shared, take this…$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainGyaradosite
text: Gyaradosite lets Gyarados Mega Evolve. Let it hold the stone in battle. / SURF east from ROUTE 128 to EVER GRANDE. Use WATERFALL at the city's entrance.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_RegisteredJuan
text: Registered GYM LEADER JUAN in the POKéNAV.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostBattle
text: Eight BADGES open EVER GRANDE. Its challenge is five master teams in a row. / SURF east from ROUTE 128 to EVER GRANDE. Use WATERFALL at the city's entrance. / You may heal with your BAG between rooms, but never use items inside their battles.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_NeedMindBadge
text: There remains but one BADGE to obtain in HOENN. / If you wish to challenge the POKéMON LEAGUE, first earn the MIND BADGE from the GYM in MOSSDEEP.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatue
text: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatueCertified
text: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM / JUAN'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPreRematch
text: JUAN: Ah, this GYM had returned to its usual state of serenity… / But our young typhoon has returned to put us to the test again! / Well, my friend, most certainly! / I shall be delighted to dance with you as often as you wish!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchDefeat
text: Ahahaha, you are the winner! You have defeated me again!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostRematch
text: JUAN: If I told you to become my apprentice, you will refuse, I am sure. / I would like to make a gift of my coat to you. / But again, you will refuse. I imagine that to be so. / And that, my friend, is a certain sign of nobility!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchNeedTwoMons
text: JUAN: Ah, this GYM had returned to its usual state of serenity… / But our young typhoon has returned to put us to the test again! / Well, my friend, most certainly! I shall be delighted to dance with you… / Ah, no, no, no. You have with you but one POKéMON. / I wish that you would return with two, perhaps more, POKéMON, please.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaIntro
text: I'll show you the sublime techniques I learned from our LEADER JUAN!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaDefeat
text: Please forgive me, JUAN…$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaPostBattle
text: Watch what happens if you crack all the floor tiles.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyIntro
text: You came all the way here, but you won't get to see JUAN. / Not if you lose to me, you won't!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyDefeat
text: You're strong! I was fooled by your cute looks!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyPostBattle
text: You might be good enough to avoid being wiped out in one hit by JUAN.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneIntro
text: The sight of JUAN conducting a battle… / The very beauty of it compelled me to become a TRAINER.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneDefeat
text: You battled with more beauty than I could muster…$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphnePostBattle
text: The grace you bring to battle is fabulous. / Oh… I'm so fortunate to have found POKéMON.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConnieIntro
text: I should teach you how harsh battles can be.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConnieDefeat
text: Oh. You're strong.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConniePostBattle
text: I'll tell you something good. / If you want to reach JUAN, you need to walk on each floor tile once.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetIntro
text: The POKéMON GYM of the highest level in the HOENN region… / That's the SOOTOPOLIS GYM.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetDefeat
text: What a high level you are!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetPostBattle
text: Rather than being satisfied by being in a strong GYM, I imagine training in other places will make you stronger. But above all, it looks more fun.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaIntro
text: I train my POKéMON together with JUAN. / Don't think I'm a pushover.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaDefeat
text: I was beaten…$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaPostBattle
text: I think you have potential. Why don't you stay and train with us?$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyIntro
text: A graceful glide across the ice while crossing no lines… / A TRAINER putting on that performance would be elegantly beautiful!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyDefeat
text: Well, excuse me?!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyPostBattle
text: This is really obvious, but how strong you are as a TRAINER has nothing to do with how young or old you are.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyIntro
text: When I'm with my POKéMON, the time flies by before you can say, “Oops!”$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyDefeat
text: Oops!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyPostBattle
text: I wish I could forget about lost causes before I can manage an “Oops!”$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaIntro
text: I can battle with really rare POKéMON if you'd like.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaDefeat
text: Oh, there now! Did you have a good look at my POKéMON?$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaPostBattle
text: I came to this GYM because JUAN praised me for my darling POKéMON. / Oh, if only I'd met JUAN years ago when I was younger…$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaIntro
text: Giggle… Your grim look is so charming.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaDefeat
text: Oh, dear. I went much too easy on you.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaPostBattle
text: You couldn't lay a finger on JUAN, I'm sure. Giggle…$

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WallaceToughestInHoenn
text: WALLACE is rumored to be the toughest TRAINER in the whole HOENN region. / This town's GYM is led by the TRAINER who taught WALLACE. / But the ELITE FOUR… They're said to be even stronger than WALLACE's mentor. / How strong could they be?$

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EveryoneTakenRefuge
text: Everyone in town has taken refuge and won't come out of their homes. / Even I would rather not venture outside.$

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AlwaysBeFriendsWithPokemon
text: Whenever, wherever, and whatever happens, I will always be friends with POKéMON. / Because it's fun to be with POKéMON!$

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ArentPokemonOurFriends
text: Aren't POKéMON our friends? / Why are they going wild this way?$

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_PPUpIsGreat
text: PP UP is great! / It raises the POWER POINTS, the PP, of a POKéMON move.$

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_TooScaryOutside
text: What… What is happening? / I really want to know, but it's too scary to go outside.$

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_FullRestoreItemOfDreams
text: Do you know FULL RESTORE? / Full restoration of HP! Eradication of all status problems! / It's truly an item of your dreams!$

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_DidSomethingAwaken
text: This weather… Did something awaken?$

label: SootopolisCity_House1_Text_FoundThisRazorClaw
text: For thirty years I've remained in SOOTOPOLIS honing my skills. / This RAZOR CLAW is just as sharp. I bequeath it to you!$

label: SootopolisCity_House1_Text_ExplainRazorClaw
text: A Razor Claw evolves Sneasel. Use it at night when ready.$

label: SootopolisCity_House1_Text_Kecleon
text: KECLEON: Puu puhyaah.$

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_MoveSpecialist
text: I once taught DRACO METEOR only to DRAGONS that trusted their TRAINER. / The CENTER specialist now handles every legal competitive move.$

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_DidYouKnowAboutMtPyreOrbs
text: MT. PYRE… / At its peak are two orbs placed side by side. Did you know?$

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_YesTwoOrbsSideBySide
text: Yes, two orbs side by side… / The sight of them together… It is somehow soothing…$

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_OughtToVisitAndSee
text: Is that so? Perhaps you ought to visit and see…$

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_JuanHasManyFansDoYou
text: You're a POKéMON TRAINER, aren't you? / SOOTOPOLIS's JUAN has many fans. Even more than his student WALLACE! / Do you have any?$

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_YouMustBePrettyStrong
text: Oh, then you must be pretty strong.$

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_LonesomeTryWorkingHarder
text: Oh, dear… That's a little lonesome. / Try working a little harder to get a fan following.$

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_TrainerFanClubWasWild
text: Dedicated fans come over from even outside of HOENN. / It was really wild when I went to the TRAINER FAN CLUB in LILYCOVE.$

label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_AncientTreasuresWaitingInSea
text: Listen up, and I'll tell you something good. / There's supposed to be an ancient ruin in the sea around here. / There could be treasures just waiting to be discovered down there.$

label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_StrollUnderwaterWithPokemon
text: Ancient treasures… / It would be nice if they existed, but even if they didn't, it would be so beautiful to take an underwater stroll with my POKéMON.$

label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_Azumarill
text: AZUMARILL: Marurii.$

label: SootopolisCity_House5_Text_SootopolisMtPyreConnection
text: There appears to be some connection between SOOTOPOLIS and MT. PYRE. / My friends and I did some research on it at the lab where I used to work.$

label: SootopolisCity_House5_Text_BrotherUsedToStudySea
text: My big brother used to study the sea.$

label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_FirstGuestInWhileTakeDoll
text: Hello! You're our first guest in a good while. / You've brightened up my day, so I'll give you a big WAILMER DOLL.$

label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_TakeGoodCareOfIt
text: Take good care of it!$

label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_IllHoldItForYou
text: Oh, you want it, but not right now? Okay, then I'll hold it for you.$

label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_DontWantThisDoll
text: Are you sure? You don't want this DOLL?$

label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_LovePlushDolls
text: I love plush DOLLS!$

label: SootopolisCity_House7_Text_CityFromEruptedVolcano
text: An underwater volcano erupted and forced itself up from the depths. / Its crater emerged from the sea and became filled with rainwater. / That's how SOOTOPOLIS CITY came into being.$

label: SootopolisCity_House7_Text_CaveMadeToKeepSomething
text: The cave that links SOOTOPOLIS and the outside world… / It seems as if the cave was made to keep something from getting out. / Or am I just imagining things?$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigSeedot
text: Do you know the POKéMON SEEDOT? It's hardly ever seen in SOOTOPOLIS. / Anyway, I love big SEEDOT. The bigger the better. / But my younger brother, he says that LOTAD is bigger. / That's silly. SEEDOT has to be bigger than that! / Huh? Do you have a SEEDOT with you? P-p-please, show me!$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_GoshMightBeBiggerThanLotad
text: {STR_VAR_2}! Oh, my gosh, this is a big one! / It might even beat the big LOTAD my younger brother saw! / Thanks for showing me. This is my thanks!$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_ReceivedPotion1
text: {PLAYER} received a POTION.$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BagCrammedFull1
text: Hunh? Your BAG is crammed full.$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_SeenBiggerSeedot
text: {STR_VAR_2}, is it? / Hmm… I've seen a bigger SEEDOT than this one.$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_ThatsNotSeedot
text: Oh, now this is quite something… But it's not a SEEDOT!$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_DontHaveBigSeedot
text: You don't have a big SEEDOT? That's too bad… / If you get a big SEEDOT, please come show me.$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BiggestSeedotInHistory
text: The biggest SEEDOT in history! {STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3} giant! / A SEEDOT bigger than a LOTAD always wanted!$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigLotad
text: Do you know the POKéMON LOTAD? It's rarely seen in SOOTOPOLIS. / I love, I mean love, big LOTAD! / My big brother says that SEEDOT is bigger. / But that's wrong! Everyone knows that LOTAD is a lot bigger. / Hunh? Do you have a LOTAD? P-p-please show me!$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_WowMightBeBiggerThanSeedot
text: {STR_VAR_2}! Wow, that is big! / It might be even bigger than the huge SEEDOT my big brother saw. / Thanks for showing me! This is my thanks!$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_ReceivedPotion2
text: {PLAYER} received a POTION.$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BagCrammedFull2
text: Hunh? Your BAG is crammed full.$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_SeenBiggerLotad
text: {STR_VAR_2}? / Hmm… I've seen a bigger LOTAD than this one here.$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_ThatsNotLotad
text: Well, isn't this something! But it's no LOTAD!$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_DontHaveBigLotad
text: Don't you have a big LOTAD? How disappointing… / If you get a big LOTAD, please come show me!$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BiggestLotadInHistory
text: The biggest LOTAD in history! {STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3} colossus! / A LOTAD bigger than a SEEDOT always wanted!$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_OnlyAmusementWatchingBattles
text: When I was young, I traveled the world as a POKéMON TRAINER. / Now that I've become an old buzzard, my only amusement is watching young TRAINERS battle.$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_DoorAppearsToBeLocked
text: The door appears to be locked.$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_ChallengeVisitingTrainer
text: A TRAINER named {STR_VAR_1} is visiting my home. / Would you like to challenge {STR_VAR_1}?$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_YouWontBattle
text: You won't battle? I'm disappointed that I can't see you battle…$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_KeepItTo3On3
text: Oh, good, good! / But my house isn't all that sturdy. / Could I ask you to keep it down to a 3-on-3 match?$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_SaveProgressBeforeBattle
text: Before you two battle, you should save your progress.$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_HopeToSeeGoodMatch
text: I hope to see a good match!$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_StrVar1Tie
text: {STR_VAR_1}$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_B1F_Text_MatchEndedUpDraw
text: The match ended up a draw.$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_BrilliantStandoff
text: So, it became a standoff. / It was a brilliant match in which neither side conceded a step!$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_StrVar1Won
text: {STR_VAR_1}$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_ThatWasSuperlative
text: That was superlative! / Why, it was like seeing myself in my youth again!$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_StrVar1Lost
text: {STR_VAR_1}$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_TooBadForYou
text: Ah, too bad for you! / But it was a good match. I hope you can win next time.$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_CurrentBattles
text: I still enjoy a fine Pokémon battle. These old visitor records bring back good memories. / For a new challenge, seek the League or the Frontier's CHAMPIONS CIRCUIT.$

label: EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
text: Heh. SIDNEY. First door, best door. / My crew fights dirty. Fake Out, sleep, TAILWIND to keep you chasing. You'll think you've read it. / Then ABSOL shows up and the reading was wrong. Let's go, kid!$

label: EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_Defeat
text: Ha! You got the better of my crew. That was a good time.$

label: EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
text: Patch up from your BAG if you want. / PHOEBE's next. Her idea of “safe” is not gonna match yours.$

label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
text: Welcome. I am PHOEBE. / I trained on MT. PYRE, where the ones who are gone still take part. / My friends can steal your boosts and wear down your strength with burns. / Keep something for SPECTRIER. Each knockout can make it stronger.$

label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_Defeat
text: You honored what you could not touch. My grandmother would like you.$

label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
text: Rest a moment if you need to. / GLACIA can shelter her team with AURORA VEIL. Prepare for her snow.$

label: EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
text: GLACIA. I came far for opponents worth the cold. / Snow is patience. The VEIL buys time, the wind rearranges order, and one powerful Dragon waits behind it. / Changing the weather is one answer. But the VEIL can outlast the snow.$

label: EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_Defeat
text: …Your team weathered the battle. Acceptable.$

label: EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
text: DRAKE is old, and his Dragons are not all alike. Study each one.$

label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
text: DRAKE. Last of the four, and the one who's sailed the longest. / Dragons remember every age of battle. SALAMENCE can bring a TAILWIND. / KORAIDON brings sunlight for RESHIRAM's flames. / Keep something for MEGA GARCHOMP. Come on!$

label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_Defeat
text: Hah! My Dragons gave you everything. Superb, Trainer. Superb.$

label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
text: Heal up. Beyond that door WALLACE will throw every lesson at you at once. / Go on. The CHAMPION's waiting.$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
text: WALLACE: Welcome, {PLAYER}. / Across HOENN, moves, items and rare partners offered new possibilities. Mega Evolution opened even more. / You restored SOOTOPOLIS's balance and beat the ELITE FOUR under the LEAGUE's battle rules. / Now face the region's complete exam. My team is ready. Is yours? / Show me the Champion you became!$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat
text: You have beaten my finest team. Magnificent!$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
text: WALLACE: This victory belongs to you and the partners who brought you here. / Every choice along the way helped shape the TRAINER before me. / You stand at HOENN's peak, but the FRONTIER waits beyond the summit. / I proclaim you the new HOENN CHAMPION!$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayAdvice
text: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! One thing before WALLACE. / Watch his remaining partners. A strong opening isn't the whole battle.$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayItsAlreadyOver
text: MAY: Huh? Wait. Your face… / {PLAYER}{KUN}… It's already over, isn't it?$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanAdvice
text: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}! Advice before WALLACE, if you want it. / Watch his remaining partners. Don't let a winning turn distract you.$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanYouveWon
text: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}… / Don't tell me. You already beat him.$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
text: BIRCH: You did it, {PLAYER}! / You began with one of nine traditions, then made HOENN's whole ecosystem yours. / Let me see the POKéDEX that recorded all those possible teams.$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchCongratulations
text: BIRCH: Congratulations. The final room records one team; HOENN remembers all.$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceComeWithMe
text: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}… / No, let me rephrase that properly. / The new CHAMPION! / Come with me.$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceWaitOutside
text: WALLACE: I'm sorry, but… / From here on, only those TRAINERS who have become CHAMPIONS may enter. / You'll have to wait outside with PROF. BIRCH.$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayCongratulations
text: MAY: Groan… / … … … … … … … … / Kidding! That's the rule, and you earned every part of it. / {PLAYER}{KUN}! Honestly, congratulations!$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanCongratulations
text: BRENDAN: Whaaaat?! … … … … … / Fine. That's the rule, and I watched you earn it. / {PLAYER}, way to go! Congratulations!$

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_MustHaveAllGymBadges
text: Beyond this point, only those TRAINERS who have collected all the GYM BADGES are permitted to enter. / TRAINER, let us confirm that you have all the GYM BADGES.$

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_HaventObtainedAllBadges
text: You need all eight GYM BADGES. / If you're bound for the POKéMON LEAGUE, you must return with them.$

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_GoForth
text: TRAINER! Believe in yourself and your POKéMON, and go forth!$

label: EverGrandeCity_HallOfFame_Text_HereWeHonorLeagueChampions
text: WALLACE: This room… / This is where we keep records of POKéMON that prevailed through harsh battles. / It is here that the LEAGUE CHAMPIONS are honored.$

label: EverGrandeCity_HallOfFame_Text_LetsRecordYouAndYourPartnersNames
text: WALLACE: Come on, let's record your name as a TRAINER who triumphed over the POKéMON LEAGUE, and the names of the partners who battled with you.$

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LeagueAfterVictoryRoad
text: The POKéMON LEAGUE is only a short distance after the VICTORY ROAD. / If you've come this far, what choice do you have but to keep going?$

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BelieveInYourPokemon
text: The long and harrowing VICTORY ROAD… / It's like reliving the path one has traveled in life… / Believe in your POKéMON and give it your very best!$

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ScottHappyForYou
text: SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, you've clawed your way up to face the POKéMON LEAGUE! / I'm happy for you! You made my cheering worthwhile! / {PLAYER}{KUN}, if you were to become the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION… / I'll get in touch with you then. / Okay, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Go for greatness!$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_RivalAfterBattleRestored
text: MAGMA took the METEORITE toward MT. CHIMNEY. We have to follow. / Take ROUTE 112's cable car up to the summit.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_WithThisMeteorite
text: The METEORITE is secured. Its energy will feed MAXIE's machine at MT. CHIMNEY!$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_DontExpectMercyFromMagma
text: COURTNEY: You crossed our operation twice. Coincidence is no longer likely. / This formation will remove you from MAXIE's equation.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_CourtneyDefeat
text: You broke our celestial formation…$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_GruntDefeat
text: Even the meteor team failed?!$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_HoldItRightThereMagma
text: Hold it, TEAM MAGMA! If you set off that volcano, the whole coast will suffer!$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BeSeeingYouTeamAqua
text: COURTNEY: AQUA arrived sooner than projected. The result is unchanged. / We have the METEORITE. MAXIE is already preparing the machine at MT. CHIMNEY. / Follow us if you want to see the land rise.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefore
text: ARCHIE: We met at SLATEPORT's MUSEUM. {PLAYER}, wasn't it? / I mistook you for one of MAGMA's crew. You proved you choose your own current. / MAXIE thinks every living system can be measured, fixed, and made obedient. / Now he means to force that certainty through MT. CHIMNEY. / AQUA will stop him. If you value a world that can still change, follow us.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BossWeShouldChaseMagma
text: BOSS, we should give chase to TEAM MAGMA…$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieYesNoTellingWhatMagmaWillDo
text: ARCHIE: We move now. / If MAGMA drives that METEORITE into the fault line, the mountain answers first.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieFarewell
text: ARCHIE: {PLAYER}, come to MT. CHIMNEY. Take the cable car on ROUTE 112. / You have already changed this race.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo
text: I'm PROF. COZMO. MAGMA asked me to study the METEORITE's energy. / I thought it was geological research. They took the sample and my readings. / That energy could trigger an eruption at MT. CHIMNEY. People and POKéMON would lose their homes!$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_WhatsTeamMagmaDoingAtMtChimney
text: PROF. COZMO: MAGMA plans to use the METEORITE to power a machine at the volcano. / Please stop them before it erupts! ROUTE 112's cable car goes to MT. CHIMNEY's summit.$

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_StoneInPC
text: {PLAYER} put the {STR_VAR_2} in the PC.$

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_StoneStorageFull
text: Your BAG and PC have no room for the remaining stone. I'll keep it here. / Make some room, then speak to me again. Your gift will still be here.$

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ImStevenLetterForMe
text: I'm STEVEN. Forgive me, I didn't hear you come in. / Rare POKéMON have been seeking shelter in these caves. Their movements seem to follow the unusual weather. / I'm trying to understand why. Oh? A LETTER from my father?$

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ThankYouTakeThis
text: You've earned BRAWLY's trust. And you came all this way to find me. Thank you. / Take this MEGA RING. With a matching stone, one partner can Mega Evolve during a battle. / Have your partner hold its stone. Choose FIGHT, then press START before you choose a move. / A strong bond helps your team bring out that power.$

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_NoStarterStone
text: Your original partners have no applicable Mega Stone here. / Your other teammates can carry one!$

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ArchiveOpen
text: The RING lets your partners use the Mega Stones you find across HOENN. / Look for their glimmer off the path. People may have stones to share, too. / POKéMON CENTER VENDORS still offer evolution items free of charge.$

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ReturnWithKnuckleBadge
text: The LETTER confirms it: unusual weather is driving rare POKéMON into new hiding places. / Challenge BRAWLY at DEWFORD GYM. Come back with the KNUCKLE BADGE.$

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_FindBrawlyInSlateport
text: BRAWLY is visiting SLATEPORT. Look outside the OCEANIC MUSEUM for him. / You've delivered my LETTER, so ask MR. BRINEY at the dock to sail there. / Find BRAWLY, then return to DEWFORD. I'll wait here for your KNUCKLE BADGE.$

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_CouldBecomeChampionLetsRegister
text: A journey teaches you things you cannot learn in a laboratory. / Let's register each other in the POKéNAV. I'll keep studying these unusual POKéMON sightings.$

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_RegisteredSteven
text: Registered STEVEN in the POKéNAV.$

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_SternHandoff
text: Now take DEVON's GOODS to CAPT. STERN in SLATEPORT CITY. / Ask MR. BRINEY at DEWFORD's dock to sail you there. / The SHIPYARD staff in SLATEPORT can tell you where to find the captain.$

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_IveGotToHurryAlong
text: I'm heading east. MAGMA and AQUA are disturbing more than land and sea. / With the STONE BADGE, COBALION can appear among wild POKéMON on GRANITE CAVE B2F. / It has a 1% chance. SWEET SCENT increases that to 25%. / DEVON's researcher lists the other legendary locations and requirements.$

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_OhBagIsFull
text: Your BAG is full. Make room and return; I will keep the MEGA RING safe.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_NotAOneToBeFound
text: Hmmm… Not a one to be found…$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HaveYouSeenShroomish
text: Oh, hello! Have you seen a SHROOMISH around here? I've always loved them. / I'm on my way back to DEVON in RUSTBORO. I thought I could spare a little time…$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IWasGoingToAmbushYou
text: I was going to ambush you, but you had to dawdle in PETALBURG WOODS forever, didn't you? / I got sick of waiting, so here I am!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HandOverThosePapers
text: You! DEVON RESEARCHER! / Hand over those papers!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YouHaveToHelpMe
text: Please, help me! / These papers belong to DEVON. I can't let him take them!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_NoOneCrossesTeamAqua
text: Hunh? What do you think you're doing? What, you're going to protect him? / No one who crosses TEAM AQUA gets any mercy, not even a kid! / Come on and battle me!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YoureKiddingMe
text: You're kidding me! You're tough!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YouveGotSomeNerve
text: Grrr… You've got some nerve meddling with TEAM AQUA! Come on and battle me again! / I wish I could say that, but I'm out of POKéMON… / And, hey, we of TEAM AQUA are also after something in RUSTBORO. / I'll let you go today!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ThatWasAwfullyClose
text: Whew… I thought he'd caught me. Thank you for standing up to him. / I must get these papers back to DEVON. But first, take this GREAT BALL. / It's the least I can do!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TeamAquaAfterSomethingInRustboro
text: He said TEAM AQUA was after something in RUSTBORO, too, didn't he? / My colleagues could be in trouble.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ICantBeWastingTime
text: I need to warn everyone at DEVON. No more looking for SHROOMISH today!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YoureLoadedWithItems
text: You're loaded with items. I can't give you this GREAT BALL.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_GoBugPokemonTeam
text: I caught a whole bunch of POKéMON! / Go, go, go! My BUG POKéMON team!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ICouldntWin
text: I have all these POKéMON, but I couldn't win…$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ImOutOfPokeBalls
text: I caught a bunch of POKéMON. Now I'm out of POKé BALLS.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_InstantlyPopularWithBugPokemon
text: If you take BUG POKéMON to school, you get to be instantly popular!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_CantBePopularIfILose
text: I can't be popular if I lose.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_PeopleRespectYou
text: If you have a big BUG POKéMON, people respect you for it.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch1
text: I want to tell you when my BUG POKéMON grow up! / I'm registering you in my POKéNAV!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch2
text: I want to tell you when my BUG POKéMON grow up! / I'm registering you in my POKéNAV!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_MyPokemonHaveGrown
text: My BUG POKéMON have grown. I'll be popular again.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_CantBePopularIfLose
text: I can't be popular if I lose.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IveBeenTrainingHard
text: You get to be popular if you have strong POKéMON, right? So, I've been training hard.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_StayOutOfTallGrass
text: Yo, there! Your POKéMON doing okay? / If your POKéMON are weak and you want to avoid battles, you should stay out of tall grass.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HiddenItemsExplanation
text: BURMY hide among these leaves. Females become WORMADAM at Lv. 20; males become MOTHIM at the same level. / After a battle, BURMY makes a cloak from its surroundings: leaves in grass, sand in caves, or trash in buildings. / Raise DARTRIX to Lv. 34 or higher here to get Hisuian DECIDUEYE. Elsewhere, it grows into the usual form.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TryUsingThisItem
text: Oh, neat! That's the BADGE from RUSTBORO GYM! / You must be a TRAINER. You should try using this item.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TartAppleExplanation
text: It's a TART APPLE. Use it to evolve the right APPLIN. / Evolution items reward exploring even when battle gear is easy to obtain.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsExperience
text: TRAINER TIPS / Use the LEVELER to bring a new partner to your current training limit. / Then prepare its moves, Ability, Nature, and held item before the next battle.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsPP
text: FOREST FIELD NOTES / CUT opens paths into the deeper forest. With the STONE BADGE, CELEBI can appear in the third area. / The KNUCKLE BADGE adds VIRIZION in the second area. The HEAT BADGE adds WO-CHIEN there. / Each is a 1% wild encounter. SWEET SCENT gives a 25% chance of an available local legendary.$

label: MtChimney_Text_MeteoriteWillActivateVolcano
text: The METEORITE will drive this volcano's energy into the fault line. / Caverns will open beneath HOENN, and the land will rise!$

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro
text: MAXIE: ARCHIE's unexpected ally. I prefer problems with clear solutions. / The sea changes without permission. Land gives people room to build and grow. / This machine will awaken the power beneath MT. CHIMNEY. HOENN will have all the land it needs. / You may test my team. You will not stop my work.$

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieDefeat
text: You found the flaw before I could stabilize the field...$

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieYouHaventSeenLastOfMagma
text: MAXIE: The METEORITE was one input, not the plan itself. The BLUE ORB remains. / You stopped this eruption, but the fault line is already moving beneath HOENN.$

label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaIntro
text: TABITHA: You followed the METEORITE. Good. You understand the real objective. / MAXIE already has it. My formation only needs to keep you from his machine.$

label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaDefeat
text: You broke the guard line too quickly…$

label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaPostBattle
text: MAXIE, begin the fault-line sequence! The delay model has failed.$

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt2Intro
text: Stable land means homes, roads, and room for people to build a future. / That is why I chose TEAM MAGMA. You will not interrupt the work.$

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: My certainty cracked first…$

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: MAXIE promised a safer world. / If the method frightens everyone it is meant to help, what did we misjudge?$

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: This ridge could become solid ground, not a threat hanging over LAVARIDGE. / I believe in that future enough to defend it.$

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: Belief was not enough to hold the line…$

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: You came through fire to challenge us. Maybe certainty is not the same as truth.$

label: MtChimney_Text_TeamAquaAlwaysMessingWithPlans
text: AQUA keeps changing the field before our formation can stabilize it.$

label: MtChimney_Text_MeteoritesPackAmazingPower
text: The METEORITE resonates with the fault!$

label: MtChimney_Text_YouBetterNotMessWithUs
text: Stand back! We are forcing the mountain into a stable state for everyone.$

label: MtChimney_Text_AquasNameSimilar
text: MAGMA builds fixed ground. AQUA trusts change without limits. / Do not confuse opposite answers.$

label: MtChimney_Text_DouseThemInFire
text: Hold the high ground! Do not let AQUA reach the machine!$

label: MtChimney_Text_KeepMakingMoreLand
text: We will make the fault line hold!$

label: MtChimney_Text_Bufoh
text: The line is holding!$

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieGoStopTeamMagma
text: ARCHIE: {PLAYER}! MAXIE is forcing the METEORITE into the volcano's fault line. / If it breaks, fire will tear through the mountain and every connected cavern.$

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieIHaveMyHandsFull
text: ARCHIE: Grrr… / I want to stop that MAXIE, but I can't! / Not when I have my hands full battling three opponents at once!$

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieThankYou
text: ARCHIE: You stopped him. I owe you that. / But do not confuse AQUA with MAGMA. We would free the old current, not cage it. / Take JAGGED PASS down to LAVARIDGE. Your next GYM is there. / That METEORITE is still in the machine. COZMO in FALLARBOR may want it back. / If you stand in our way again, I will expect an even better battle.$

label: MtChimney_Text_MagmaOutnumbersUs
text: MAGMA fixed every approach at once. We cannot break their formation!$

label: MtChimney_Text_LessHabitatForWaterPokemon
text: If they seal the currents, every WATER POKéMON below loses its habitat!$

label: MtChimney_Text_MagmasNameSimilar
text: AQUA keeps life moving. MAGMA would freeze the world into one answer.$

label: MtChimney_Text_Bushaa
text: Break their line!$

label: MtChimney_Text_LavaCookiesJust200
text: LAVA COOKIES are MT. CHIMNEY's local specialty. / Try one. It's just ¥200.$

label: MtChimney_Text_ThankYouDear
text: Thank you, dear!$

label: MtChimney_Text_YouveNotGotTheMoney
text: Oh, dear. You can't buy a thing if you've not got the money.$

label: MtChimney_Text_OhFineThen
text: Oh, fine then.$

label: MtChimney_Text_MeteoriteFittedOnMachine
text: A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious machine… / The machine seems to be storing energy in the METEORITE.$

label: MtChimney_Text_RemoveTheMeteorite
text: A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious machine… / Do you want to remove the METEORITE?$

label: MtChimney_Text_PlayerRemovedMeteorite
text: {PLAYER} removed the METEORITE from the mysterious machine.$

label: MtChimney_Text_PlayerLeftMeteorite
text: {PLAYER} left the METEORITE where it was.$

label: MtChimney_Text_MachineMakesNoResponse
text: This mysterious machine… It makes no response whatsoever.$

label: MtChimney_Text_RouteSign
text: {DOWN_ARROW} JAGGED PATH LAVARIDGE TOWN AHEAD$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyIntro
