text: I've been to the hot springs and refreshed my tired bones. Right now I'm feeling strong!$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyDefeat
text: Oh, my goodness. Now, aren't you something!$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyPostBattle
text: Well, well, I've lost. I can't call myself an EXPERT now, can I?$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRegister
text: Thank you, child. It was fun, as if I were battling my own grandchild. / Please, keep in touch and tell me where your journey takes you.$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRematchIntro
text: If you can mesh your heart with those of your POKéMON, why, you should be able to achieve great things.$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRematchDefeat
text: Oh, my goodness. Now, aren't you something!$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyPostRematch
text: Perhaps your heart has become one with the hearts of your POKéMON.$

label: MtChimney_Text_MelissaIntro
text: I've got the fire in me, baby. I can't stand it! I have to battle!$

label: MtChimney_Text_MelissaDefeat
text: Ooh, that was a scorching-hot match!$

label: MtChimney_Text_MelissaPostBattle
text: The heat of MT. CHIMNEY warms me up, baby!$

label: MtChimney_Text_SheilaIntro
text: I've finally made it to MT. CHIMNEY. I want to make my POKéMON battle!$

label: MtChimney_Text_SheilaDefeat
text: The way you battle… It's like a MT. CHIMNEY eruption!$

label: MtChimney_Text_SheilaPostBattle
text: Like I said, I've finally made it to MT. CHIMNEY. It would be a shame if I only do a little sightseeing… / I want to get in some battles and buy COOKIES as souvenirs.$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShirleyIntro
text: Since I bathed in the hot springs, I've been feeling great! I'm sure I'm going to win!$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShirleyDefeat
text: Yowch! I'm getting a chill out of the water.$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShirleyPostBattle
text: I'll have to take another dip in the hot springs. Want to join me? / Just joking!$

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerIntro
text: This is one fine mountain! Plenty of hot people around for company!$

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerDefeat
text: Oh, you're a real firebrand, too!$

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerPostBattle
text: I think I need a dip in LAVARIDGE HOT SPRING with the locals!$

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerRegister
text: I like little fireballs like you. Let me register you in my POKéNAV.$

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerRematchIntro
text: I'm happily surrounded by hot people around these parts. I won't lose!$

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerRematchDefeat
text: Gosh, you're still the same firebrand as before!$

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerPostRematch
text: Actually, it really is hot here. I'm overdressed for these parts.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_DarkraiDormant
text: A dream can calm this nightmare. / After helping the elders, befriend MUNNA or MUSHARNA and return here. / Your Pokédex records the connection. Your partner may stay in the PC.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_DarkraiQuiet
text: The nightmare has lifted. Your encounter with DARKRAI is recorded.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_DarkraiNeedsTrainers
text: A dream can calm this nightmare. / After helping the elders, befriend MUNNA or MUSHARNA and return here. / Your Pokédex records the connection. Your partner may stay in the PC.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_DarkraiNeedsMusharna
text: A dream can calm this nightmare. / After helping the elders, befriend MUNNA or MUSHARNA and return here. / Your Pokédex records the connection. Your partner may stay in the PC.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_DarkraiAwakened
text: DARKRAI emerges from the nightmare mist. Approach it at the summit.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_DarkraiAwaits
text: DARKRAI is still waiting in the nightmare mist at the summit.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_CresseliaAwakened
text: DARKRAI's capture has revealed a new lead: CRESSELIA shelters in the rear B1F room of METEOR FALLS. / With six badges and our ORB, it can appear among wild POKéMON there.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_CresseliaAwaits
text: CRESSELIA can appear among wild POKéMON in METEOR FALLS' rear B1F room, after six badges and our ORB.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_TimeSignDormant
text: DIALGA can appear in METEOR FALLS' main B1F chamber with the MIND BADGE. It needs no dream POKéMON.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_DialgaAwakened
text: With the MIND BADGE, DIALGA can appear among wild POKéMON in the main B1F chamber of METEOR FALLS.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_DialgaAwaits
text: Search the main B1F chamber of METEOR FALLS for DIALGA. SWEET SCENT helps draw out local legends.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_DreamChainComplete
text: Nightmare, dream, and time have all answered you. Their legend is yours.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_MattIntro
text: MATT: Rain does more than boost Water. It heals, redirects Fire, and changes tempo. / Break AQUA's formation before the wind!$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_MattDefeat
text: You kept one answer outside the current.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_MattAfter
text: ARCHIE is beyond us with the RED ORB. If you follow, expect the sea to fight back.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: MAGMA reached the ORBS first, but their fixed formation left a path behind them. / AQUA will take that path and the ORB.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: You changed course inside my attack…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: One current broke. Others still run between you and ARCHIE.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2Intro
text: MAGMA guards one lane and calls it order. AQUA attacks from every open current. / Read this one before it carries you away.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: You found still water inside the rush…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: You keep interfering, but have you decided what the ORBS should protect?$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3Intro
text: We saw you at MT. CHIMNEY. / You reject MAGMA and still pursue AQUA. Then show me the answer you chose.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3Defeat
text: You refused both currents…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
text: The battle still bought ARCHIE time. The RED ORB is already within reach.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4Intro
text: You adapt too freely for MAGMA and question too much for AQUA. / A lone Trainer should not be able to break two organizations. Prove me wrong.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4Defeat
text: You needed neither uniform…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
text: Our crews make ARCHIE's plans possible. Your team did the same for yours.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_ArchieWeGotTheOrbLetsGo
text: ARCHIE: MAXIE took the BLUE ORB. The RED ORB belongs to AQUA now! / The wardens used these ORBS to keep ancient powers asleep. I will use this one to wake the sea. / AQUA, move out!$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_BothOrbsTakenMagmaLeftThis
text: Both ORBS are gone. They were entrusted to us to keep GROUDON and KYOGRE's powers in balance. / MAGMA dropped this EMBLEM. Take it to their hideout in JAGGED PASS. / Ride ROUTE 112's cable car to MT. CHIMNEY, then descend the pass. / Carry the EMBLEM near the odd boulder on the east side. It may open the way. / Stop MAGMA before they awaken something they cannot control.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_MagmaEmblemSentToPC
text: Your KEY ITEMS pocket is full, so the MAGMA EMBLEM was sent to your PC.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_MagmaEmblemWaiting
text: The MAGMA EMBLEM is still waiting for you. Make room and take it now.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_MagmaEmblemNoRoom
text: Both your KEY ITEMS pocket and PC are full. Make room, then speak to me again.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_OrbsHaveBeenTaken
text: The stolen ORBS can awaken GROUDON and KYOGRE. Their powers must never clash again. / Take the MAGMA EMBLEM to JAGGED PASS. Use ROUTE 112's cable car to MT. CHIMNEY, then descend the pass. / Approach the strange boulder on the east side. Find MAGMA before they awaken GROUDON.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreAwakened
text: Oh, my goodness… / You say that both GROUDON and KYOGRE have been awakened? / It is said that the BLUE ORB and the RED ORB quelled the rage of the two POKéMON… / It is also said that the true owner of the ORBS still exists. / However, no one knows who, or what exactly, the ORBS belong to. / It could be a human, or perhaps a POKéMON, but no one knows.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_ThoseTwoMenReturnedOrbs
text: The two men who took the ORBS came back to return them on their own. / Those men… Perhaps they are not so evil after all…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_SuperAncientPokemonTaughtUs
text: The embodiments of the land, sea, and the sky… / That is said to be the identities of the super-ancient POKéMON… / In the same way that we humans and POKéMON have life, our world, too, is alive… / The super-ancient POKéMON have taught us that…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_WillYouHearOutMyTale
text: MT. PYRE is where we calm the spirits of POKéMON that have passed on… / This is a high place where one can see all of HOENN… / The disembodied spirits of POKéMON must find solace here… / Is it coincidence that you are here… / Will you hear out my tale? A tale long told in the HOENN region?$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreTale
text: GROUDON raised the land and KYOGRE carved the sea. Their clash grew until neither could stop. / RAYQUAZA descended and calmed them. The RED and BLUE ORBS were left in our care. / With the FEATHER BADGE, TAPU LELE and Galarian MOLTRES can appear in the outside grass. Receiving our ORB adds YVELTAL. / With the MIND BADGE, GIRATINA can appear on the sixth floor. / Each is a 1% wild encounter. SWEET SCENT gives 25%, shared among the available legends in that area.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_WellThatTooIsFine
text: I see… Well, that, too, is fine…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_HearTheNewLegendOfHoenn
text: The old legend named three great powers. SOOTOPOLIS added a fourth: the Trainer who understood why balance mattered. / Will you hear HOENN's new legend?$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_HoennTrioTale
text: RAYQUAZA restored the balance. You helped HOENN find a way through. / With the MIND BADGE, search the sixth floor for GIRATINA. It has a 1% wild encounter chance. / SWEET SCENT raises its chance to 25%.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_OrbsApart
text: The ORBS were entrusted to us to keep GROUDON and KYOGRE's powers in balance. / Only RAYQUAZA could calm their last clash. I fear we will need its help again.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieHoldItRightThere
text: ARCHIE: Hold it right there.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieSoItWasYou
text: ARCHIE: Fufufu… So it was you, after all.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieBeholdKyogre
text: ARCHIE: KYOGRE, the current before maps, borders, or human permission. / The ocean itself answers your call. Today the sea becomes free again!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieYouMustDisappear
text: You chased us through every changing route and answered every formation. / One final current stands between you and my dream. Survive it if you can.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDefeat
text: You kept your shape while breaking mine.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWithThisRedOrb
text: ARCHIE: You won the battle. The RED ORB still decides the world. / KYOGRE, answer the sea!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_RedOrbShinesByItself
text: The RED ORB suddenly began shining by itself!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhereDidKyogreGo
text: ARCHIE: What?! / I didn't do anything. Why did the RED ORB… / Where did KYOGRE go?$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieAMessageFromOutside
text: ARCHIE: Hm? It's a message from our members outside…$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
text: ARCHIE: Heavy rain? Good. The current is moving exactly as planned. / What? Routes flooded, crews trapped, and the pressure still rising? / No. Freedom was not supposed to erase everything it connected.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhyDidKyogreDisappear
text: ARCHIE: The RED ORB woke KYOGRE, but it never promised me control. / I mistook motion for obedience.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWhatHaveYouWrought
text: MAXIE: ARCHIE, KYOGRE's rain is spreading beyond the coast. GROUDON will answer with its own power. / If they clash, neither the land nor the people you meant to free will survive.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDontGetAllHighAndMighty
text: ARCHIE: Your certainty woke GROUDON! My mistake only mirrors yours. / And the RED ORB should still let me... No. We never understood the ORBS.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWeDontHaveTimeToArgue
text: MAXIE: Blame is another wasted turn. Outside, HOENN is breaking now. / Look at the world our perfect answers created.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieComeOnPlayer
text: MAXIE: {PLAYER}, come on, you have to get out of here, too!$

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
text: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}. STEVEN told me how far you have traveled. / I am WALLACE. I once led the SOOTOPOLIS GYM; JUAN leads it now. / GROUDON and KYOGRE's powers are overwhelming HOENN. Their struggle will consume land and sea alike. / The oldest tale tells of a third power that stopped their clash: RAYQUAZA. / We need its help again. But I do not know where it sleeps...$

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WhereIsRayquaza
text: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, you have walked more of HOENN than any of us. / Do you know where RAYQUAZA is now?$

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_ButWereInCaveOfOrigin
text: WALLACE: The CAVE OF ORIGIN? / But that's right here! I need you to do better than that! / Please, I need you to think about where RAYQUAZA might be right now.$

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_OldLadyDidntMentionThat
text: WALLACE: MT. PYRE? / But when I met the old lady there earlier, she made no mention of it. / I very much doubt that the old lady would try to hide something from me… / {PLAYER}{KUN}, could you think about this more carefully for me?$

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_CantYouRememberSomehow
text: WALLACE: Huh? You don't remember? Hmm… That's a problem… / Can't you remember somehow?$

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WellHeadToSkyPillar
text: WALLACE: The SKY PILLAR! Of course. A place between the sea and sky. / From ROUTE 128, SURF south, then west through ROUTES 129 and 130 to ROUTE 131. / SKY PILLAR is on its north side, east of PACIFIDLOG. I will open the way!$

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_DoorIsClosed
text: The door is closed.$

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_OpenedDoorToSkyPillar
text: WALLACE: Oh, my, I'm terribly sorry! / In my haste, I didn't notice that I'd left you behind! / I've opened the locked door of the SKY PILLAR. / {PLAYER}{KUN}, let's be on our way!$

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_EarthquakeNotMomentToWaste
text: WALLACE: It's an earthquake! / There's not a moment to waste! We've got to hurry!$

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_SituationGettingWorse
text: WALLACE: Hmm… The situation is getting worse…$

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_GotToGoBackForSootopolis
text: WALLACE: The tremors reach even here. We are running out of time! / RAYQUAZA should be farther up. Please reach it while I return to help SOOTOPOLIS. / Everything is in your hands now, {PLAYER}{KUN}.$

label: SkyPillar_Top_Text_RayquazaFlewOff
text: RAYQUAZA flew toward SOOTOPOLIS!$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_CourtneyIntro
text: COURTNEY: Prediction: you will target the sun before noticing the split pressure. / Let us measure how quickly you correct.$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_CourtneyDefeat
text: Correction arrived before failure. Noted.$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_CourtneyAfter
text: MAXIE values certainty. You keep proving that adaptation is also measurable.$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_AdminsStillStanding
text: COURTNEY and TABITHA still hold this chamber. Face both before MAXIE.$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11Intro
text: MAXIE promised solid ground under every home in HOENN. I believe him. / MANDIBUZZ taunts, MAMOSWINE crushes. You will not reach the chamber.$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11Defeat
text: You moved before my TAUNT mattered…$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11PostBattle
text: None of us have seen GROUDON. MAXIE keeps it behind the last door. / I wonder if certainty needs a door.$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12Intro
text: Sun, sand, and GARCHOMP's stone. MAXIE built this formation for one outcome. / Soon! Very soon our ground will hold!$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12Defeat
text: The formation had one answer, and you found the other…$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12PostBattle
text: MAXIE, sir! An intruder is headed for the chamber!$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13Intro
text: AMOONGUSS pulls your attacks. RHYPERIOR turns the ones that land into power. / You're not getting by me easily!$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13Defeat
text: You hit the slot I left open…$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13PostBattle
text: Go on, then. Tell MAXIE the ground moved under us too.$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaIntro
text: TABITHA: Every chamber behind you was built to make one approach predictable. / MAXIE is already with GROUDON. I only need to make your last answer too slow.$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaDefeat
text: Your last answer was faster than my model allowed…$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaPostBattle
text: Every minute you spent on me was one more MAXIE had with GROUDON. / Go and see what certainty awakened.$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieAwakenGroudon
text: MAXIE: GROUDON, ancient architect of continents... accept the BLUE ORB. / The mountain shakes with your power. Rise, and give HOENN land that will never yield!$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieGroudonWhatsWrong
text: MAXIE: GROUDON! The model was exact. Why did the ORB make you reject me? / Where are you going?$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieOhItWasYou
text: MAXIE: You again. GROUDON fled before you touched the machine. / Then prove the error is mine, not yours.$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieDefeat
text: What makes you so adept at handling POKéMON?$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieImGoingAfterGroudon
text: MAXIE: Your team adapted; my plan did not. I understand the lesson. / But GROUDON is loose, and ARCHIE still holds the matching disaster. / He needs STERN's submarine to reach the seafloor. STERN is in SLATEPORT. / Go to the harbor in northeast SLATEPORT and warn CAPT. STERN. / I will follow GROUDON. This is no longer an experiment we control.$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: The INSTITUTE mapped every pressure shift before the storm arrived. / ARCHIE needs those maps. You are not interrupting this current again.$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: You read the pressure change first…$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: These maps connect the strange storms to the ocean's depths. / SHELLY took the researchers upstairs. ARCHIE wants their readings.$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt4Intro
text: You crossed the flooded grass alone? Then this indoor front will not stop you. / I will change the forecast myself.$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt4Defeat
text: My forecast failed completely…$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
text: The bed restores exhausted teams. Use it. SHELLY is upstairs with the researchers. That is your next front.$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_EveryoneWentUpstairs
text: Those AQUA people took the researchers upstairs while I was asleep! / Can you go up and help them?$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_WowYoureStrong
text: Wow, you're really strong! / I wish I could be a POKéMON TRAINER like you!$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_ProfStudyingRain
text: The PROFESSOR loves rain. That's a fact. / But if it keeps raining, people will be in trouble. That's another fact. / And thus, the PROFESSOR is studying if the rain can be put to good use.$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_NoticingAbnormalWeather
text: On the 2nd floor of the INSTITUTE, we study the weather patterns over the HOENN region. / We've been noticing temporary and isolated cases of droughts and heavy rain lately…$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_WhatWereAquasUpTo
text: You saved our staff and records. AQUA wanted to know what is causing these violent changes in weather.$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_TakeRestInBed
text: There's a bed… Let's take a rest.$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt2Intro
text: CASTFORM reads a battlefield before the first drop falls. AQUA needs that gift. / You will not reach the research wing.$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: You changed the forecast around me…$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: CASTFORM does not command the weather. It survives by changing with it.$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt3Intro
text: Rare data, rare POKéMON, hidden currents. AQUA follows what the world conceals.$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
text: You exposed every hidden line…$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
text: ARCHIE wants a world no border can hold. You keep asking what that freedom costs.$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt5Intro
text: You came for the weather POKéMON, too? / Then you know a changing form can answer more fields than a rigid one. Show me.$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt5Defeat
text: Your answer changed one turn sooner…$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
text: CASTFORM was never the whole objective. The storm records point toward MT. PYRE and its ORBS.$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ShellyIntro
text: SHELLY: We came for weather records. They show what happens when the ancient sea begins to stir. / AQUA changes the battlefield before the opponent can adjust. / Let's see how quickly you read a storm!$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ShellyDefeat
text: You found the calm inside my storm…$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ShellyPostBattle
text: You adapted inside the storm. No wonder ARCHIE remembers you. / The records point to MT. PYRE. We move.$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_TeamMagmaJustPassedBy
text: TEAM MAGMA just passed below us. They were searching for an ancient BLUE ORB. / They are headed for MT. PYRE!$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_WeHaveToHurryToMtPyre
text: What?! MAGMA already moved toward the BLUE ORB? / The records confirm MT. PYRE is the next node. AQUA, change course now!$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ThanksPleaseTakePokemon
text: You saved our staff and our data. Take this CASTFORM as a research partner. / It reads weather directly, and old desert records say the land itself knows it.$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_NoRoomForPokemon
text: Hm? You don't seem to have any room for this POKéMON.$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_PlayerReceivedCastform
text: {PLAYER} received CASTFORM!$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_PokemonChangesWithWeather
text: CASTFORM changes with the weather. Let it show you what a storm can do. / Now that our work can continue, five badges let you find TORNADUS on ROUTE 119 and THUNDURUS on ROUTE 110. / Search their grass. Each has a 1% chance; SWEET SCENT gives 25%, shared with other local legends. / A researcher at ROUTE 111's elevated ruins also needs CASTFORM for a weather survey.$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_RevealGlassPurpose
text: This REVEAL GLASS changes the forms of TORNADUS, THUNDURUS, and LANDORUS. / The northern bridge is clear now. Follow ROUTE 119 to FORTREE's GYM.$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_RevealGlassBagFull
text: The REVEAL GLASS is ready for you, but your KEY ITEMS pocket is full. / Make room, then speak with me again.$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ChangingWeatherRidiculous
text: Our instruments track unusual weather across HOENN. / DEVON's researcher tracks the legendary POKéMON. His guide tells you where and when to search. / The road north leads to FORTREE. You're welcome to rest here.$

text: I track weather patterns over the HOENN region. / Presently, a drought has been recorded in {STR_VAR_1}. / Could that mean, somewhere near {STR_VAR_1}…$

text: Abnormal weather conditions are no longer being reported. / The occasional rainfall is a blessing, really.$
